MBE 考题解析

Real Property: Future Interests

核心考点 本题考察的是附确定期限的完全保有地产 (Fee Simple Determinable) 及其对应的未来权益——复归可能性 (Possibility of Reverter) 的性质与转移。
1识别地产类型

契约中的用语 "so long as it is used for school purposes"（只要用于学校目的）是典型的持续性语言 (Durational Language)。

这种语言创造了 Fee Simple Determinable (FSD)。其特点是：一旦条件被打破，地产权自动 (Automatically) 终止，无需原所有人采取任何法律行动。

类型 关键用语 终止方式
FSD
(本题)		 So long as,
Until,
During		 自动终止
(Automatic)
FSSCS
(条件后续)		 But if,
Provided that		 需行使进入权
(Right of Entry)
2确定未来权益归属

当所有人设立 FSD 时，他保留了 Possibility of Reverter (复归可能性)。这是一种未来权益。

题目中的法条指出："descendible"（可继承的）权益也是 "devisable"（可遗赠的）。

关键推理链条：

所有人 (Owner)
持有 Possibility of Reverter
↓ 去世 (遗嘱)
朋友 (Friend)
通过遗嘱获得 "all my estate"
(包含复归可能性)
↓ 学校关闭
朋友 (Friend)
自动获得 Fee Simple Absolute
(土地所有权)
3分析当前状态

当学区关闭学校时，"用于学校目的" 的条件不再满足。由于是 FSD，学区的权利瞬间自动终止。

此时，土地所有权立即回到了复归可能性的持有人手中。根据遗嘱，这个持有人是朋友。

因此，学区随后签发给开发商的免责契约 (Quitclaim Deed) 是无效的，因为那时学区已经没有任何权利可以转让了。

正确答案：B (The friend)

为什么其他选项是错的？

A. The Developer (开发商)
错误。开发商从学区购买土地时，学区的权利已经因为学校关闭而自动终止了。学区不能转让它不拥有的东西 (Nemo dat quod non habet)。
C. The School District (学区)
错误。FSD 的性质决定了违反条件时权利自动丧失，不会停留在学区手中。
D. The Son (儿子)
错误。虽然儿子是法定继承人 (Heir)，但所有人留下了有效的遗嘱 (Will)，将所有财产给了朋友。遗嘱优先于法定继承。Possibility of Reverter 是可以通过遗嘱转让的财产权益。
💡 MBE 提分技巧
在做此类题目时，务必区分 Fee Simple Determinable (FSD) 和 Fee Simple Subject to Condition Subsequent (FSSCS)。

如果是 FSSCS（例如用词是 "but if"），违反条件不会自动终止权利，必须由持有 "Right of Entry" 的人采取行动收回。如果本题是 FSSCS，且朋友未行使权利，学区（及开发商）可能仍持有土地。但本题是 "so long as" (FSD)，所以是自动回归。

questions.question:
An elderly woman owned a large manor in fee simple. Because of her advanced age, she no longer wished to deal with maintenance and other obligations associated with homeownership. She therefore conveyed the manor to her eldest son for life, remainder to her youngest son.
The youngest son took ill and died three years later, leaving his entire estate to a friend under the terms of his duly executed will. The youngest son was survived by his daughter, his sole heir. The eldest son died six months later, survived by the elderly woman, the friend, and the daughter.
The jurisdiction in which the manor is situated recognizes traditional common-law rules regarding the destructibility of contingent remainders.
In an appropriate action between the elderly woman, the friend, and the daughter to determine title to the manor, who will prevail?

choices.a: The daughter, because she is the youngest son's heir.
choices.b: The elderly woman, because she had a reversion that entitled her to possession of the manor immediately upon the eldest son's death.
choices.c: The elderly woman, because the youngest son's contingent remainder was destroyed when he predeceased the eldest son.
choices.d: The friend, because the youngest son's vested remainder was transferred by his will.

data.questionStem:
Q86061

An elderly woman owned a large manor in fee simple. Because of her advanced age, she no longer wished to deal with maintenance and other obligations associated with homeownership. She therefore conveyed the manor to her eldest son for life, remainder to her youngest son.

The youngest son took ill and died three years later, leaving his entire estate to a friend under the terms of his duly executed will. The youngest son was survived by his daughter, his sole heir. The eldest son died six months later, survived by the elderly woman, the friend, and the daughter.

The jurisdiction in which the manor is situated recognizes traditional common-law rules regarding the destructibility of contingent remainders.

In an appropriate action between the elderly woman, the friend, and the daughter to determine title to the manor, who will prevail?

一位年迈的女士以完全保有地产权(fee simple)的形式拥有一座大庄园。由于年事已高，她不愿再处理与房屋所有权相关的维护和其他义务。因此，她将庄园转让给她的长子，授予其终身地产权(life estate)，剩余权(remainder)授予她的小儿子。

三年后，小儿子病故，根据其合法订立的遗嘱，将其全部遗产留给了一位朋友。小儿子身后留有他的女儿，即其唯一继承人。六个月后，长子去世，在世的相关人有这位年迈的女士、那位朋友以及小儿子的女儿。

庄园所在地的司法管辖区承认关于或然剩余权(contingent remainders)可摧毁性的传统普通法规则。

在一场由这位年迈的女士、朋友和女儿之间为确定庄园所有权而提起的适当诉讼中，谁将胜诉？
options:
A. The daughter, because she is the youngest son's heir.
女儿，因为她是小儿子的继承人。

B. The elderly woman, because she had a reversion that entitled her to possession of the manor immediately upon the eldest son's death.
年迈的女士，因为她拥有复归权(reversion)，该权利使其有权在长子去世后立即占有庄园。

C. The elderly woman, because the youngest son's contingent remainder was destroyed when he predeceased the eldest son.
年迈的女士，因为小儿子的或然剩余权(contingent remainder)在他先于长子去世时被摧毁。

D. The friend, because the youngest son's vested remainder was transferred by his will.
朋友，因为小儿子的既定剩余权(vested remainder)已通过其遗嘱转让。
data.explanation:
A life estate is a present possessory interest in real property that terminates on the death of an individual. The future interest that follows a life estate is either a reversion (if held by the grantor) or a remainder (if created in a grantee - as seen here). Remainders are either:

  • vested - not subject to any condition precedent AND held by an identifiable living person (eg, "remainder to my youngest son") or
  • contingent - subject to a condition precedent OR held by an unknown or unborn person (eg, "remainder to my youngest son, but only if … ").


Both types of remainders are fully transferable during the grantee's lifetime,† devisable by will , and inheritable through intestate succession.

Here, the elderly woman conveyed the manor to her eldest son for life, remainder to her youngest son. Since the manor would go to the youngest son unconditionally when the eldest son died, the youngest son had a vested remainder. That remainder was devisable, so it transferred to his friend under the terms of his duly executed will. And since the eldest son has since died, the friend has title to the manor in fee simple.

†At common law and in a minority of jurisdictions, contingent remainders are not transferable during the grantee's lifetime.

(Choice A) The daughter has no interest in the manor because the youngest son devised his vested remainder to the friend.

(Choice B) The elderly woman (grantor) did not have a reversion that entitled her to possession immediately upon the eldest son's death. Instead, the friend was entitled to possession of the manor at that time because he had the youngest son's remainder interest.

(Choice C) At common law and in this jurisdiction, contingent remainders are destroyed if they have not vested by the time the prior estate terminates. But this rule does not affect the youngest son's vested remainder.

Educational objective: Remainders - whether they are vested or contingent - are fully transferable during the grantee's lifetime, devisable by will, and inheritable through intestate succession.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 13%，C选项 26%，D选项 54%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

终身地产权(life estate)是一种现有的不动产占有权益，它在某一个人死亡时终止。在终身地产权之后的未来权益(future interest)，要么是复归权(reversion)（如果由授予人持有），要么是剩余权(remainder)（如果为受让人创设——如此处所示）。剩余权分为两种：

  • 既定剩余权(vested) - 不受任何先决条件限制，并且由一个可确定的在世人持有（例如，“剩余权授予我的小儿子”）或
  • 或然剩余权(contingent) - 受先决条件限制，或者由一个未知或未出生的人持有（例如，“剩余权授予我的小儿子，但前提是……”）。


两种类型的剩余权在受让人在世时都是可完全转让的†，可通过遗嘱转让的，以及可通过无遗嘱继承的方式继承的。

在本案中，这位年迈的女士将庄园转让给她的长子，授予其终身地产权，剩余权授予她的小儿子。由于长子去世后，庄园将无条件地归小儿子所有，因此小儿子拥有的是既定剩余权(vested remainder)。该剩余权是可通过遗嘱转让的，因此根据其合法订立的遗嘱，该权利已转让给他的朋友。并且由于长子此后已经去世，该朋友以完全保有地产权(fee simple)的形式拥有该庄园的所有权。

†在普通法以及少数司法管辖区中，或然剩余权在受让人在世时不可转让。

(选项A) 女儿对庄园没有权益，因为小儿子已将其既定剩余权通过遗嘱转让给了朋友。

(选项B) 年迈的女士（授予人）并不拥有复归权，该权利并不使其有权在长子去世后立即占有庄园。相反，朋友在那个时候有权占有庄园，因为他拥有小儿子的剩余权益。

(选项C) 在普通法和本案的司法管辖区中，如果或然剩余权在先有地产权终止时仍未既定化(vested)，则该权利将被摧毁。但此规则不影响小儿子的既定剩余权。

教学目的：剩余权——无论是既定剩余权还是或然剩余权——在受让人在世时均可完全转让，可通过遗嘱转让，并可通过无遗嘱继承的方式继承。

References

Moore v. McKinley, 69 N.W.2d 73, 80 (Iowa 1955) (describing the difference between vested and contingent remainders).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Future Interests
核心考点：既定剩余权 (Vested Remainder)

本题的关键在于识别小儿子的权益性质。当剩余权授予给一个已确定的人(ascertained person)且不受先决条件(condition precedent)限制时，它就是既定剩余权。

1. 产权转让 (Conveyance)
母亲 → 长子 (Life Estate)
母亲 → 小儿子 (Remainder)
分析： 小儿子是确定的，且获得产权没有额外条件（只要长子死，他一定得）。因此是 Vested Remainder。
2. 小儿子去世
小儿子立有遗嘱，将财产留给朋友。
法律后果： 既定剩余权是财产权益，可以通过遗嘱继承 (Devisable)。权益转移给朋友。
3. 长子去世
终身地产权 (Life Estate) 结束。
结果： 剩余权持有人（现在是朋友）获得占有权，成为 Fee Simple 所有者。
✅ 正确答案：D (朋友)

理由：

  • 小儿子拥有的是 Indefeasibly Vested Remainder（绝对既定剩余权）。
  • 这种权益在法律上等同于现有的财产权益，具有可转让性 (Alienable)、可遗赠性 (Devisable) 和 可继承性 (Descendible)。
  • 因为小儿子立了遗嘱，该权益根据遗嘱转移给了朋友，而不是通过无遗嘱继承法传给女儿。
⚠️ 常见陷阱 (Red Herring)

关于选项 C (Destructibility Rule)：

题目特意提到该管辖区承认“或然剩余权的可摧毁性规则” (Destructibility of Contingent Remainders)。这是一个干扰项。

该规则仅适用于或然剩余权 (Contingent Remainder)。例如：“给长子终身，如果小儿子那时年满21岁，则给小儿子”。

在本题中，小儿子的权益是既定的 (Vested)，因此该规则完全不适用。

为什么其他选项错误？

  • 选项 A (女儿)： 只有在小儿子没有遗嘱 (Intestate) 的情况下，女儿作为继承人才有份。但这里有有效遗嘱。
  • 选项 B (母亲)： 母亲已经把完整的 Fee Simple 拆分成了 Life Estate + Remainder 分别给了两个儿子，她自己没有保留任何权益 (No Reversion)。

questions.question:
A landlord leased a building to a tenant for a 10-year term. Two years after the term began, the tenant subleased the building to a sublessee for a 5-year term. Under the terms of the sublease, the sublessee agreed to make monthly rent payments to the tenant.
Although the sublessee made timely rent payments to the tenant, the tenant did not forward four of those payments to the landlord. The tenant has left the jurisdiction and cannot be found. The landlord has sued the sublessee for the unpaid rent.
There is no applicable statute.
If the court rules that the sublessee is not liable to the landlord for the unpaid rent, what will be the most likely reason?

choices.a: A sublessee is responsible to the landlord only as a surety for unpaid rent owed by the tenant.
choices.b: The sublease constitutes a novation of the original lease.
choices.c: The sublessee is not in privity of estate or contract with the landlord.
choices.d: The sublessee's rent payments to the tenant fully discharged the sublessee's obligation to pay rent to the landlord.

A landlord leased a building to a tenant for a 10-year term. Two years after the term began, the tenant subleased the building to a sublessee for a 5-year term. Under the terms of the sublease, the sublessee agreed to make monthly rent payments to the tenant.

Although the sublessee made timely rent payments to the tenant, the tenant did not forward four of those payments to the landlord. The tenant has left the jurisdiction and cannot be found. The landlord has sued the sublessee for the unpaid rent.

If the court rules that the sublessee is not liable to the landlord for the unpaid rent, what will be the most likely reason?

一位房东将一栋建筑物出租给一位承租人，租期为10年。租期开始两年后，承租人将该建筑物转租给一位次承租人，租期为5年。根据转租合同的条款，次承租人同意向承租人按月支付租金。

尽管次承租人及时向承租人支付了租金，但承租人并未将其中四笔租金转交给房东。承租人已离开该司法管辖区，下落不明。房东已就未付租金起诉次承租人。

本案没有适用的成文法。

如果法院裁定次承租人对房东的未付租金不承担责任，最可能的原因是什么？
options:
A. A sublessee is responsible to the landlord only as a surety for unpaid rent owed by the tenant.
次承租人仅作为承租人所欠未付租金的保证人，向房东负责。

B. The sublease constitutes a novation of the original lease.
该转租合同构成了对原租赁合同的更新(novation)。

C. The sublessee is not in privity of estate or contract with the landlord.
次承租人与房东之间不存在财产利益关系(privity of estate)或合同关系(privity of contract)。

D. The sublessee's rent payments to the tenant fully discharged the sublessee's obligation to pay rent to the landlord.
次承租人向承租人支付租金的行为，完全解除了次承租人向房东支付租金的义务。
data.explanation:
A landlord and tenant have a legal relationship based on both:
  • privity of contract - their shared interest in the lease agreement and
  • privity of estate - their successive right to possess the property (ie, the tenant's current possessory right immediately precedes the landlord's future possessory right).


Either party can freely transfer his/her interest unless the lease prohibits it. For example, a tenant can sublease part of his/her interest to a third party (sublessee) for less than the remainder of the tenant's lease term. Despite that transfer, a sublessee is not liable to the landlord for a breach of the lease (eg, unpaid rent) because:
  • no lease agreement exists between the landlord and the sublessee (no privity of contract) and
  • the tenant will regain possession of the property before the landlord does (no privity of estate).


Instead, the tenant remains liable to the landlord for any such breach.

(Choice A) A surety is a person who assumes direct liability for another's obligation (eg, debt). Here, the sublessee is not a surety because there is no indication that the sublessee agreed to assume the tenant's contractual liability under the lease. Therefore, the sublessee is not liable for the tenant's failure to pay rent.

(Choice B) A novation is a separate agreement based on an existing contract that (1) substitutes a new party for an original contracting party and (2) excuses the original party from further performance under the original contract. But since a sublease does neither, it is not a novation.

(Choice D) A sublessee has no obligation to pay rent to a landlord.

Educational objective: Since a sublessee and landlord lack privity of contract and privity of estate, the sublessee is not liable to the landlord for a breach of the tenant's lease (eg, unpaid rent). Instead, the tenant remains liable to the landlord for any such breach.



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 0%，C选项 83%（正确选项），D选项 14%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

房东与承租人的法律关系基于以下两者：
  • 合同关系 (privity of contract) - 他们在租赁协议中的共同利益以及
  • 财产利益关系 (privity of estate) - 他们对财产的相继占有权（即，承租人当前的占有权紧接在房东未来的占有权之前）。


任何一方均可自由转让其权益，除非租赁合同禁止。例如，承租人可以在其剩余租期内，将其部分权益转租给第三方（次承租人）。尽管有此转让，次承租人仍对房东不因违反租赁合同（例如，未付租金）而承担责任，因为：
  • 房东与次承租人之间不存在租赁协议（无合同关系）并且
  • 承租人将在房东之前重新获得对该财产的占有权（无财产利益关系）。


相反，承租人仍需就任何此类违约行为向房东承担责任。

(选项 A) 保证人是指为他人的义务（如债务）承担直接责任的人。在本案中，次承租人不是保证人，因为没有迹象表明次承租人同意承担承租人在租赁合同下的合同责任。因此，次承租人对承租人未能支付租金不承担责任。

(选项 B) 债务更新(novation)是一项基于现有合同的独立协议，该协议 (1) 以新的一方替代原合同方，并且 (2) 免除原合同方在原合同下的进一步履行义务。但由于转租合同不具备上述任何一项特征，因此它不是债务更新。

(选项 D) 次承租人没有义务向房东支付租金。

教学目的： 由于次承租人与房东之间缺乏合同关系(privity of contract)和财产利益关系(privity of estate)，因此次承租人无需为承租人违反租赁合同（如未付租金）向房东承担责任。相反，承租人仍需为任何此类违约行为向房东承担责任。

References

49 Am. Jur. 2d Landlord and Tenant § 970 (2018).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Landlord & Tenant
核心考点：转租 (Sublease) vs. 转让 (Assignment) 在房产法中，承租人将租赁权转给第三方时，根据转让期限的不同，分为两种法律关系。这直接决定了第三方是否需要直接向房东负责。
法律关系图解
房东 (Landlord)
⬇️
承租人 (Tenant) (Privity of Contract & Estate)
⬇️ (转租 Sublease)
次承租人 (Sublessee)
❌ 房东与次承租人之间无直接连接
本案解析

要判断次承租人(Sublessee)是否对房东(Landlord)负责，必须看两者之间是否存在法律上的“关联”(Privity)。

1. 判定类型：是转租还是转让？

  • 转让 (Assignment)：承租人转让了剩余的全部租期。
  • 转租 (Sublease)：承租人只转让了部分租期，自己保留了未来的回归权 (Reversion)。

本案中，原租期剩8年（10年-2年），但只转给了次承租人 5年。承租人保留了最后3年的权益。因此，这是一个转租 (Sublease)。

2. 法律后果：

在转租关系中：

  • 无合同关系 (No Privity of Contract)：房东只和原承租人签了合同，没和次承租人签。
  • 无财产利益关系 (No Privity of Estate)：因为原承租人保留了部分权益（回归权），次承租人的占有权并不直接衔接房东的权益。
为什么选 C？
✅ 选项 C 正确

"The sublessee is not in privity of estate or contract with the landlord."

这是转租(Sublease)最核心的法律特征。因为缺乏这两种“Privity”中的任何一种，房东无法直接起诉次承租人要求支付租金。房东只能起诉原承租人(Tenant)，再由原承租人向次承租人追偿。

❌ 选项 A (Surety/保证人)

除非次承租人明确签署协议同意为原承租人的债务担保，否则法律不会自动将其视为保证人。

❌ 选项 B (Novation/债务更新)

Novation 需要三方（房东、承租人、次承租人）共同达成协议，明确房东同意释放原承租人的责任并由新人取代。单纯的转租不构成 Novation。

❌ 选项 D (Payment/支付行为)

次承租人向承租人付款是履行他们之间的转租合同，但这并不是免除对房东责任的法律理由。根本理由是次承租人对房东本来就没有直接责任。

💡 MBE 拿分技巧

看到 "Sublease vs. Assignment" 的题目，直接看剩余时间：

  • 转让全部剩余时间 ➡️ Assignment ➡️ 有 Privity of Estate ➡️ 要对房东负责。
  • 保留哪怕一天时间 ➡️ Sublease ➡️ 无 Privity ➡️ 不要对房东负责。

questions.question:
A man owned a tract of land in fee simple. Five years ago, he executed and delivered to his sister an instrument in the proper form of a warranty deed that conveyed the land to the sister "for and during the term of her natural life." No other estate or interest or person taking an interest was mentioned. The sister took possession of the land and has remained in possession.
Fifteen months ago, the man died, leaving a will that has been duly admitted to probate. The will, inter alia, had the following provision: "I devise the land to my wife for her natural life and from and after my wife's death to my son, his heirs and assigns, forever."
Administration of the man's estate has been completed. The man's wife claims the immediate right to possession of the land. His son also asserts a right to immediate possession.
In an appropriate lawsuit to which the sister, the wife, and the son are parties, who should be adjudged to have the right to immediate possession?

choices.a: The sister, because no subsequent act of the man would affect her life estate.
choices.b: The son, because the sister's estate terminated with the man's death and all that the man had was the right to transfer his reversion in fee simple.
choices.c: The wife, because the man's will was the final and definitive expression of his intent.
choices.d: The wife, because the sister's estate terminated with the death of the man.

Q86048

A man owned a tract of land in fee simple. Five years ago, he executed and delivered to his sister an instrument in the proper form of a warranty deed that conveyed the land to the sister "for and during the term of her natural life." No other estate or interest or person taking an interest was mentioned. The sister took possession of the land and has remained in possession.

Fifteen months ago, the man died, leaving a will that has been duly admitted to probate. The will, inter alia, had the following provision: "I devise the land to my wife for her natural life and from and after my wife's death to my son, his heirs and assigns, forever."

Administration of the man's estate has been completed. The man's wife claims the immediate right to possession of the land. His son also asserts a right to immediate possession.

In an appropriate lawsuit to which the sister, the wife, and the son are parties, who should be adjudged to have the right to immediate possession?

一名男子以完全所有权(fee simple)拥有一块土地。五年前，他签署并向其妹妹交付了一份格式正确的担保契据，将该土地转让给妹妹，“期限为她的自然生命期间”。契据中未提及任何其他产权、权益或享有权益的人。妹妹占有了该土地并持续占有至今。

十五个月前，该男子去世，留下了一份已正式通过遗嘱认证的遗嘱。该遗嘱除其他事项外，有如下条款：“我将此土地遗赠给我的妻子，期限为她的自然生命期间，并在我妻子去世后，永久遗赠给我的儿子及其继承人和受让人。”

该男子的遗产管理已经完成。该男子的妻子主张对该土地的即时占有权。他的儿子也主张即时占有权。

在一场以妹妹、妻子和儿子为当事人的适当诉讼中，谁应被判决拥有即时占有权？
options:
A. The sister, because no subsequent act of the man would affect her life estate.
妹妹，因为该男子的任何后续行为都不会影响她的终身地产权。

B. The son, because the sister's estate terminated with the man's death and all that the man had was the right to transfer his reversion in fee simple.
儿子，因为妹妹的地产权随着该男子的死亡而终止，而该男子所拥有的全部权利只是转让他以完全所有权(fee simple)享有的复归权。

C. The wife, because the man's will was the final and definitive expression of his intent.
妻子，因为该男子的遗嘱是其意图的最终和明确的表达。

D. The wife, because the sister's estate terminated with the death of the man.
妻子，因为妹妹的地产权随着该男子的死亡而终止。
data.explanation:
Types of life estates


Words of purchaseWords of limitationDefining characteristic
Life estate"To A""for life"Ownership for duration of life of grantee
Life estate pur autre vie"To A""for the life of B"Ownership for duration of life of person other than grantee
A life estate is a present possessory estate that terminates on the death of an individual. The future interest that follows a life estate is either a remainder (if created in a grantee) or a reversion (if retained by the grantor ). If a grantor conveys a life estate without specifying who holds the future interest, then it is presumed that the grantor retains a reversion. This interest is fully transferable during the grantor's lifetime, devisable by will, and inheritable through intestate succession.

Here, the man conveyed a life estate in the land to his sister that would terminate when she died. The conveyance mentioned no other person or interest, so it is presumed that the man retained a reversion entitling him to possession of the land once the sister died. Until that time, however, the most the man could convey was his reversionary interest. Therefore, the man could do nothing that would affect the sister's life estate, and she should be adjudged to have the right to immediate possession of the land (Choices B, C & D).

Educational objective: If a grantor conveys a life estate without specifying who holds the future interest, the grantor presumptively retains a reversion.

选项正确率统计：A选项 91%（正确选项），B选项 0%，C选项 5%，D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

终身地产权的类型


受让人条款权益限制条款定义特征
Life estate (终身地产权)“授予A”“终身”所有权持续至受让人生命终结
Life estate pur autre vie (为他人之身的终身地产权)“授予A”“以B的生命为期”所有权持续至受让人以外的他人生命终结
终身地产权(life estate)是一种现时占有性地产权，它在某一个人死亡时终止。终身地产权之后的未来权益(future interest)，如果创设给受让人，则为余留权(remainder)；如果由授予人保留，则为复归权(reversion)。如果授予人转让了终身地产权但未指明未来权益的持有人，则推定授予人保留复归权。此项权益在授予人生前可完全转让，可通过遗嘱处分，也可通过无遗嘱继承来继承。

在本案中，该男子将其土地的终身地产权转让给了他的妹妹，该权益将在妹妹去世时终止。该转让未提及任何其他人或权益，因此推定该男子保留了复归权，使其有权在妹妹去世后占有该土地。然而，在此之前，该男子最多只能转让其复归权益。因此，该男子所做的任何事情都不能影响妹妹的终身地产权，故应判决她拥有对该土地的即时占有权（因此选项B、C、D错误）。

教学目的：如果授予人转让了终身地产权但未指明未来权益的持有人，则推定授予人保留复归权。

References

Restatement of Property § 107 (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (discussing life estates).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：终身地产权与复归权

本题考察的是不动产法中关于终身地产权 (Life Estate) 的存续期间以及生前转让 (Inter Vivos Conveyance) 与遗嘱 (Will) 之间的效力层级。

核心法律概念

终身地产权 (Life Estate)：
一种赋予持有者在其有生之年占有和使用土地的权利。除非明确说明是“为他人之身” (pur autre vie)，否则其期限由持有者 (Grantee) 的寿命决定。

复归权 (Reversion)：
当原所有者 (Grantor) 转让出的权益少于其拥有的全部权益时（例如，拥有完全所有权却只转让了终身地产权），剩余的权益自动保留在原所有者手中。

逻辑推演步骤

第一步：分析五年前的转让行为
男子签署并交付了契据 (Deed)。这是一个有效的生前转让。
  • 受让人：妹妹。
  • 期限："for and during the term of her natural life"（在她自然生命期间）。
  • 结论：妹妹获得了以她自己的生命为量度的终身地产权。男子保留了复归权 (Reversion)。
权利状态时间轴
5年前：契据交付
妹妹获得现时占有权 (Possession)
↓
15个月前：男子去世
妹妹还活着 → 她的权利未终止
↓
现在：诉讼
妹妹仍享有占有权
第二步：分析男子去世的影响
男子的死亡不会终止妹妹的终身地产权。

因为契据中界定的期限是“妹妹的生命”，而不是“男子的生命”。只要妹妹还活着，她的地产权就继续存在。

第三步：分析遗嘱的效力
遗嘱 (Will) 只能处分死者在去世时实际拥有的财产。
  • 男子去世时，该土地的现时占有权属于妹妹。
  • 男子拥有的只是复归权 (Reversion)（即未来权益）。
  • 因此，遗嘱有效地将这个“复归权”传给了妻子（作为新的终身权益）和儿子（作为余留权人）。
  • 但是，妻子和儿子的权益必须等到妹妹去世后才能转变为占有权。
正确答案：A (妹妹)

妹妹拥有即时占有权，因为她的终身地产权尚未结束。男子的任何后续行为（包括立遗嘱）都不能单方面撤销已经有效交付的契据。

为什么其他选项是错误的？

选项 B (儿子)： 错误地认为妹妹的权益随男子死亡而终止。除非契据写明是“以男子的生命为期” (pur autre vie)，否则原所有者的死亡不影响受让人的终身地产权。
选项 C & D (妻子)： 错误。遗嘱不能推翻之前已经完成的生前转让。男子不能通过遗嘱把已经送给妹妹的“现时占有权”再送给妻子。他只能遗赠他剩下的东西（即等待妹妹去世后的复归权）。
💡 MBE 考试技巧
在做不动产题目时，牢记 "Nemo dat quod non habet"（人不能给付其本身未享有的权利）。

一旦题目中出现“契据已交付” (Deed delivered)，该权益就已经从授予人身上剥离了。授予人死后的遗嘱无法收回这部分权益。始终先画出时间轴，确定谁是“测量生命” (Measuring Life)。

questions.question:
A retiree conveyed a condo he owned to "my son for life, remainder to my granddaughter." At the time of the conveyance, there was a mortgage on the condo with an unpaid balance of $25,000. The mortgage required monthly payments covering the interest to date and a portion of the principal.
For the past six months, the son has been living alone in the condo and paying the full monthly payment due to the lender. The son has since asked his lawyer for advice regarding the parties' obligations with respect to the monthly payment.
What should the lawyer tell him?

choices.a: The granddaughter and the son must pay based on the present value of their respective interests.
choices.b: The granddaughter must pay the full monthly payment.
choices.c: The son must pay the full monthly payment.
choices.d: The son must pay the principal, but the granddaughter must pay the interest to the lender.

questions.question:
A widow executed a will that devised a condominium unit to her only child, a son, for life and then to her named granddaughter "if she survives." The will named a charity as the alternate beneficiary of the condominium unit. The widow died and, 25 years later, the widow's son died. At the time of the son's death, the widow's granddaughter had been dead for three years. The granddaughter's will devised her entire estate to a friend.
In a dispute between the charity and the granddaughter's friend regarding ownership of the condominium unit, the court determined that the survivorship provision in the widow's will was ambiguous and awarded the condominium unit to the charity.
Which of the following is the most likely reason that the court awarded the condominium unit to the charity?

choices.a: The jurisdiction continues to follow the common law Rule Against Perpetuities.
choices.b: The jurisdiction continues to follow the common law rule regarding the destructibility of contingent remainders.
choices.c: The jurisdiction has adopted the majority rule that the holder of a remainder interest must survive the owner of the immediately preceding estate.
choices.d: The jurisdiction's anti-lapse statute does not apply to the granddaughter.

questions.question:
A father owned property in fee simple. The small house on the property was occupied, with the father's oral permission, rent-free by his son and the son's college classmate. The son was then 21 years old.
The father, by properly executed instrument, conveyed the property to "my beloved son, his heirs and assigns, upon the condition precedent that he earn a college degree by the time he reaches the age of 30. If, for any reason, he does not meet this condition, then the property shall become the sole property of my beloved daughter, her heirs and assigns." At the time of the conveyance, the son and his classmate attended a college located several blocks from the property. Neither had earned a college degree.
One week after the delivery of the deed to the son, he recorded the deed and immediately told the classmate that he was going to begin charging the classmate rent since "I am now your landlord." There is no applicable statute.
The son and the classmate did not reach agreement, and the son served the appropriate notice to terminate whatever tenancy the classmate had. The son then sought, in an appropriate action, to oust the classmate.
Who should prevail?

choices.a: The classmate, because he is a tenant of the father, not of the son.
choices.b: The classmate, because the father's permission to occupy preceded the father's conveyance to the son.
choices.c: The son, because the conveyance created a fee simple subject to divestment in the son.
choices.d: The son, because the father's conveyance terminated the classmate's tenancy.

data.questionStem:
Q86085

A father owned property in fee simple. The small house on the property was occupied, with the father's oral permission, rent-free by his son and the son's college classmate. The son was then 21 years old.

The father, by properly executed instrument, conveyed the property to "my beloved son, his heirs and assigns, upon the condition precedent that he earn a college degree by the time he reaches the age of 30. If, for any reason, he does not meet this condition, then the property shall become the sole property of my beloved daughter, her heirs and assigns." At the time of the conveyance, the son and his classmate attended a college located several blocks from the property. Neither had earned a college degree.

One week after the delivery of the deed to the son, he recorded the deed and immediately told the classmate that he was going to begin charging the classmate rent since "I am now your landlord." There is no applicable statute.

The son and the classmate did not reach agreement, and the son served the appropriate notice to terminate whatever tenancy the classmate had. The son then sought, in an appropriate action, to oust the classmate.

Who should prevail?

一位父亲以fee simple（绝对所有权）拥有一处房产。该房产上的一栋小房子，经父亲口头许可，由其儿子和儿子的大学同学免费居住。当时，儿子21岁。

父亲通过一份妥善签署的文书，将该房产转让给“我亲爱的儿子及其继承人和受让人，但其先决条件（condition precedent）是，他在年满30岁之前获得大学学位。如果因任何原因，他未能满足此条件，则该房产应成为我亲爱的女儿及其继承人和受让人的独有财产。”在转让之时，儿子和他的同学在距离该房产几个街区的一所大学就读。两人均未获得大学学位。

在契约（deed）交付给儿子一周后，儿子登记了该契约，并立即告知其同学，他将开始向其收取租金，因为“我现在是你的房东了。”本案没有适用的成文法。

儿子和同学未能达成协议，于是儿子送达了适当的通知，以终止该同学所拥有的任何租赁关系（tenancy）。随后，儿子通过适当的诉讼，试图驱逐该同学。

谁应该胜诉？
options:
A. The classmate, because he is a tenant of the father, not of the son.
同学，因为他是父亲的承租人，而不是儿子的承租人。

B. The classmate, because the father's permission to occupy preceded the father's conveyance to the son.
同学，因为父亲允许其居住在先，父亲向儿子转让房产在后。

C. The son, because the conveyance created a fee simple subject to divestment in the son.
儿子，因为该转让为儿子创设了一个可被剥夺的fee simple（fee simple subject to divestment）。

D. The son, because the father's conveyance terminated the classmate's tenancy.
儿子，因为父亲的转让终止了同学的租赁关系。
data.explanation:
A tenancy at will - a tenancy with no fixed term that can be created by express agreement or by implication if the tenant occupies the premises rent-free - generally continues until terminated by either the landlord or the tenant. A tenancy at will terminates automatically when the landlord conveys a present interest in the property to a third party. But when the landlord conveys a future interest, the tenancy continues. In that case, the future interest holder has no right to terminate the tenancy.

Here, the son and the classmate lived in the father's house rent-free (tenancy at will). The father then conveyed a property interest in the home to the son that could become possessory if he earned a college degree before age 30 (future interest). Therefore, that conveyance did not automatically terminate the classmate's tenancy, so the classmate was still the father's tenant (Choice D). And since the son (future interest holder) had no right to terminate that tenancy, the classmate should prevail in the son's action to oust the classmate.

(Choice B) Although the father's permission to occupy the house preceded the conveyance, the son would prevail in his ouster action if the father had conveyed a present interest to the son (since that would have terminated the classmate's tenancy automatically). Therefore, the classmate should not prevail on this basis.

(Choice C) After the conveyance, the father had a fee simple subject to divestment - a present possessory interest that could be cut short upon the happening of a stated condition (ie, if the son graduated college before age 30). The son only had a future interest that could become possessory if that condition occurred.

Educational objective: A tenancy at will can be terminated (1) by the landlord or the tenant or (2) automatically when the landlord conveys a present interest in the property to a third party. But when the landlord conveys a future interest, the tenancy continues, and the future interest holder has no right to terminate that tenancy.



选项正确率统计：A选项 62%（正确选项），B选项 9%，C选项 24%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

任意租赁（tenancy at will）——一种没有固定期限的租赁关系，可以通过明示协议创设，或者在承租人免费占用房产时通过默示方式创设——通常会持续到被房东或承租人任何一方终止为止。当房东将房产的当前权益（present interest）转让给第三方时，任意租赁关系自动终止。但是，当房东转让的是未来权益（future interest）时，租赁关系继续存在。在这种情况下，未来权益持有人（future interest holder）无权终止该租赁关系。

在本案中，儿子和同学免费居住在父亲的房子里（构成任意租赁，tenancy at will）。父亲随后将房屋的一项财产权益转让给了儿子，该权益在他30岁前获得大学学位时即可占有（此为未来权益，future interest）。因此，该转让并未自动终止同学的租赁关系，所以同学仍然是父亲的承租人（因此选项D的理由不成立）。并且，由于儿子（未来权益持有人）无权终止该租赁关系，同学在儿子提起的驱逐诉讼中应当胜诉。

（选项B）尽管父亲允许其居住在先，转让在后，但如果父亲转让给儿子的是一项当前权益（因为那会自动终止同学的租赁关系），那么儿子将在其驱逐诉讼中胜诉。因此，同学不应基于此理由胜诉。

（选项C）转让之后，父亲拥有的是一个可被剥夺的fee simple（fee simple subject to divestment）——即一种当前占有权益（present possessory interest），它可能因某一规定条件的发生（即儿子在30岁前大学毕业）而被终止。儿子只拥有一项未来权益，只有在该条件发生时才可能变为占有权益。

教学目的：任意租赁（tenancy at will）可以通过以下方式终止：（1）由房东或承租人终止；或（2）当房东将房产的当前权益（present interest）转让给第三方时自动终止。但是，当房东转让的是未来权益（future interest）时，租赁关系继续存在，且未来权益持有人无权终止该租赁关系。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Prop.: Landlord & Tenant § 1.6 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (tenancy at will).
  • Restatement (Second) of Prop.: Landlord & Tenant § 15.1 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (termination of tenancy at will upon landlord's conveyance).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Future Interests & Tenancy
💡 核心结论

本题正确答案是 (A)。

关键点：父亲转让给儿子的是“未来权益”（Future Interest），而非“当前占有权益”（Present Possessory Interest）。因此，父亲仍然是房东，儿子无权驱逐房客。

🔍 权益归属分析

理解本题的关键在于准确界定转让后各方的法律地位。

转让前的状态
父亲：Fee Simple Absolute
同学：Tenancy at Will (任意租赁)
⬇️ 父亲签署契约 (Deed)
"To son... upon condition precedent that he earn a college degree..."
转让后的状态
父亲：Fee Simple Subject to Executory Limitation
(当前拥有者/房东)

儿子：Executory Interest (Springing)
(未来权益，尚未占有)
⚖️ 法律推理逻辑

1. 租赁类型的识别
同学免费居住且无固定期限，这构成了任意租赁 (Tenancy at Will)。

2. 权益类型的识别
契约中使用了 "upon condition precedent"（先决条件）这一措辞。这意味着儿子必须先获得学位，然后才能获得房产的所有权。
在此之前，儿子拥有的只是一个执行权益 (Executory Interest)，这是一种未来权益。

3. 租赁终止规则
规则：如果房东转让了房产的当前权益（即卖掉了房子），任意租赁会自动终止。
本案：房东（父亲）只转让了一个未来权益给儿子。父亲仍然保留当前的占有权（直到儿子毕业）。因此，租赁关系没有终止。

结论： 既然租赁未终止，且父亲仍是当前权益持有人，那么父亲才是房东。儿子作为未来权益持有人，无权行使房东的权利（如驱逐房客）。
❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
(A) 正确。同学仍是父亲的租客，因为父亲仍持有当前占有权益。
(B) 错误。虽然“先来后到”在某些产权记录法（Recording Acts）问题中很重要，但在本题中，如果父亲真的转让了当前权益，租赁就会终止。B选项的逻辑没有触及问题的核心（即权益并未真正转移）。
(C) 错误（高频陷阱）。C选项说儿子拥有 "Fee simple subject to divestment"。这是错误的。因为有“先决条件”，儿子目前什么都没拿到（除了一个未来希望）。实际上，是父亲拥有 Fee simple subject to executory limitation（受制于执行权益限制的费用单纯所有权）。
(D) 错误。只有转让“当前权益”才会终止任意租赁。转让未来权益不会影响当前的租赁关系。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧
看到 "Condition Precedent"（先决条件）时要警惕！
这通常意味着受让人(Grantee)目前还没有拿到占有权。

Condition Precedent = Future Interest (Executory Interest)
Condition Subsequent = Present Interest (Defeasible Fee)

questions.question:
A man and a woman owned property as joint tenants with the right of survivorship. Without the woman's knowledge or consent, the man signed a 10-year promissory note to a bank and secured the note with a mortgage on the property. The mortgage was promptly recorded.
Two years later, the man died intestate, leaving his son as his sole heir. The woman first learned of the mortgage after the man died. The woman and the son did not make any payments on the mortgage. As a result, the bank initiated judicial foreclosure proceedings, naming both the son and the woman as parties to the action. The woman and the son have consulted an attorney about the enforceability of the mortgage.
The jurisdiction follows the lien theory of mortgages.
What is the attorney likely to say regarding the mortgage?

choices.a: The mortgage is enforceable against the son and the woman, because the mortgage encumbered the entire property.
choices.b: The mortgage is enforceable against the son only, because he is the man's sole heir.
choices.c: The mortgage is enforceable against the woman only, because she is the surviving joint tenant.
choices.d: The mortgage is not enforceable against the son or the woman, because the mortgage expired upon the man's death.

data.questionStem:
Q86053

A man and a woman owned property as joint tenants with the right of survivorship. Without the woman's knowledge or consent, the man signed a 10-year promissory note to a bank and secured the note with a mortgage on the property. The mortgage was promptly recorded.

Two years later, the man died intestate, leaving his son as his sole heir. The woman first learned of the mortgage after the man died. The woman and the son did not make any payments on the mortgage. As a result, the bank initiated judicial foreclosure proceedings, naming both the son and the woman as parties to the action. The woman and the son have consulted an attorney about the enforceability of the mortgage.

The jurisdiction follows the lien theory of mortgages.

What is the attorney likely to say regarding the mortgage?

一名男子和一名女子以享有生存者权的共同共有关系（joint tenants with the right of survivorship）共同拥有一处房产。在女子不知情或未同意的情况下，该男子与一家银行签署了一份为期10年的本票，并以该房产的抵押权为该本票提供担保。该抵押权被及时登记。

两年后，该男子无遗嘱死亡，其儿子为其唯一继承人。女子在男子去世后才得知该抵押权的存在。女子和儿子均未对该抵押贷款进行任何还款。因此，银行启动了司法止赎程序，并将儿子和女子都列为该诉讼的当事人。女子和儿子已就该抵押权的可执行性咨询了一名律师。

该司法管辖区遵循抵押权的留置权理论（lien theory of mortgages）。

关于该抵押权，律师可能会怎么说？
options:
A. The mortgage is enforceable against the son and the woman, because the mortgage encumbered the entire property.
该抵押权对儿子和女子均可执行，因为该抵押权负担了整个房产。

B. The mortgage is enforceable against the son only, because he is the man's sole heir.
该抵押权仅对儿子可执行，因为他是该男子的唯一继承人。

C. The mortgage is enforceable against the woman only, because she is the surviving joint tenant.
该抵押权仅对女子可执行，因为她是尚存的共同共有人。

D. The mortgage is not enforceable against the son or the woman, because the mortgage expired upon the man's death.
该抵押权对儿子或女子均不可执行，因为该抵押权在男子死亡时即告失效。
data.explanation:
The man and the woman owned the property as joint tenants with the right of survivorship. A joint tenant may only grant a mortgage on his/her own joint-tenancy interest without the other joint tenant's consent. Therefore, a mortgage executed by one joint tenant will only attach to that tenant's property interest. But whether the joint tenancy remains intact depends on the jurisdiction:
  • Lien theory (majority rule) - a mortgage is merely a lien on the property, which means that granting a mortgage does not sever the joint tenancy, but a severance will occur upon a foreclosure sale following a default
  • Title theory (minority rule) - a mortgage constitutes a transfer of title, which means that granting a mortgage does sever the joint tenancy and the mortgagor-tenant becomes tenants in common with the other joint tenants


Here, the man mortgaged the property without the woman's consent, so the mortgage only encumbered the man's joint-tenancy interest - not the entire property (Choice A). And since this jurisdiction follows the lien theory of mortgages, the joint tenancy between the man and the woman was not severed when the man mortgaged his joint-tenancy interest. Instead, the joint tenancy remained intact until the man's death.

When a joint tenant dies, that tenant's interest disappears and the remaining joint tenant's interest automatically expands to absorb it due to the right of survivorship. This means that any mortgage attached to a joint tenant's interest also disappears when that tenant dies and cannot be enforced against the deceased tenant's heirs or the surviving tenant (the son and the woman, respectively) (Choices B & C). Therefore, the mortgage on the man's tenancy expired upon his death, leaving the bank with no interest in the property on which to foreclose.

Educational objective: A joint tenant may only grant a mortgage on his/her joint-tenancy interest without the other joint tenant's consent. In a lien-theory jurisdiction (majority rule), granting a mortgage does not sever the joint tenancy. But in a title-theory jurisdiction (minority rule), granting a mortgage does sever the joint tenancy.



选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 15%，C选项 38%，D选项 39%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

该男子和女子以享有生存者权的共同共有关系（joint tenants with the right of survivorship）共同拥有该房产。一名共同共有人只能在未经其他共同共有人同意的情况下，就其自己的共同共有权益设定抵押权。因此，由一名共同共有人设定的抵押权仅附着于该共有人的财产权益上。但该共同共有关系是否保持完整取决于司法管辖区的规定：
  • 留置权理论（Lien theory）（多数派规则）——抵押权仅是财产上的留置权，这意味着设定抵押权并不分割共同共有关系，但若发生违约并进行止赎出售，则会导致分割。
  • 所有权理论（Title theory）（少数派规则）——抵押权构成所有权的转让，这意味着设定抵押权确实会分割共同共有关系，而抵押人-共有人与其他共同共有人成为分权共有人（tenants in common）。


在本案中，该男子未经女子同意便抵押了该房产，因此抵押权仅负担了该男子的共同共有权益——而非整个房产（选项A）。并且由于该司法管辖区遵循抵押权的留置权理论，当该男子抵押其共同共有权益时，他与女子之间的共同共有关系并未被分割。相反，该共同共有关系一直保持完整，直到该男子去世。

当一名共同共有人死亡时，由于生存者权的存在，该共有人的权益即告消失，而尚存的共同共有人的权益会自动扩大以吸收该权益。这意味着附着于共同共有人权益上的任何抵押权，在该共有人死亡时也随之消失，并且不能对已故共有人的继承人或尚存的共有人（分别为儿子和女子）强制执行（选项B和C）。因此，设定在该男子共有权上的抵押权在其死亡时即告失效，导致银行在该房产上已没有任何可以进行止赎的权益。

教学目标：一名共同共有人只能在未经其他共同共有人同意的情况下，就其自身的共同共有权益设定抵押权。在一个遵循留置权理论（多数派规则）的司法管辖区，设定抵押权不会分割共同共有关系。但在一个遵循所有权理论（少数派规则）的司法管辖区，设定抵押权确实会分割共同共有关系。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 4.1 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (explaining the lien theory of mortgages).

20 Am. Jur. 2d Cotenancy and Joint Ownership § 93 (2018) (discussing a joint tenant's ability to bind other tenants).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Joint Tenancy & Mortgages

正确答案 选项 D

抵押权对儿子或女子均不可执行，因为该抵押权在男子死亡时即告失效。

核心考点逻辑链
1
留置权理论 (Lien Theory)：
在该理论下，抵押权被视为一种担保权益（Lien），而非所有权的转移。因此，共同共有人之一单方面设定抵押，不会切断 (Sever) 共同共有关系 (Joint Tenancy)。
2
生存者权 (Right of Survivorship)：
由于共同共有关系未被切断，当男子死亡时，生存者权生效。女子的权益自动扩大至整个房产。
3
权益消失原则：
男子的权益在死亡瞬间“消失”了（被女子吸收）。由于抵押权仅附着在男子的权益上，当该权益消失时，抵押权也随之消灭。
关键区分：Lien vs. Title Theory

这是本题的解题关键，MBE常考这两种理论的区别：

Lien Theory
(本题情况)
  • 抵押 = 留置权
  • 不切断 Joint Tenancy
  • 死亡时：抵押权随死者权益消失
  • 幸存者获得无负担房产
Title Theory
(对比情况)
  • 抵押 = 转让所有权
  • 切断 Joint Tenancy
  • 变为按份共有 (TIC)
  • 死亡时：抵押权保留，儿子继承份额及债务
排除错误选项
  • 选项 A (对两人均有效)： 错误。女子从未签署本票或抵押合同，男子的单方行为不能负担女子的权益。
  • 选项 B (对儿子有效)： 错误。由于是 Joint Tenancy，男子死后房产直接归女子，儿子作为继承人 (Heir) 什么都分不到，自然也不存在“抵押权在儿子继承的房产上执行”的情况。
  • 选项 C (对女子有效)： 错误。女子虽然得到了房产，但她是基于“生存者权”获得的，这被视为她原本权益的延续和扩大，而不是从男子那里“继承”来的。因此，她取得的房产不附带男子单方设定的债务（除非是 Title Theory 导致关系破裂）。
💡 MBE 抢分技巧 在遇到 Joint Tenancy 和 Mortgage 的题目时，按以下步骤思考：
  1. 看题目是否指明 Lien Theory 还是 Title Theory。
  2. 如果是 Lien Theory（多数州规则）：Mortgage 不切断共有关系 → 死后抵押权消失 → 幸存者赢 (Winner)。
  3. 如果是 Title Theory（少数州规则）：Mortgage 切断共有关系 → 变为 Tenancy in Common → 死后抵押权保留 → 银行赢。

questions.question:
The owner of a tract of land executed a deed purporting to convey the land "to my brother for life, then to my nephew in fee simple." The brother began to manage the land, which is valuable income-producing real estate. The brother collected all rents and paid all expenses, including real estate taxes. The nephew did not object, and this state of affairs continued until the brother executed a deed purporting to convey the land to his girlfriend five years later. The nephew asserted his right to ownership of the land. The girlfriend also asserted her ownership and said that if the nephew had any rights, he was obligated to pay real estate taxes even though the brother had paid them in the past. Income from the land is ample to cover expenses, including real estate taxes.
In an appropriate action to determine the rights of the parties, what should the court decide?

choices.a: The brother's purported deed forfeited his life estate, so the nephew owns the land in fee simple.
choices.b: The girlfriend owns an estate for her life, is entitled to all income, and must pay real estate taxes; the nephew owns the remainder interest.
choices.c: The girlfriend owns an estate for the life of the brother and is entitled to all income; the nephew owns the remainder interest and must pay real estate taxes.
choices.d: The girlfriend owns an estate for the life of the brother, is entitled to all income, and must pay real estate taxes; the nephew owns the remainder interest.

data.questionStem:
Q86057

The owner of a tract of land executed a deed purporting to convey the land "to my brother for life, then to my nephew in fee simple." The brother began to manage the land, which is valuable income-producing real estate. The brother collected all rents and paid all expenses, including real estate taxes. The nephew did not object, and this state of affairs continued until the brother executed a deed purporting to convey the land to his girlfriend five years later. The nephew asserted his right to ownership of the land. The girlfriend also asserted her ownership and said that if the nephew had any rights, he was obligated to pay real estate taxes even though the brother had paid them in the past. Income from the land is ample to cover expenses, including real estate taxes.

In an appropriate action to determine the rights of the parties, what should the court decide?

一块土地的所有人签署了一份契据，意图将该土地转让给“我的兄弟终身持有，然后由我的侄子获得完全所有权”。该兄弟开始管理这块土地，这是一处有价值的、能产生收入的房产。该兄弟收取了所有租金并支付了所有费用，包括房产税。侄子未曾表示反对，这种情况持续了五年，直到该兄弟签署了一份契据，意图将土地转让给他的女友。侄子主张其对该土地的所有权。女友也主张其所有权，并声称如果侄子享有任何权利，他就有义务支付房产税，尽管过去是由兄弟支付的。该土地的收入足以支付包括房产税在内的各项费用。

在一项旨在确定各方当事人权利的适当诉讼中，法院应如何判决？
options:
A. The brother's purported deed forfeited his life estate, so the nephew owns the land in fee simple.
该兄弟意图转让的契据使其丧失了其终身地产权，因此侄子拥有该土地的完全所有权。

B. The girlfriend owns an estate for her life, is entitled to all income, and must pay real estate taxes; the nephew owns the remainder interest.
女友拥有以其本人生命为期的地产权，有权获得所有收入，且必须支付房产税；侄子拥有剩余权益。

C. The girlfriend owns an estate for the life of the brother and is entitled to all income; the nephew owns the remainder interest and must pay real estate taxes.
女友拥有以兄弟生命为期的地产权，并有权获得所有收入；侄子拥有剩余权益，且必须支付房产税。

D. The girlfriend owns an estate for the life of the brother, is entitled to all income, and must pay real estate taxes; the nephew owns the remainder interest.
女友拥有以兄弟生命为期的地产权，有权获得所有收入，且必须支付房产税；侄子拥有剩余权益。
data.explanation:
A life estate is a present possessory interest that terminates on the death of an individual. A life estate is freely transferable but becomes a life estate pur autre vie since it is measured by the life of someone other than the current life tenant. The future interest that follows a life estate is either a reversion (if held by the grantor) or a remainder (if created in a grantee). It will become a possessory interest when the life estate terminates.

Here, the owner conveyed a life estate to the brother ("to my brother for life") and the nephew received a remainder in fee simple ("then to my nephew") (Choice A). The brother then conveyed his present possessory interest to the girlfriend, who received a life estate pur autre vie measured by the brother's life (Choice B).

As the current life tenant, the girlfriend has a right to all income received from the property. But she also has a duty to pay current charges that become due during the tenancy - including real estate taxes. As a result, the court should decide the rights of the parties accordingly (Choice C).

Educational objective: A life estate is a freely transferable present interest in land that terminates on the death of an individual and is followed by a reversionary or remainder interest. The life tenant is entitled to all income received from the land but must pay current charges on the land (eg, real estate taxes).



选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 4%，C选项 12%，D选项 80%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

终身地产权 (life estate) 是一种现时占有权益 (present possessory interest)，在某一个人死亡时终止。终身地产权可自由转让，但转让后即成为一种为他人之身的终身地产权 (life estate pur autre vie)，因其存续期间是以非现时终身地产权持有人的他人之生命来衡量的。紧随终身地产权的未来权益 (future interest)，若由授予人 (grantor) 持有，则为复归权 (reversion)；若为受让人 (grantee) 创设，则为剩余权 (remainder)。当终身地产权终止时，它将成为一种占有性权益。

在本案中，所有人将一份终身地产权授予了兄弟（“给我的兄弟终身持有”），而侄子获得了一份完全所有权 (fee simple) 的剩余权（“然后由我的侄子获得”）(选项A)。兄弟随后将其现时占有权益转让给女友，女友获得了一个以兄弟生命为期的为他人之身的终身地产权 (life estate pur autre vie) (选项B)。

作为现时的终身地产权持有人 (life tenant)，女友有权获得该房产产生的所有收入。但她亦有义务支付保有期间到期的当期费用——包括房产税。因此，法院应据此对当事人的权利作出相应判决(选项D)。

教学目标：终身地产权 (life estate) 是一种可自由转让的土地现时权益，它在某一个人死亡时终止，其后跟随的是复归权益 (reversionary interest) 或剩余权益 (remainder interest)。终身地产权持有人 (life tenant) 有权获得土地产生的所有收入，但必须支付土地的当期费用（例如，房产税）。

References

Restatement of Property §§ 129 - 130 (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (duty to pay current charges).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：终身地产权与义务

正确答案：D

本题考查的是不动产法中关于终身地产权 (Life Estate) 的转让性及其附随义务。

原始授予 (Original Grant)
兄弟 (Brother) 获得终身地产权
↓
转让 (Conveyance)
兄弟将土地转让给女友 (Girlfriend)
↓
当前状态 (Current Status)
女友持有 "为他人之身的终身地产权"
(Life Estate Pur Autre Vie)

核心法律规则解析

1. 终身地产权的转让性 (Alienability)
终身地产权是一种可自由转让的财产权益。终身地产权人 (Life Tenant) 可以出售、赠与或抵押其权益。
  • 关键点：转让不会导致权益没收 (Forfeiture)。因此，选项 A 错误。
  • 期限限制：转让人只能转让其拥有的权益。既然兄弟的权益是以他自己的生命为期限，他转让给女友的权益也必须以兄弟的生命为期限，而不是女友的生命。
  • 这被称为 Life Estate Pur Autre Vie（为他人之身的终身地产权）。因此，选项 B 错误。
2. 房产税的支付义务 (Duty to Pay Taxes)
根据废置原则 (Doctrine of Waste)，终身地产权人有义务维护房产，不损害剩余权益人 (Remainderman) 的利益。
  • 规则：终身地产权人必须支付房产的所有当期费用 (Current Charges)，如房产税 (Real Estate Taxes) 和抵押贷款的利息。
  • 限额：支付义务的上限是该土地产生的收入 (Income)；如果终身地产权人自己居住，则上限为公平租金价值 (Fair Rental Value)。
  • 本案应用：题目明确指出“土地收入足以支付费用”。因此，作为当前的占有人和收益人，女友必须支付房产税。因此，选项 C 错误。

逻辑推演总结

  1. 权益归属：女友拥有现在的占有权，但期限取决于兄弟还活多久。侄子拥有剩余权益 (Remainder)，在兄弟去世后生效。
  2. 收益归属：作为现时权益持有人，女友有权获得所有租金收入。
  3. 负担归属：权利与义务对等。既然女友享受了收入，她就必须用这笔收入支付房产税。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 在处理不动产题目时，遵循以下步骤：
1. 识别权益 (Identify the Estate)： 谁持有现时权益？谁持有未来权益？
2. 确定期限 (Measure the Duration)： 权益何时终止？（本题中，女友的权益随兄弟死亡而终止）。
3. 分配义务 (Allocate Duties)： 记住 "Life Tenant pays interest and taxes; Remainderman pays principal"（终身权益人付利息和税；剩余权益人付本金）。

questions.question:
By warranty deed, a woman conveyed her property to her two closest friends "as joint tenants with right of survivorship." The two friends are not related. The first friend conveyed all her interest to her son by warranty deed and subsequently died intestate. Thereafter, the second friend conveyed all her interest to her husband by warranty deed. There is no applicable statute, and the jurisdiction recognizes the common law joint tenancy.
Who owns title to the property?

choices.a: The husband.
choices.b: The husband and the heirs of the first friend.
choices.c: The husband and the son.
choices.d: The woman.

data.questionStem:
Q86076

By warranty deed, a woman conveyed her property to her two closest friends "as joint tenants with right of survivorship." The two friends are not related. The first friend conveyed all her interest to her son by warranty deed and subsequently died intestate. Thereafter, the second friend conveyed all her interest to her husband by warranty deed. There is no applicable statute, and the jurisdiction recognizes the common law joint tenancy.

Who owns title to the property?

一名女性通过瑕疵担保契约，将其财产转让给她的两个最亲密的朋友，“作为享有遗属权的共同共有人（as joint tenants with right of survivorship）”。这两位朋友没有亲属关系。第一个朋友通过瑕疵担保契约将其全部权益转让给了她的儿子，随后无遗嘱死亡。此后，第二个朋友通过瑕疵担保契约将其全部权益转让给了她的丈夫。本案无适用的成文法，且该司法管辖区承认普通法下的共同共有（common law joint tenancy）。

谁拥有该财产的所有权？
options:
A. The husband.
丈夫。

B. The husband and the heirs of the first friend.
丈夫和第一个朋友的继承人。

C. The husband and the son.
丈夫和儿子。

D. The woman.
该女性。
data.explanation:
Concurrent estates

(property shared by two or more persons)
TypeAttributesTransferability
Tenancy in common
  • Separate & possibly unequal shares of property
  • Equal right to possess entire property
  • No right of survivorship
  • Alienable during life
  • Devisable
  • Inheritable
Joint tenancy
  • Undivided & equal shares of property
  • Equal right to possess entire property
  • Right of survivorship
Alienable during life (but severs tenancy)
Tenancy by entiretyJoint tenancy between married personsAlienable with spouse's consent
A joint tenancy is a type of concurrent estate in which each co-tenant has an undivided and equal interest in the property with the right of survivorship. A lifetime transfer of a joint tenant's interest severs that interest from the joint tenancy relationship, and it becomes a tenancy-in- common ownership interest.

Here, the two friends owned the property as joint tenants with the right of survivorship. The first friend conveyed her property interest to her son during her lifetime. This converted the joint tenancy into a tenancy in common between the son and the second friend. The second friend then conveyed her property interest (tenancy in common) to her husband. Therefore, the husband and the son own title as tenants in common (Choices A & D).

(Choice B) Since the first friend conveyed her property interest to her son, her heirs had no property interest to inherit upon her death. But even if that conveyance had not been made (ie, had the joint tenancy continued), the first friend's property interest would have gone to the second friend - the surviving co-tenant. And the second friend's subsequent conveyance to her husband would have given him exclusive ownership of the property.

Educational objective: A lifetime transfer of a joint tenant's interest severs that interest from the joint tenancy relationship, and it becomes a tenancy-in-common ownership interest.

选项正确率统计：A选项 21%，B选项 2%，C选项 74%（正确选项），D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

共同财产

(两人或多人共有的财产)
类型属性可转让性
按份共有 (Tenancy in common)
  • 独立且可能不均等的财产份额
  • 平等占有全部财产的权利
  • 无遗属权
  • 生前可转让
  • 可通过遗嘱处分
  • 可继承
共同共有 (Joint tenancy)
  • 不可分割且均等的财产份额
  • 平等占有全部财产的权利
  • 有遗属权
生前可转让（但会切断共有关系）
夫妻一体共有 (Tenancy by entirety)已婚人士之间的共同共有经配偶同意后可转让
共同共有 (Joint tenancy) 是一种共同财产形式，其中每个共有人对财产拥有不可分割的、平等的权益，并享有遗属权 (right of survivorship)。共同共有人在生前转让其权益的行为会切断该权益与共同共有的关系，使其转变为按份共有的所有权权益。

在本案中，这两个朋友作为享有遗属权的共同共有人拥有该财产。第一个朋友在生前将其财产权益转让给了她的儿子。此行为将共同共有转变为儿子与第二个朋友之间的按份共有。随后，第二个朋友将其财产权益（按份共有）转让给了她的丈夫。因此，丈夫和儿子作为按份共有人拥有所有权（选项 A & D）。

（选项 B）由于第一个朋友已将其财产权益转让给儿子，她的继承人在她去世时没有可继承的财产权益。但即使没有进行该转让（即，如果共同共有关系继续存在），第一个朋友的财产权益也将归于第二个朋友——即在世的共有人。而第二个朋友随后向其丈夫的转让将使丈夫获得该财产的独有所有权。

教学目标：共同共有人在生前转让其权益的行为会切断该权益与共同共有的关系，并使其转变为按份共有的所有权权益。

References

20 Am. Jur. 2d Cotenancy and Joint Ownership § 22 (2018) (severance of joint tenancy).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Concurrent Estates

核心考点：共有关系的切断 (Severance) 在普通法下，共同共有 (Joint Tenancy) 的核心特征是遗属权 (Right of Survivorship)。

但是，如果任何一方在生前转让 (Inter Vivos Conveyance) 其权益，该转让会破坏“四大统一” (Four Unities)，从而切断共同共有关系，使其转变为按份共有 (Tenancy in Common)。

案情法律状态推演

初始状态
女性将房产转让给朋友1 (F1) 和朋友2 (F2)。
Joint Tenancy (共同共有)
关键转折：F1 转让给儿子
F1 通过契约将权益转给儿子。
法律后果：切断 (Severance)
F1 的转让破坏了共有关系。此时，儿子与 F2 成为按份共有人。
Tenancy in Common (按份共有)
F1 去世
F1 去世。
由于 F1 生前已经卖掉了权益，且共有关系已切断，遗属权不再适用。F1 的继承人无权继承该房产。
F2 转让给丈夫
F2 将其持有的 50% 按份共有权益转让给丈夫。
丈夫获得 F2 的份额。
最终状态：丈夫 + 儿子 (TIC)

深度解析

本题考察的是生前转让对共同共有的影响。

1. 为什么不是选项 B (丈夫和 F1 的继承人)?
这是最大的干扰项。如果 F1 没有在生前转让给儿子，那么在她死后，根据遗属权，F2 会自动获得全部所有权。但因为 F1 生前已经转让 (Inter Vivos Conveyance)，她死时手里已经没有该房产的权益了，所以她的继承人什么也得不到。

2. 为什么不是选项 A (仅丈夫)?
这需要假设 F2 拥有遗属权并获得了 F1 的份额。但如前所述，F1 的转让行为已经将 Joint Tenancy 降级为 Tenancy in Common，消灭了遗属权。因此 F2 只有自己原本的那一半，无法获得 F1 的那一半。

3. 结论逻辑：
儿子通过购买获得了 F1 的 50% (Tenancy in Common)。
丈夫通过购买获得了 F2 的 50% (Tenancy in Common)。
两人互不相关，各自持有独立份额。

正确答案：C (丈夫和儿子)

An organic farm was conveyed to a married couple by a deed that created a cotenancy in equal shares with the right of survivorship.
The husband later informed the wife that he intended to convey his "undivided one-half interest in the farm" to his sister. The wife objected to the conveyance, but the husband nevertheless conveyed his interest in the farm to the sister by deed. The husband has since died.
In an action between the sister and the wife to determine title to the farm, who will prevail?

choices.a: The sister, because the husband and the wife had a tenancy in common.
choices.b: The sister, because the wife knew of the conveyance prior to the husband's death.

questions.question:
An individual owned land in fee simple. She executed a will, which devised the land "to my husband for life, and then to my daughter, but if my grandson graduates from college, to my grandson." At the time of the individual's death, her husband, daughter, and grandson are alive, and her grandson is in high school.
What interest in the land does the individual's grandson have?

choices.a: Contingent remainder.
choices.b: Power of termination.
choices.c: Shifting executory interest.
choices.d: Springing executory interest.

data.questionStem:
Q86050

An individual owned land in fee simple. She executed a will, which devised the land "to my husband for life, and then to my daughter, but if my grandson graduates from college, to my grandson." At the time of the individual's death, her husband, daughter, and grandson are alive, and her grandson is in high school.

What interest in the land does the individual's grandson have?

一位个人以完全保有地产权（fee simple）的形式拥有一块土地。她立下遗嘱，将该土地遗赠‘给我的丈夫终身持有，然后给我的女儿，但如果我的孙子大学毕业，则给我的孙子’。在该个人去世时，她的丈夫、女儿和孙子都健在，且孙子正在上高中。

该个人的孙子对这块土地拥有何种权益？
options:
A. Contingent remainder.
或有剩余权（Contingent remainder）。

B. Power of termination.
终止权（Power of termination）。

C. Shifting executory interest.
转移性未来执行权益（Shifting executory interest）。

D. Springing executory interest.
产生性未来执行权益（Springing executory interest）。
data.explanation:
An executory interest is a future interest in a grantee that generally cuts short, or divests, a prior estate upon the happening of a specified condition. There are two types of executory interests:
  • Shifting - divests an estate held by another grantee, such that the estate shifts from one grantee to another (the executory-interest holder)
  • Springing - divests an estate held by a grantor, such that the estate springs from the grantor to the executory-interest holder
Here, the grandson (grantee) has a future interest in the land because he is not entitled to immediate possession. Since his interest will cut short the daughter's (other grantee's) interest in the land if and when he graduates from college, the grandson has a shifting executory interest (Choice C).

(Choice A) A remainder is a future interest created in a grantee that is capable of becoming a present possessory estate upon the natural expiration of a life estate or term of years.† Here, the daughter (not the grandson) has a remainder interest that will become possessory as soon as the husband dies and his life estate naturally ends.

†A remainder can also follow a fee tail, but this estate has been eliminated in most states.

(Choice B) A power of termination (ie, right of entry) is a future interest created in a grantor. It follows a fee simple subject to a condition subsequent and allows the grantor or his/her successor in interest to terminate the estate upon the happening of a specified condition. Here, the future interest in question belongs to the grandson - not the individual (grantor) - so it cannot be a power of termination.

Educational objective: A shifting executory interest divests an estate held by another grantee, such that the estate shifts from one grantee to another (the executory-interest holder). In contrast, a springing executory interest divests an estate held by a grantor, such that the estate springs from the grantor to the executory-interest holder.



选项正确率统计：A选项 26%，B选项 0%，C选项 53%（正确选项），D选项 19%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

未来执行权益（executory interest）是授予给受让人（grantee）的一种未来权益（future interest），通常在特定条件发生时，会缩短或剥夺先前的地产权。未来执行权益有两种类型：
  • 转移性（Shifting） - 剥夺另一位受让人（grantee）持有的地产权，从而使地产权从一位受让人转移（shifts）至另一位（即未来执行权益持有人）
  • 产生性（Springing） - 剥夺让与人（grantor）持有的地产权，从而使地产权从让与人产生（springs）并归于未来执行权益持有人
在本案中，孙子（受让人）对该土地拥有未来权益，因为他无权立即占有。由于当他大学毕业时，他的权益将缩短女儿（另一位受让人）对土地的权益，因此孙子拥有转移性未来执行权益（shifting executory interest）（选项 C）。

（选项 A）剩余权（remainder）是在受让人（grantee）身上创设的一种未来权益，它能够在终身地产权（life estate）或定期地产权（term of years）自然终止时，转变为当前的占有性地产权（present possessory estate）。† 在本案中，女儿（而非孙子）拥有剩余权益（remainder interest），一旦丈夫去世，其终身地产权自然结束，该权益即可成为占有性权益。

†剩余权也可以跟在限定继承地产权（fee tail）之后，但这种地产权在大多数州已被废除。

（选项 B）终止权（power of termination）（即进入权（right of entry））是在让与人（grantor）身上创设的一种未来权益。它跟在附带后决条件的可废止的完全保有地产权（fee simple subject to a condition subsequent）之后，并允许让与人或其权益继承人在特定条件发生时终止该地产权。在本案中，所涉未来权益属于孙子——而非该个人（让与人）——因此不可能是终止权。

教学目标：转移性未来执行权益（shifting executory interest）剥夺另一位受让人（grantee）持有的地产权，从而使地产权从一位受让人转移至另一位（即未来执行权益持有人）。相比之下，产生性未来执行权益（springing executory interest）剥夺让与人（grantor）持有的地产权，从而使地产权从让与人产生并归于未来执行权益持有人。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Future Interests
正确答案：C 转移性未来执行权益
(Shifting Executory Interest)
权益流转图解
丈夫 (Husband)
终身地产权 (Life Estate)
当前占有
↓
女儿 (Daughter)
既定剩余权 (Vested Remainder)
等待丈夫去世
⚡ 触发条件：孙子大学毕业 ⚡
孙子 (Grandson)
转移性未来执行权益
剥夺女儿的权益
深度解析

要判断孙子的权益类型，我们需要回答两个关键问题：

  1. 他是“耐心等待”还是“插队”？
    孙子的权益并不是等待女儿的权益自然结束，而是在特定条件（大学毕业）发生时，强行切断/剥夺 (Divest) 女儿的权益。因此，它不是剩余权 (Remainder)，而是未来执行权益 (Executory Interest)。
  2. 他剥夺的是谁的权益？
    孙子剥夺的是女儿（另一位受让人/Grantee）的权益，而不是原房主（Grantor）的权益。
    • 剥夺受让人 = Shifting (转移性)
    • 剥夺原房主 = Springing (产生性)

结论：因为孙子的权益是从另一位受让人（女儿）那里“转移”过来的，所以是 Shifting Executory Interest。

为什么其他选项是错的？
A. 剩余权 (Remainder) 剩余权必须耐心等待前一个地产权自然结束（如终身地产权结束）。它不能“切断”先前的权益。本题中孙子会切断女儿的权益，所以不是剩余权。
D. 产生性 (Springing) Springing 发生在权益从原房主 (Grantor) 手中跳出来的时候。例如：“给A，如果A结婚”。在A结婚前，权益保留在房主手中。本题中权益已在女儿手中，所以不是 Springing。
* 选项 B (Power of Termination) 仅属于原房主 (Grantor)，不属于第三方。
💡 MBE 快速解题技巧

在做 Future Interests 题目时，记住这个拟人化口诀：

  • Remainder (剩余权) 是“有礼貌的”：它总是耐心等待前一个人死掉或租期结束，绝不插队。
  • Executory Interest (未来执行权益) 是“粗鲁的”：它像刽子手，一旦条件满足，直接砍断前一个人的权益并取而代之。

看到“But if” (但是如果...) 这种转折词，通常暗示着“粗鲁的”未来执行权益。

questions.question:
A tenant leased retail space in a strip mall for a two-year term. The written lease specifically prohibits the assignment of the premises without the permission of the landlord. As a favor to a friend, the tenant, without seeking the landlord's consent, told his friend that she could use a closet in the back room to store her belongings for as long as the tenant leases the space.
Has the tenant violated the terms of his lease?

choices.a: No, because the friend's interest is merely a license.
choices.b: No, because the tenant's promise does not extend to the use of the entire leased premises.
choices.c: Yes, because the prohibition against assignment is an enforceable restraint on alienation.
choices.d: Yes, because the tenant's promise extends for the entire term of the lease.

questions.question:
A landlord leased an apartment to a tenant by written lease for two years ending on the last day of a recent month. The lease provided for $700 in monthly rent. The tenant occupied the apartment and paid the rent for the first 15 months of the lease term, until he moved to another city to take a new job. Without consulting the landlord, the tenant moved a friend into the apartment and signed an informal writing transferring to the friend his "lease rights" for the remaining nine months of the lease. The friend made the next four monthly $700 rent payments to the landlord. For the final five months of the lease term, no rent was paid by anyone, and the friend moved out with three months left of the lease term. The landlord was on an extended trip abroad, and did not learn of the default and the vacancy until the end of the lease term.
The landlord has sued the tenant and the friend, jointly and severally, for $3,500 for the last five months' rent.
What is the likely outcome of the lawsuit?

choices.a: Both the tenant and the friend are liable for the full $3,500, because the tenant is liable based on privity of contract and the friend is liable based on privity of estate as an assignee.
choices.b: The friend is liable for $1,400 based on privity of estate, which lasted only until he vacated, and the tenant is liable for $2,100 based on privity of contract and estate for the period after the friend vacated.
choices.c: The tenant is liable for $3,500 based on privity of contract, and the friend is not liable, because a sublessee does not have personal liability to the original landlord.
choices.d: The friend is liable for $3,500 based on privity of estate, and the tenant is not liable, because the landlord's failure to object to the friend's payment of rent relieved the tenant of liability.

一位房东通过书面租赁合同将一套公寓出租给一位租户，租期为两年，于最近某个月的最后一天到期。租赁合同规定月租金为700美元。租户居住了该公寓并支付了租期前15个月的租金，之后他搬到另一个城市接受了一份新工作。未经与房东商议，租户让一位朋友搬入该公寓，并签署了一份非正式书面文件，将其剩余九个月租期的“租赁权”转让给该朋友。该朋友向房东支付了接下来四个月每月700美元的租金。在租期的最后五个月里，无人支付租金，且该朋友在租期还剩三个月时搬离了公寓。房东当时正在国外进行长期旅行，直到租期结束时才得知违约和房屋空置的情况。

房东已对租户和该朋友提起连带责任诉讼，要求赔偿最后五个月的租金，共计3500美元。

该诉讼的可能结果是什么？
options:
A. Both the tenant and the friend are liable for the full $3,500, because the tenant is liable based on privity of contract and the friend is liable based on privity of estate as an assignee.
租户和该朋友均需对全部3500美元承担责任，因为租户基于合同之债（privity of contract）承担责任，而该朋友作为受让人（assignee）基于地产之债（privity of estate）承担责任。

B. The friend is liable for $1,400 based on privity of estate, which lasted only until he vacated, and the tenant is liable for $2,100 based on privity of contract and estate for the period after the friend vacated.
该朋友基于地产之债（privity of estate）承担1400美元的责任，该责任仅持续到他搬离为止；租户则基于合同之债和地产之债，对该朋友搬离后的期间承担2100美元的责任。

C. The tenant is liable for $3,500 based on privity of contract, and the friend is not liable, because a sublessee does not have personal liability to the original landlord.
租户基于合同之债（privity of contract）承担3500美元的责任，而该朋友不承担责任，因为分租人（sublessee）对原房东不承担个人责任。

D. The friend is liable for $3,500 based on privity of estate, and the tenant is not liable, because the landlord's failure to object to the friend's payment of rent relieved the tenant of liability.
该朋友基于地产之债（privity of estate）承担3500美元的责任，而租户不承担责任，因为房东未能对该朋友支付租金的行为提出异议，从而免除了租户的责任。
data.explanation:
A landlord and tenant have a legal relationship based on both:

  • privity of contract - their shared interest in the lease agreement and
  • privity of estate - their successive right to possess the property (ie, the tenant's current right of possession is immediately followed by the landlord's future right of possession).


Unless the lease states otherwise, either party can freely transfer his/her interest under the lease. Assignment is a complete transfer of a tenant's interest to a third party (assignee) for the remainder of the tenant's lease term (as seen here), so:

  • the original tenant retains privity of contract due to the lease and
  • the assignee gains privity of estate since the landlord's right of possession now follows the assignee's.


Because of this privity, the original tenant and the assignee are jointly and severally liable for the landlord's entire harm arising from a breach of the lease (eg, failure to pay rent). Therefore, the tenant and the friend are liable for the landlord's entire harm ($3,500).

(Choice B) The friend's privity of estate did not terminate when he vacated the property - it lasted until the end of the lease term since that was the friend's assigned interest. And though the tenant lacked privity of estate, he retained privity of contract with the landlord - even after the friend vacated. Therefore, both are liable for the full $3,500.

(Choice C) A sublease is a partial transfer of a tenant's interest to a third party (sublessee) for less than the remainder of the lease term. A sublessee is not personally liable to the landlord since (1) no lease agreement exists between them (no privity of contract) and (2) the tenant will regain possession before the landlord (no privity of estate). But since the friend was an assignee, he is jointly and severally liable to the landlord.

(Choice D) A tenant is relieved of liability following assignment when the landlord expressly releases the tenant from the lease (eg, letter stating that tenant has no lease obligations). An implied release (eg, the landlord's failure to object to the friend's payment of rent) is insufficient.

Educational objective: Assignment is a transfer of a tenant's entire interest to a third party (assignee) for the remainder of the lease term. The tenant (through privity of contract) and the assignee (through privity of estate) are jointly and severally liable for the landlord's entire harm arising from a breach of the lease.







选项正确率统计：A选项 62%（正确选项），B选项 4%，C选项 25%，D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

房东和租户之间的法律关系基于以下两点：

  • 合同之债（privity of contract）- 他们在租赁协议中的共同利益 以及
  • 地产之债（privity of estate）- 他们对财产相继的占有权（即，租户当前的占有权紧随着房东未来的占有权）。


除非租赁合同另有规定，任何一方都可以自由转让其在租赁合同下的权益。转让（Assignment）是指将租户的权益完全转让给第三方（受让人）覆盖租户剩余的全部租期（如本案所示），因此：

  • 原租户因租赁合同而保留合同之债 并且
  • 受让人获得地产之债，因为房东的占有权现在紧随受让人的占有权之后。


基于此种债的关系，原租户和受让人对因违反租赁合同（例如，未能支付租金）而给房东造成的全部损失承担连带责任。因此，租户和该朋友均需对房东的全部损失（3500美元）承担责任。

（选项B）该朋友的地产之债并未在他搬离房产时终止——它持续到租期结束，因为这是转让给该朋友的权益。并且，尽管租户在转让后丧失了地产之债，他仍然与房东保留着合同之债——即使在该朋友搬离后也是如此。因此，两者均需对全部3500美元承担责任。

（选项C）分租（sublease）是租户将其部分权益转让给第三方（分租人），且转让期限短于剩余租期。分租人对房东不承担个人责任，因为（1）他们之间不存在租赁协议（没有合同之债），并且（2）在房东收回占有权之前，原租户将重新获得占有权（没有地产之债）。但由于本案中的朋友是受让人，他确实需要对房东承担连带责任。

（选项D）在转让后，如果房东明确解除租户的租赁责任（例如，通过信件声明租户不再有租赁义务），租户的责任才会被免除。默示的责任解除（例如，房东未能对该朋友支付租金的行为提出异议）是不充分的。

教学目标：转让（Assignment）是指将租户的全部权益转让给第三方（受让人），覆盖剩余的全部租期。租户（通过合同之债）和受让人（通过地产之债）对因违反租赁合同而给房东造成的全部损失承担连带责任。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Property: Landlord & Tenant § 15.1 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (right to transfer lease interest).
  • Restatement (Second) of Property: Landlord & Tenant § 16.1 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (joint and several liability based on privity of contract and privity of estate).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Landlord & Tenant

不动产法：房东与租户

核心考点：转让 vs. 分租

本题的关键在于判断租户（Tenant）将房屋交给朋友（Friend）的行为在法律上属于哪种性质。这决定了各方的责任归属。

转让 (Assignment)
租户转让了其在租赁合同下的全部剩余权益（Entire remaining interest）。
分租 (Sublease)
租户只转让了部分权益（Less than the entire interest），即保留了部分租期或收回权。

本题判定：租户转让了剩余的全部九个月（remaining nine months），因此这是Assignment。

责任分析：Privity (债/关系)

在 Assignment 的情况下，责任基于两种法律关系：

1. 合同之债 (Privity of Contract)
  • 存在于原房东与原租户之间。
  • 除非房东明确释放（Novation），否则原租户永远对租金负责。
  • 结论：租户 (Tenant) 需承担责任。
2. 地产之债 (Privity of Estate)
  • 存在于原房东与当前占有人（受让人）之间。
  • 因为是 Assignment，受让人（Friend）获得了完整的剩余租期，与房东建立了直接的地产关系。
  • 受让人对基于地产的义务（如付租金）负责，直到租期结束或他再次转让给别人。
  • 结论：朋友 (Friend) 需承担责任。

正确答案解析 (Option A)

由于存在上述两种关系：

房东
(Landlord)
⚡
租户
(Contract)
房东
(Landlord)
⚡
朋友
(Estate)

房东可以起诉任何一方或双方来追讨全部租金（Joint and Several Liability，连带责任）。

因此，选项 A 正确：租户基于合同责任，朋友基于地产责任，两者均需对全部 $3,500 负责。

易错项辨析

选项 B 错误 (关于朋友的责任范围)
虽然朋友提前搬走了，但在 Assignment 中，他拥有的是剩余的整个租期。除非他将房子再转让给别人，否则他的 Privity of Estate 持续到租期结束。仅仅搬出（Abandonment）并不终止他对房东的地产之债。
选项 C 错误 (误判为 Sublease)
如果是 Sublease，分租人（Sublessee）确实对原房东没有个人责任（既无合同也无地产关系）。但本题是 Assignment，受让人有直接责任。
选项 D 错误 (关于租户的免责)
房东接受朋友的租金并不代表房东放弃了对原租户的追索权。要免除原租户的责任，必须有明确的债务更替 (Novation) 或免责声明。

🎓 MBE 抢分技巧

在看到租户把房子给别人的题目时，按以下步骤思考：

  1. 看时间：转让的是剩余的全部时间吗？
    • 是 ➔ Assignment (受让人对房东负责)。
    • 否 ➔ Sublease (分租人只对原租户负责，对房东不负责)。
  2. 看原租户：房东有没有签过字说 "I release Tenant from liability"？
    • 没有 ➔ 原租户永远基于 Privity of Contract 负责。

questions.question:
A landlord owns a building that contains six living units. The landlord lives in one of the units and rents out the other five. When a tenant with a two-year-old child moved out of one of the units, the landlord decided that he would not rent to a tenant with a child under the age of 10. However, when he advertised that the unit was available for rent, he did not include this limitation in the ad and instead indicated that all families were welcome. A couple with a six-year-old child contacted the landlord about renting the unit, and he informed them of his policy regarding children. The couple claimed that the landlord's policy violated the federal Fair Housing Act. Rather than dispute this with the couple, the landlord decided to take the unit off the market and allow it to remain empty for the foreseeable future.
Has the landlord violated the federal Fair Housing Act?

choices.a: No, because he lived in one of the units in the building.
choices.b: No, because he took the unit off the market and has not rented it to anyone.
choices.c: Yes, because he discriminated against the couple based on familial status.
choices.d: Yes, because his advertisement falsely represented his policy regarding children.

一位房东拥有一栋包含六个居住单元的建筑。房东自己居住在其中一个单元，并将其余五个单元出租。当一个带有名两岁小孩的租户搬出其中一个单元后，房东决定他将不再向有10岁以下小孩的租户出租该单元。然而，当他刊登广告表示该单元可供出租时，他并未在广告中包含此限制，反而表示欢迎所有家庭。一对带有名六岁小孩的夫妇联系房东洽谈租用该单元事宜，房东告知了他们其关于儿童的政策。这对夫妇声称房东的政策违反了联邦《Fair Housing Act》。房东没有与这对夫妇争论，而是决定将该单元撤出市场，并在可预见的未来内保持空置。

该房东是否违反了联邦《Fair Housing Act》？
options:
A. No, because he lived in one of the units in the building.
否，因为他居住在该建筑的一个单元中。

B. No, because he took the unit off the market and has not rented it to anyone.
否，因为他将该单元撤出市场，并且没有将其出租给任何人。

C. Yes, because he discriminated against the couple based on familial status.
是，因为他基于家庭状况歧视了这对夫妇。

D. Yes, because his advertisement falsely represented his policy regarding children.
是，因为他的广告虚假陈述了其关于儿童的政策。
data.explanation:
Fair Housing Act


ApplicabilityExceptions
Prohibits discriminatory actions in sale/renting of dwelling based on race, color, religion, sex, handicap, national origin, or familial status - including:
  • refusing bona fide offer
  • discriminating in terms, conditions, privileges, or services of purchase/rental
  • advertising preference for or discrimination against buyer/renter
  • falsely representing dwelling's availability for inspection, sale, or rental
  • inducing sale/renting with discriminatory representations about neighborhood
  • denying reasonable modifications to accommodate handicap at occupant's expense
Act does not apply to:
  • religious organizations
  • private clubs that incidentally provide lodging to members
  • familial status for senior housing
  • owner of ≤ 3 single-family dwellings
  • owner-occupied dwellings with ≤ 4 units
  • sale/rental of single-family home by private owner
*These exceptions do not apply to discriminatory advertisements or when owner is assisted by a real estate agent, broker, or salesman.

The Fair Housing Act (FHA) prohibits discrimination in the sale or rental of housing on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, disability, or familial status. Protected familial status includes having children under the age of 18 and being pregnant. Prohibited discrimination can take various forms (see above table), such as refusing to rent or sell housing or making housing unavailable.

Here, the landlord attempted to circumvent the FHA by taking the unit off the market and not renting it to anyone. But since the landlord made the unit unavailable to avoid renting to the couple with the six-year-old child, he discriminated against the couple on the basis of familial status in violation of the FHA (Choice B).

(Choice A) Owner-occupied buildings with no more than four living units (including the owner's unit) are generally exempted from the FHA. Since the landlord's building contains six living units, his occupation of one of the units does not qualify him for this exemption.

(Choice D) Advertising a preference or limitation based on protected characteristics is a violation of the FHA. However, the landlord's failure to advertise that he would not rent to a tenant with a child under the age of 10 is not a violation.

Educational objective: The Fair Housing Act prohibits discrimination in the sale or rental of housing (eg, making housing unavailable) on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, disability, or familial status. Protected familial status includes having children under the age of 18 and being pregnant.

选项正确率统计：A选项 12%，B选项 13%，C选项 68%（正确选项），D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

Fair Housing Act


适用性例外情况
禁止在住宅销售/租赁中基于种族、肤色、宗教、性别、残障、国籍或家庭状况的歧视性行为——包括：
  • 拒绝善意要约
  • 在购买/租赁的条款、条件、特权或服务方面进行歧视
  • 刊登广告偏好或歧视购买者/租赁者
  • 虚假陈述住宅可供视察、出售或租赁
  • 以关于社区的歧视性陈述引诱出售/租赁
  • 拒绝为适应残障人士而进行的合理改造（费用由居住者承担）
法案不适用于：
  • 宗教组织
  • 偶然向其成员提供住宿的私人俱乐部
  • 老年人住房的家庭状况
  • 拥有≤3个独栋住宅的业主
  • 业主自住且单元数≤4的住宅
  • 私人业主出售/租赁独栋住宅
*当业主使用房地产代理人、经纪人或销售人员，或刊登歧视性广告时，这些例外情况不适用。

《Fair Housing Act》 (FHA) 禁止在住房的销售或租赁中基于种族、肤色、宗教、国籍、性别、残障或家庭状况的歧视。受保护的家庭状况包括拥有18岁以下的子女以及怀孕。被禁止的歧视可以有多种形式（见上表），例如拒绝出租或出售住房，或使住房不可得。

在本案中，房东试图通过将该单元撤出市场并不再租给任何人来规避FHA。但由于房东为了避免租给有六岁小孩的夫妇而使该单元不可得，他基于家庭状况歧视了这对夫妇，违反了《Fair Housing Act》（选项B）。

（选项A） 业主自住且不超过四个居住单元（包括业主自住单元）的建筑通常可豁免于FHA。由于该房东的建筑包含六个居住单元，他居住在其中一个单元并不使他符合此项豁免的资格。

（选项D） 刊登广告明示基于受保护特征的偏好或限制是违反FHA的行为。然而，房东未在广告中声明他不会租给有10岁以下小孩的租户，这本身并不构成违法。

教学目标：《Fair Housing Act》禁止在住房销售或租赁中（例如，使住房不可得）基于种族、肤色、宗教、国籍、性别、残障或家庭状况进行歧视。受保护的家庭状况包括拥有18岁以下的子女以及怀孕。

References

Fair Housing Act, 42 U.S.C. §§ 3601 et seq.

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Fair Housing Act
正确答案
选项 C
是，因为他基于家庭状况歧视了这对夫妇。
⚖️ 法律依据 (Legal Rule)

联邦公平住房法 (Fair Housing Act, FHA) 禁止在住房租赁或销售中基于以下受保护特征进行歧视：

  • 种族 (Race)
  • 肤色 (Color)
  • 宗教 (Religion)
  • 性别 (Sex)
  • 国籍 (National Origin)
  • 残障 (Disability/Handicap)
  • 家庭状况 (Familial Status)

家庭状况特别保护拥有18岁以下子女的家庭以及孕妇。

🔍 深度解析 (Analysis)

本题的核心在于判断房东的行为是否受到 FHA 的豁免，以及其行为是否构成歧视。

1. 歧视行为的认定：
房东拒绝向带有10岁以下儿童的租户出租，这直接构成了基于家庭状况 (Familial Status) 的歧视。即使房东后来将房屋“撤出市场”，其动机是为了避免租给受保护群体，这属于 FHA 禁止的“使住房不可得” (making housing unavailable) 的行为。

2. 豁免条款的适用性 (The "Mrs. Murphy" Exemption)：
FHA 对某些房东提供豁免，最常见的是“业主自住豁免”。

豁免条件 本案情况
业主必须居住在该建筑中 (Owner-occupied) ✅ 房东住在其中一个单元
建筑包含的单元数必须 ≤ 4个 ❌ 建筑包含 6个 单元
结论 无豁免权 (No Exemption)

由于该建筑有6个单元，超出了FHA规定的“业主自住且不超过4个单元”的豁免范围，因此房东必须完全遵守 FHA。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误
选项 A (No, because he lived in one of the units...)
错误。虽然房东自住是豁免条件之一，但FHA的这项豁免仅适用于4个或更少单元的建筑。本案中6个单元的规模使房东失去了豁免资格。
选项 B (No, because he took the unit off the market...)
错误。将房屋撤出市场以避免租给受保护阶层，本身就是一种非法的歧视手段（使住房不可得）。如果允许这种抗辩，任何房东都可以通过暂时空置房屋来逃避法律制裁。
选项 D (Yes, because his advertisement...)
错误。虽然 FHA 禁止歧视性广告，但本案中房东的广告是“欢迎所有家庭”，广告本身并未违规。违规的是其实际的拒绝行为和政策。即使广告没有问题，实际操作中的歧视依然违反 FHA。
MBE 考试技巧

遇到 Fair Housing Act 的题目，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 识别受保护群体： 是否涉及种族、家庭状况（小孩）、残障等？
  2. 检查豁免权 (Exemptions)：
    • 是否是宗教组织或私人俱乐部？
    • 是否是"Mrs. Murphy" Exemption（业主自住 + ≤4个单元）？
    • 是否是私人出售独栋房屋（无经纪人）？
  3. 注意广告例外： 即使享有豁免权的房东（如业主自住的小公寓），也绝对禁止发布歧视性广告。

本题陷阱： 考生容易只看到“业主自住”就以为有豁免，而忽略了“6个单元”这一关键数字。

questions.question:
A brother and sister acquired title in fee simple to property, as equal tenants in common, by inheritance from their aunt. During the last 15 years of her lifetime, the aunt allowed the brother to occupy an apartment in the house on the property, to rent the other apartment in the house to various tenants, and to retain the rent. The brother made no payments to the aunt, and since the aunt's death 7 years ago he has made no payments to the sister. For those 22 years, the brother has paid the real estate taxes on the property, kept the building on the property insured, and maintained the building. At all times, the sister has lived in a distant city and has never had anything to do with the aunt, the brother, or the property.
Recently, the sister needed money for the operation of her business and demanded that the brother join her in selling the property. The brother refused.
The period of time to acquire title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 10 years. There is no other applicable statute.
The sister brought an appropriate action against the brother for partition. The brother asserted all available defenses and counterclaims.
How should the court rule on the sister's action for partition?

choices.a: Deny the partition and find that title has vested in the brother by adverse possession.
choices.b: Deny the partition, confirm the tenancy in common, but require an accounting to determine if either the brother or sister is indebted to the other on account of the rental payment, taxes, insurance premiums, and maintenance costs.
choices.c: Grant the partition and require, as an adjustment, an accounting to determine if either the brother or sister is indebted to the other on account of the rental payments, taxes, insurance premiums, and maintenance costs.
choices.d: Grant the partition to the brother and sister as equal owners, but without an accounting.
