MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Cotenancy

💡 核心考点：共同共有人的权限

本题考察的是共同共有 (Tenancy in Common) 中，单个共有人是否有权在未经其他共有人同意的情况下，签署影响共有财产产权的协议（如边界线协议）。

⚖️ 黄金法则 (The Golden Rule) 虽然共同共有人可以自由转让自己的权益，但不能在未经授权的情况下，通过合同约束其他共有人的权益，也不能单方面处分整个共有财产的产权。

✅ 正确答案：C

理由：哥哥会胜诉，因为共同共有人不能用边界线协议约束另一位共有人。

逻辑推演：

  1. 所有权形式：兄妹是 Tenants in Common。这意味着他们各自拥有独立的、不可分割的权益。
  2. 缺乏代理权：法律不默认共有人之间互为代理人。妹妹签署边界协议 (Boundary-line Agreement) 实际上是在放弃一部分共有土地的产权（给邻居）。
  3. 无效力：由于哥哥没有签署该协议，也没有授权妹妹，该协议对他没有约束力。
  4. 结果：哥哥有权要求法院确认真实的原始边界 (Quiet Title)，因为邻居不能依据一份无效力及于哥哥的协议来对抗哥哥的产权主张。

📊 共有人的权限边界

理解 Tenancy in Common 中“能做”与“不能做”的区别是解题关键：

无需同意 (No Consent Needed) 必须同意 (Consent Required)
转让、出售、抵押自己的份额 出售或转让整个共有财产
占有整个财产 (只要不驱逐他人) 排他性地占有部分财产
享有自己份额的收益 签署约束其他共有人的合同 (如本题的边界协议)

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (关于互利)：
虽然如果合同对所有共有人“互利”，法律有时会推定共有人追认 (Ratification) 了该合同。但这种推定是可以被反驳的。本案中，哥哥明确否认 (Repudiated) 了协议，因此推定不成立。

选项 B (关于占有)：
虽然妹妹当时是唯一占有人 (Sole Possession)，但这仅赋予她使用权，并不赋予她处分缺席共有人产权的权力。占有不等于拥有完全的处分代理权。

选项 D (关于银行)：
这是一个干扰项。银行作为抵押权人 (Mortgagee) 是否参与协议，影响的是银行的担保权益，而不影响兄妹之间的产权关系。哥哥胜诉的理由是他自己的权益未被有效约束，而不是因为银行没签字。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 财产法题目中，看到 "One co-tenant" 做某事（签合同、给许可、划边界）时，立刻警惕：

  • 如果是使用土地（如种地），通常是允许的。
  • 如果是改变产权或约束他人（如设定地役权、划定边界），通常是无效的，除非有明确的授权或追认。
© MBE Property Law Study Aid

questions.question:
A landowner conveyed his land by quitclaim deed to his daughter and son "as joint tenants in fee simple." The language of the deed was sufficient to create a common law joint tenancy with right of survivorship, which is unmodified by statute.
The daughter then duly executed a will devising her interest in the land to a friend. Then the son duly executed a will devising his interest in the land to a cousin.
The son died, and later the daughter died. Neither had ever married. The daughter's friend and the cousin survived.
After both wills have been duly probated, who owns what interest in the land?

choices.a: The cousin owns the fee simple.
choices.b: The daughter's friend and the cousin own equal shares as joint tenants with right of survivorship.
choices.c: The daughter's friend and the cousin own equal shares as tenants in common.
choices.d: The daughter's friend owns the fee simple.

data.questionStem:
Q86037

A landowner conveyed his land by quitclaim deed to his daughter and son "as joint tenants in fee simple." The language of the deed was sufficient to create a common law joint tenancy with right of survivorship, which is unmodified by statute.

The daughter then duly executed a will devising her interest in the land to a friend. Then the son duly executed a will devising his interest in the land to a cousin.

The son died, and later the daughter died. Neither had ever married. The daughter's friend and the cousin survived.

After both wills have been duly probated, who owns what interest in the land?

一位土地所有者通过一份免责契据（quitclaim deed）将其土地转让给他的女儿和儿子，“作为享有完全保有地产权（fee simple）的联权共有人（joint tenants）”。该契据的措辞足以创设普通法上附带生存者权（right of survivorship）的联权共有关系，且该关系未经成文法修改。

随后，女儿依合法程序订立了一份遗嘱，将其在该土地上的权益遗赠给一位朋友。然后，儿子也依合法程序订立了一份遗嘱，将其在该土地上的权益遗赠给一位堂/表亲。

儿子去世，之后女儿也去世了。两人均未曾结婚。女儿的朋友和该堂/表亲均在世。

在两份遗嘱都经过合法的遗嘱认证程序后，谁对该土地拥有何种权益？
options:
A. The cousin owns the fee simple.
堂/表亲拥有完全保有地产权（fee simple）。

B. The daughter's friend and the cousin own equal shares as joint tenants with right of survivorship.
女儿的朋友和堂/表亲作为附带生存者权（right of survivorship）的联权共有人（joint tenants），拥有平等的份额。

C. The daughter's friend and the cousin own equal shares as tenants in common.
女儿的朋友和堂/表亲作为分权共有人（tenants in common），拥有平等的份额。

D. The daughter's friend owns the fee simple.
女儿的朋友拥有完全保有地产权（fee simple）。
data.explanation:
A joint tenancy is a type of concurrent estate in which each co-tenant has an undivided and equal interest in the property with the right of survivorship. The right of survivorship means that a joint tenant's interest disappears upon his/her death and the remaining joint tenants' interests automatically expand to absorb it. Therefore, a joint tenant has no interest to devise upon death.

Here, the daughter and the son were joint tenants in fee simple. Although they executed wills attempting to devise their joint tenancy interests to others, they could not do so because of their right of survivorship. But the joint tenancy disappeared when the son died, and the daughter automatically acquired the entire property in fee simple. As a result, her fee simple interest passed to the friend under her will when she died.

(Choice A) Since the son was a joint tenant and died first, his property interest was acquired by the daughter. As a result, the son had no interest to devise to his cousin under a will.

(Choice B) Under the common law and in most jurisdictions, a joint tenancy with right of survivorship entails four unities. This includes unity of title, which requires joint tenants to receive their interests in the same instrument of conveyance. Since the friend and the cousin received their purported interests in separate wills, they could not acquire joint tenancy interests.

(Choice C) A lifetime transfer of a joint tenant's interest severs that interest from the joint tenancy, and it becomes a tenancy-in-common ownership interest. Therefore, the friend and cousin would have owned equal shares of the property as tenants in common had the daughter and son conveyed their interests when they were alive instead of attempting to devise them at death.

Educational objective: A joint tenant's interest disappears upon his/her death and the remaining joint tenants' interests automatically expand to absorb it (ie, right of survivorship). Therefore, a joint tenancy interest cannot be devised.



选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 1%，C选项 31%，D选项 63%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

联权共有（joint tenancy）是一种共同地产权形式，其中每个共有人在财产中都拥有不可分割且平等的权益，并附带生存者权（right of survivorship）。生存者权意味着，当一位联权共有人死亡时，其权益即告消失，而尚存的联权共有人的权益会自动扩张以吸收该权益。因此，联权共有人在死亡时没有任何权益可以通过遗嘱进行遗赠。

在本案中，女儿和儿子是享有完全保有地产权的联权共有人。尽管他们都订立了遗嘱，试图将他们的联权共有权益遗赠给他人，但由于生存者权的存在，他们无法这样做。当儿子去世时，联权共有关系即告消失，女儿自动获得了该土地的全部完全保有地产权。因此，当女儿去世时，她的完全保有地产权根据其遗嘱转移给了那位朋友。

（选项 A）由于儿子是联权共有人且先于女儿去世，他的财产权益已被女儿获得。因此，儿子没有任何权益可以通过遗嘱遗赠给他的堂/表亲。

（选项 B）根据普通法和大多数司法管辖区的规定，附带生存者权的联权共有需要具备四个统一体（four unities）。这包括产权统一（unity of title），即要求联权共有人必须通过同一份转让文书获得其权益。由于该朋友和堂/表亲是通过不同的遗嘱获得其声称的权益，他们不能获得联权共有权益。

（选项 C）联权共有人在生前转让其权益的行为会将其权益从联权共有关系中分割出去，使其成为分权共有（tenancy-in-common）的所有权权益。因此，如果女儿和儿子在生前转让了他们的权益，而不是试图在死亡时通过遗嘱进行遗赠，那么这位朋友和堂/表亲将会作为分权共有人拥有该财产的平等份额。

教学目标：联权共有人的权益在其死亡时即告消失，尚存的联权共有人的权益会自动扩张以吸收该权益（即生存者权）。因此，联权共有的权益不能通过遗嘱进行遗赠。

MBE Real Property

联权共有与遗嘱

⚖️ 核心规则：生存者权 (Right of Survivorship)

在联权共有 (Joint Tenancy) 关系中，当一名共有人死亡时，其权益自动消失并被尚存的共有人吸收。

关键点：遗嘱 (Will) 不能切断联权共有关系。 因为生存者权在死亡发生的瞬间生效，而遗嘱在死亡之后才生效。

案情逻辑推演

1. 设立联权共有
父亲将土地转让给女儿(D)和儿子(S)。
Joint Tenancy Right of Survivorship
2. 订立遗嘱 (无效处分)
D 立遗嘱给朋友；S 立遗嘱给堂亲。
注意：此时遗嘱尚未生效，也不切断共有关系。
3. 儿子(S) 先去世 💀
关键转折点： S 的权益瞬间消失。D 依据生存者权自动获得 S 的份额。
S 的遗嘱对该土地无效（堂亲一无所获）。
D 现在拥有 Fee Simple Absolute（完全保有地产权）。
4. 女儿(D) 后去世 💀
D 去世时是该土地的唯一完全所有者。
D 的遗嘱正常生效，将土地传给朋友。
✅ 正确答案：D

女儿的朋友拥有完全保有地产权
(The daughter's friend owns the fee simple.)

❌ 为什么堂亲(Cousin)什么都没有？
因为儿子(S)先去世。他的权益被“生存者权”吞噬了，没有留下任何东西给他的遗嘱继承人。

❌ 为什么不是分权共有(Tenancy in Common)?
题目明确说明是 Joint Tenancy。虽然生前转让(Inter vivos conveyance)可以切断联权共有并转化为分权共有，但订立遗嘱这一行为本身不会切断联权共有。

🎓 MBE 考试锦囊：
看到 Joint Tenancy + Will (遗嘱) 的组合时，请立即警惕！
记住口诀："Survivorship beats the Will"（生存者权 胜过 遗嘱）。除非共有人在生前已经通过出售或转让切断了共有关系，否则遗嘱在联权共有面前就是一张废纸。

questions.question:
A mother owned a two-family apartment house on a small city lot not suitable for partition-in-kind. Upon the mother's death, her will devised the apartment house to "my two sons, in equal shares."
A week ago, a creditor obtained a money judgment against the youngest son and properly filed the judgment in the county where the apartment house is located. A statute in the jurisdiction provides: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for ten years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered."
The youngest son needed cash, but the oldest son did not wish to sell the apartment house. Nevertheless, the youngest son commenced a partition action against the oldest son and the creditor. The court properly ordered a partition by judicial sale.
After the sale, the creditor's judgment will be a lien on what interest?

choices.a: All of the apartment house.
choices.b: All of the proceeds of sale of the apartment house.
choices.c: Only a one-half interest in the apartment house.
choices.d: Only the portion of the proceeds of sale due to the youngest son.

Q86058

A mother owned a two-family apartment house on a small city lot not suitable for partition-in-kind. Upon the mother's death, her will devised the apartment house to "my two sons, in equal shares."

A week ago, a creditor obtained a money judgment against the youngest son and properly filed the judgment in the county where the apartment house is located. A statute in the jurisdiction provides: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for ten years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered."

The youngest son needed cash, but the oldest son did not wish to sell the apartment house. Nevertheless, the youngest son commenced a partition action against the oldest son and the creditor. The court properly ordered a partition by judicial sale.

After the sale, the creditor's judgment will be a lien on what interest?

一位母亲在城市的一小块地块上拥有一栋双户公寓楼，该地块不适合进行实物分割。

母亲去世后，其遗嘱将该公寓楼遗赠给“我的两个儿子，平等享有份额。”

一周前，一名债权人获得了针对小儿子的金钱判决，并在该公寓楼所在的郡县妥善登记了该判决。该司法管辖区的一项法规规定：“任何妥善登记的判决，自登记之日起十年内，均构成对被判决人当时拥有或此后获得的不动产的留置权。”

小儿子需要现金，但大儿子不希望出售该公寓楼。然而，小儿子对大儿子和该债权人提起了分割之诉。法院依法下令通过司法出售进行分割。

出售后，债权人的判决将对何种权益构成留置权？
options:
A. All of the apartment house.
公寓楼的全部。

B. All of the proceeds of sale of the apartment house.
公寓楼销售所得的全部款项。

C. Only a one-half interest in the apartment house.
仅公寓楼一半的权益。

D. Only the portion of the proceeds of sale due to the youngest son.
仅销售所得款中应归属于小儿子的那一部分。
data.explanation:
Co-tenants can freely encumber their separate interests in the property without consent of the other tenants (except in a tenancy by the entirety). This means that a tenant can use his/her share of the property to secure repayment of a debt, and creditors will only have a lien on that tenant's property interest. And if any tenant later seeks to divide the property through a partition by sale, that lien will either:
  • remain on the tenant-debtor's property interest if the creditor is not a party to the partition action or
  • attach to the tenant-debtor's share of proceeds from the sale if the creditor is a party to the partition action.
Here, the two sons became co-tenants when the mother devised them a duplex in equal shares. A creditor later obtained and filed a money judgment against the youngest son, creating a judgment lien on his one-half interest in the duplex. The youngest son then commenced an action for partition by sale against the oldest son and the creditor - which the court granted. Since the creditor was a party to the partition action, the judgment lien will attach to the youngest son's portion of the proceeds from the judicial sale (Choices A, B & C).

Educational objective: When a co-tenancy is divided in an action for partition by sale, any lien on a tenant's property interest will stay attached to that interest if the creditor is not a party to the action. But if the creditor is a party, then the lien will attach to the sale proceeds attributable to that interest.



选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 3%，C选项 16%，D选项 77%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

共同共有人可以未经其他共有人同意，自由地就其在财产中的各自权益设定负担（夫妻整存共有除外）。这意味着共有人可以使用其在财产中的份额来担保债务的偿还，而债权人将只对该共有人的财产权益享有留置权。并且，如果任何共有人随后寻求通过变价分割（partition by sale）来分割财产，该留置权将：
  • 如果债权人不是分割之诉的当事人，则留置权将保留在债务人-共有人的财产权益上；或者
  • 如果债权人是分割之诉的当事人，则留置权将附着于债务人-共有人从销售中获得的所得款份额上。
在本案中，当母亲将一栋双户住宅以平等份额遗赠给他们时，这两个儿子成为了共同共有人。一名债权人随后获得了针对小儿子的金钱判决并进行了登记，从而在他于该双户住宅中所占的一半权益上设立了判决留置权。小儿子随后提起了变价分割之诉，将大儿子和债权人列为被告——法院批准了此项诉讼。由于债权人是分割之诉的当事人，该判决留置权将附着于小儿子从司法出售中获得的所得款部分（因此选项A、B、C错误）。

教学目标：当一项共同共有关系在变价分割之诉中被分割时，如果债权人不是该诉讼的当事人，则对共有人财产权益的任何留置权将继续附着于该权益上。但如果债权人是当事人，那么留置权将附着于归属于该权益的销售所得款上。

MBE 考点解析

不动产所有权与分割 (Real Property)
正确答案：D
仅销售所得款中应归属于小儿子的那一部分。

本题考察的是按份共有 (Tenancy in Common)、判决留置权 (Judgment Lien) 以及变价分割 (Partition by Sale) 之间的相互作用。

核心法律原则解析
1. 按份共有人的权利范围 Rights of Co-tenants
两个儿子通过遗嘱继承获得了房产，形成了按份共有 (Tenancy in Common) 关系。
  • 每个共有人拥有独立的权益份额。
  • 债权人针对某一共有人的判决，只能在该共有人的特定份额上设立留置权，而不能影响其他共有人的权益。
2. 变价分割与留置权的转移 Partition by Sale & Effect on Liens
当法院下令进行变价分割（即卖掉房子分钱）时，针对某一共有人的留置权去向取决于债权人是否参与了诉讼：
  • 如果债权人是当事人 (Party to the action)： 留置权从“土地”上被剥离，转而附着于该债务人分得的销售所得款 (Proceeds) 上。这样买家才能获得清晰的所有权 (Clear Title)。
  • 如果债权人不是当事人： 留置权通常会保留在土地上，买家买到的房子将背负该债务。
本案逻辑推演
  1. 确定权益归属：大儿子和小儿子各拥有一半权益。大儿子不欠债，因此他的那一半财产（或变现后的钱）绝对不能被用来偿还小儿子的债。
  2. 确定诉讼程序：题目明确指出，小儿子起诉了“大儿子和该债权人 (against the oldest son and the creditor)”。这意味着债权人是该分割之诉的当事人。
  3. 应用规则：由于债权人参与了诉讼，法院拍卖房产后，为了保护买受人，留置权不再附着于房产本身，而是“转移”到了小儿子应得的那部分现金上。
选项辨析
  • 选项 A (公寓楼全部) 错误： 这不仅侵犯了大儿子的权益，而且因为债权人参与了诉讼，留置权已被剥离，不再附着于房产。
  • 选项 B (全部所得款) 错误： 大儿子没有债务，债权人无权触及属于大儿子的那一半销售款。
  • 选项 C (仅公寓楼一半权益) 错误： 这是最具迷惑性的选项。如果债权人没有被列为被告，这个选项可能是对的（买家买到的房子会带着针对小儿子那一半权益的留置权）。但因为债权人是当事人，留置权必须从房产转移到钱款上，以确保司法拍卖的有效性和终局性。
  • 选项 D 正确： 留置权精确地附着于债务人（小儿子）在变现后所分得的那部分资金上。
MBE 考试技巧

在处理 Partition (分割) 类题目时，请务必检查以下两点：

  1. 谁欠债？ (留置权不能跨越共有人的界限)。
  2. 债权人是否在诉讼名单里？ (决定了留置权是留在房子上，还是变成对现金的权利)。

questions.question:
Three years ago, a man conveyed a tract of land to a friend for $50,000 by a deed that provided: "By accepting this deed, [the friend] covenants for herself, her heirs and assigns, that the premises herein conveyed shall be used solely for residential purposes and, if the premises are used for nonresidential purposes, [the man], his heirs and assigns, shall have the right to repurchase the premises for the sum of one thousand dollars ($1,000)." In order to pay the $50,000 purchase price for land, the friend obtained a $35,000 mortgage loan from the bank. The man had full knowledge of the mortgage transaction. The deed and mortgage were promptly and properly recorded in proper sequence. The mortgage, however, made no reference to the quoted language in the deed.
Two years ago, the friend converted her use of the land from residential to commercial without the knowledge or consent of the man or of the bank. The friend's commercial venture failed, and she defaulted on her mortgage payments to the bank. The land now has a fair market value of $25,000.
The bank began appropriate foreclosure proceedings against the friend. The man properly intervened, tendered $1,000, and sought judgment that the friend and the bank be ordered to convey the land to the man, free and clear of the mortgage.
The common-law Rule Against Perpetuities is unmodified by statute.
If the court rules against the man, what will be the reason?

choices.a: The bank had no actual knowledge of, and did not consent to, the violation of the covenant.
choices.b: The consideration of $1,000 was inadequate.
choices.c: The provision quoted from the deed violates the Rule Against Perpetuities.
choices.d: The rights reserved by the man were subordinated, by necessary implication, to the rights of the bank as the lender of the purchase money.

三年前，一名男子以50,000美元的价格将一块土地转让给一位朋友，其契据规定：“[该朋友]接受本契据，即为其本人、其继承人和受让人立下契约，承诺此处转让的房产仅用于住宅目的；如果该房产被用于非住宅目的，[该男子]、其继承人和受让人有权以一千美元（$1,000）的价款回购该房产。”为了支付50,000美元的土地购买价款，该朋友从银行获得了35,000美元的抵押贷款。该男子完全知晓该抵押交易。契据和抵押权已按适当顺序及时、妥善地登记。然而，抵押合同中并未提及契据中引用的上述文字。

两年前，该朋友在未经该男子或银行知晓或同意的情况下，将土地用途从住宅改为商业用途。该朋友的商业投资失败，并拖欠了其应向银行偿付的抵押贷款。该土地目前的公平市场价值为25,000美元。

银行对该朋友提起了适当的止赎程序。该男子进行了适当的干预，提交了1,000美元，并请求判决，要求该朋友和银行将土地转让给该男子，且不附带任何抵押权。

普通法上的 Rule Against Perpetuities 未经法规修改。

如果法院作出不利于该男子的裁决，理由会是什么？
options:
A. The bank had no actual knowledge of, and did not consent to, the violation of the covenant.
银行对违反契约的行为没有实际知情，也未曾同意。

B. The consideration of $1,000 was inadequate.
1,000美元的对价不充分。

C. The provision quoted from the deed violates the Rule Against Perpetuities.
契据中引用的条款违反了 Rule Against Perpetuities。

D. The rights reserved by the man were subordinated, by necessary implication, to the rights of the bank as the lender of the purchase money.
根据必要推定，该男子保留的权利次于银行作为购房款出借人的权利。
data.explanation:
The Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP) applies only to contingent future interests - ie, future interests that are held by unknown/unborn persons or subject to a condition precedent. Here, the deed conveyed the friend a present possessory interest in the tract, and the man received an option to purchase the premises contingent upon the friend's use of the premises for nonresidential purposes. Therefore, the man's future interest is subject to RAP.

Under the common law, RAP renders a contingent future interest void ab initio if it could vest more than 21 years after some relevant life in being at the creation of the interest. Therefore, an option to purchase is almost always void if it is not set to terminate within the perpetuities period. Here, the option to purchase will vest if the friend, her heirs, and assigns ever use the premises for nonresidential purposes. This means that the man's option to purchase violates RAP because it is possible that it could vest well after the perpetuities period.

(Choices A & D) Since a deed is recorded before a purchase-money mortgage, the mortgagee's (bank's) rights are subject to whatever rights the mortgagor (friend) holds in the land. Therefore, the bank's mortgage is subordinate to the man's purchase option in the deed - regardless of whether the bank had actual knowledge of or consented to its existence.

(Choice B) Adequate consideration exists so long as there is a bargained-for exchange of promises or performance. Since the man gave $1,000 in exchange for the friend's promise to give the man a purchase option, his consideration was adequate.

Educational objective: The Rule Against Perpetuities applies only to contingent future interests (eg, purchase options) and voids any such interest that may not vest for more than 21 years after some relevant life in being at the creation of the interest.



选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 6%，C选项 36%（正确选项），D选项 47%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP) 仅适用于或有未来权益——即由身份不明/尚未出生的人持有或受先决条件约束的未来权益。在本案中，契据向朋友转让了该地块的当前占有权益，而该男子获得了一项购买选择权，该选择权取决于其朋友将房产用于非住宅目的。因此，该男子的未来权益受 RAP 约束。

根据普通法，如果一项或有未来权益可能在相关在世人（于权益创设时）死后超过21年才归属，则 RAP 会使该权益自始无效。因此，如果一项购买选择权未被设定在永续期内终止，则该选择权几乎总是无效的。在本案中，如果该朋友、其继承人和受让人在任何时候将该房产用于非住宅目的，则购买选择权将归属。这意味着该男子的购买选择权违反了 RAP，因为它有可能在永续期结束很久之后才归属。

(选项 A & D) 由于契据在购房款抵押之前登记，抵押权人（银行）的权利受制于抵押人（朋友）在该土地上持有的任何权利。因此，银行的抵押权次于该男子在契据中的购买选择权——无论银行是否实际知晓或同意其存在。

(选项 B) 只要存在经协商的允诺或履行的交换，就存在充分的对价。由于该男子支付1,000美元以换取朋友给予其购买选择权的允诺，他的对价是充分的。

教学目标： Rule Against Perpetuities 仅适用于或有未来权益（例如，购买选择权），并使任何可能在相关在世人（于权益创设时）死后超过21年才归属的此类权益无效。

References

61 Am. Jur. 2d Perpetuities and Restraints on Alienation § 5 (2020) (Rule Against Perpetuities).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析
Real Property (不动产法)

正确答案：C

契据中引用的条款违反了 Rule Against Perpetuities (反永续原则)。

如果法院判决该男子败诉，最根本的法律原因是他在契据中保留的“回购权”自始无效。

核心考点：购买选择权与 RAP

本题的关键在于识别该男子保留的权利性质，并应用普通法下的 Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP)。

1. 权利定性：购买选择权 (Option to Purchase)

虽然该条款出现在契据中，且看似像一种“进入权” (Right of Entry)，但因为它要求支付固定金额（$1,000）来换取土地，法律上将其视为购买选择权 (Option to Purchase)。

  • 重要区别：如果是单纯的 Right of Entry（即违反条件后，原主可直接收回土地而无需付款），在普通法下通常不受 RAP 限制。但购买选择权受 RAP 限制。

2. RAP 的应用

RAP 规定：任何权益如果可能在“相关在世人” (Lives in Being) 去世后 21 年之后才归属 (Vest)，则该权益无效。

  • 本案分析：该回购权是“或有”的 (Contingent)，条件是土地被用于非住宅目的。
  • 时间跨度：这个条件可能在明天触发，也可能在 100 年后触发（即朋友及其继承人一直住在那，直到很久以后才改为商用）。
  • 结论：由于没有时间限制，该权利可能在永续期（21年）之后才行使。因此，根据普通法，该选择权自始无效 (Void ab initio)。
干扰项排除

选项 A (银行不知情)：错误。
契据已经妥善登记 (Recorded)。登记构成了推定通知 (Constructive Notice)。无论银行是否实际阅读了契据，法律上视为银行已知晓该条款。因此，实际知情与否不影响权利归属。

选项 B (对价不足)：错误。
法院通常不审查对价的“充分性” (Adequacy of Consideration)，只要存在议价交换即可。$1,000 的回购价虽然低于市价，但在合同法上是有效的对价。问题不在于钱太少，而在于时间太久。

选项 D (权利次级)：错误。
通常，购房款抵押贷款 (Purchase Money Mortgage) 优于买方设立的其他留置权。但是，本案中的回购权是卖方在转让时保留的权利，且契据先于抵押权登记。如果该权利有效，它将优先于银行的抵押权。该男子败诉的原因不是因为顺序问题，而是因为权利本身无效。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

遇到“回购权” (Right to Repurchase) 或 “优先购买权” (Right of First Refusal) 且没有明确截止日期的题目时：

  1. 首先检查是否受 RAP 约束（大多数商业/财产选择权都受约束）。
  2. 如果该权利可能在“无限远的未来”行使（例如给“继承人和受让人”），它通常违反 RAP。
  3. 陷阱警示：不要将其混淆为不受 RAP 限制的“归复权” (Reversion) 或“进入权” (Right of Entry)。一旦涉及支付金钱，它通常就是 Option，从而触发 RAP 杀手。

questions.question:
In September, a college student signed a one-year written agreement to lease a fully furnished apartment from a landlord. The student paid rent on a timely basis for four months. In December, the student discovered a crack in the kitchen floor after cutting his foot on the broken tile. Although the student notified the landlord of the crack, the landlord failed to repair the floor. Fed up with the landlord, and after being offered a scholarship to study abroad for the spring semester, the student moved to Europe in January and ceased paying rent on the apartment. Upon discovering that the student had abandoned the apartment, the landlord took possession of the apartment and re-rented it to a visiting professor.
Based upon these facts, which of the following statements is true?

choices.a: The lease has been terminated, because the apartment was re-rented to a visiting professor.
choices.b: The lease has been terminated, because the student justifiably abandoned the lease.
choices.c: The lease has not been terminated, and the student is liable for any future rents.
choices.d: The lease has not been terminated, because the student was not constructively evicted.

questions.question:
A widower died. By will, he left an undeveloped parcel of land, comprising 100 acres of pasture, to his "two children in joint ownership." His son received a 70 percent interest in the land, and his daughter received a 30 percent interest. The son died shortly after the widower. Since the son did not leave a will, his property passed in accordance with the state's intestacy laws to his surviving spouse. The son's surviving spouse bought sheep and moved them onto the land to graze. The widower's daughter has not taken any action with respect to the land.
Who owns the undeveloped parcel of land?

choices.a: The widower's daughter owns the entire parcel of land outright.
choices.b: The son's surviving spouse owns a 70 percent interest in the parcel of land as a tenant in common with the widower's daughter, who owns a 30 percent interest.
choices.c: The son's surviving spouse owns 70 acres of the parcel of land and the widower's daughter owns 30 acres of the parcel of land.
choices.d: The son's surviving spouse owns the entire parcel of land outright.

questions.question:
A man's estate plan included a revocable trust established 35 years ago with a bank as trustee. The principal asset of the trust has always been a very profitable, debt-free office building. The trust instrument instructs the trustee to pay the net income to the man for life; and, after the death of the man, to pay the net income to his wife for life; and, after her death, "to distribute the net trust estate as she may appoint by will, or in default of her exercise of this power of appointment, to my son (her stepson)."
The man died 30 years ago, survived by his wife and son. The man had not revoked or amended the trust agreement. A few years after the man's death, his wife remarried. She then had a daughter, was widowed a second time, and died last year. Her will contained only one dispositive provision: "I give my entire estate to my daughter, and I intentionally make no provision for my stepson." The daughter is now 22 years old.
The common-law Rule Against Perpetuities is unmodified by statute in the jurisdiction. There are no other applicable statutes.
The son brought an appropriate action against the daughter to determine who was entitled to the net trust estate and thus to the office building.
If the court rules for the daughter, what will be the reason?

choices.a: The jurisdiction deems "entire estate" to be a reference to the office building or to the wife's power of appointment.
choices.b: The Rule Against Perpetuities does not apply to powers of appointment.
choices.c: The wife intended that the son should not benefit by reason of her death.
choices.d: The wife's life estate and power of appointment merge into complete ownership in the wife.

Q86097

The trust instrument instructs the trustee to pay the net income to the man for life; and, after the death of the man, to pay the net income to his wife for life; and, after her death, "to distribute the net trust estate as she may appoint by will, or in default of her exercise of this power of appointment, to my son (her stepson)."

The man died 30 years ago, survived by his wife and son. The man had not revoked or amended the trust agreement. A few years after the man's death, his wife remarried. She then had a daughter, was widowed a second time, and died last year. Her will contained only one dispositive provision: "I give my entire estate to my daughter, and I intentionally make no provision for my stepson." The daughter is now 22 years old.

The common-law Rule Against Perpetuities is unmodified by statute in the jurisdiction. There are no other applicable statutes.

The son brought an appropriate action against the daughter to determine who was entitled to the net trust estate and thus to the office building.

If the court rules for the daughter, what will be the reason?

一名男子的遗产规划包括一个35年前设立的可撤销信托，由一家银行担任受托人。该信托的主要资产一直是一栋盈利丰厚、无债务的办公楼。该信托文书指示受托人将净收益支付给该男子，供其终身享用；在该男子去世后，将净收益支付给其妻子，供其终身享用；在其妻子去世后，“根据她通过遗嘱的指定来分配信托净资产，若她未能行使此指定权，则将资产分配给我的儿子（她的继子）。”

该男子于30年前去世，遗有其妻子和儿子在世。该男子未曾撤销或修改该信托协议。在该男子去世几年后，他的妻子再婚。她之后生了一个女儿，第二次丧偶，并于去年去世。她的遗嘱中仅有一条处分条款：“我将我的全部遗产赠与我的女儿，并且我故意不为我的继子做任何安排。”该女儿现年22岁。

在该司法管辖区，普通法中的“反永久所有权规则”(Rule Against Perpetuities) 未被成文法修改。没有其他适用的成文法。

儿子对女儿提起了适当的诉讼，以确定谁有权获得信托净资产，即该办公楼。

如果法院裁定女儿胜诉，理由会是什么？
options:
A. The jurisdiction deems "entire estate" to be a reference to the office building or to the wife's power of appointment.
该司法管辖区认为“全部遗产”的提法是指该办公楼或妻子的指定权。

B. The Rule Against Perpetuities does not apply to powers of appointment.
“反永久所有权规则”(Rule Against Perpetuities) 不适用于指定权。

C. The wife intended that the son should not benefit by reason of her death.
妻子的意图是儿子不应因其死亡而受益。

D. The wife's life estate and power of appointment merge into complete ownership in the wife.
妻子的终身权益和指定权合并为妻子的完全所有权。
data.explanation:
The man's trust instrument conveys the net income of the trust estate to the man for life, then to the wife for life with a power of appointment subject to the son's future interest. The powerholder has the right to designate the recipients of a beneficial property interest (eg, trust). This power can be either:

  • general - if there are no limitations on the disposition of the property or
  • non-general - if there are limitations on the disposition of the property (eg, restrictions on the recipients, time, or manner of the disposition)


Here, the wife received a non-general power of appointment since she may dispose of the net trust estate only "by will" (ie, devise). If she fails to do so, then the property will go to the designated remainderman (here, the son). But since the wife devised her entire estate to her daughter, the reason for the daughter prevailing would be that this jurisdiction considers "entire estate" to be a reference to the office building or the wife's power of appointment.

(Choice B) The Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP) does apply to powers of appointment, so the exercise of this power is valid only if a trust would vest or fail to vest by the end of the life in being plus 21 years. Here, the appointment would have vested or failed immediately upon the wife's death, so RAP was not violated.

(Choice C) To exercise the power of appointment, the wife had to designate the recipient of the net trust estate. The fact that the wife identified the stepson as a nonrecipient is irrelevant.

(Choice D) A life estate and power of appointment do not merge into complete ownership (ie, a fee estate). However, the designated recipient will receive complete ownership of the property.

Educational objective: The power of appointment gives a life tenant the right to designate recipients of a beneficial property interest. If the life tenant does not exercise this power, then the property will go to the designated remainderman.

正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

该男子的信托文书将信托资产的净收益授予该男子终身享有，然后授予其妻子终身享有，并附带一项指定权，但该权利受其儿子的未来权益所规限。权利持有人有权指定一项财产受益权（例如信托）的受益人。此项权利可以是：

  • 一般指定权 - 如果对财产的处分没有限制，或者
  • 特别指定权 - 如果对财产的处分存在限制（例如，对受益人、时间或处分方式的限制）


在本案中，妻子获得的是一项特别指定权，因为她只能“通过遗嘱”（即遗赠）来处分信托净资产。如果她未能如此行事，则该财产将归于指定的剩余财产受益人（此处为儿子）。但由于妻子将其全部遗产遗赠给了女儿，女儿胜诉的理由将是该司法管辖区认为“全部遗产”的提法是指该办公楼或妻子的指定权。

(选项B) “反永久所有权规则”(Rule Against Perpetuities, RAP) 确实适用于指定权，因此，只有当信托在“在世生命”外加21年结束前归属或未能归属时，该权利的行使才有效。在本案中，该指定在妻子去世时即已归属或未能归属，因此未违反 RAP。

(选项C) 为了行使指定权，妻子必须指定信托净资产的受益人。妻子将继子确定为非受益人这一事实是无关紧要的。

(选项D) 终身权益和指定权不会合并为完全所有权（即 fee estate）。然而，被指定的受益人将获得该财产的完全所有权。

教学目标：指定权赋予终身权益持有人指定财产受益权之受益人的权利。如果终身权益持有人不行使此权利，则财产将归于指定的剩余财产受益人。

References

Restatement (Second) of Property: Donative Transfers § 12.1 (Am. Law Inst. 1986) (power of appointment).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property (不动产法) Power of Appointment (指定权)
权益流转图解
设立人 (Man)
↓
信托 (Trust)
↓
妻子 (Wife)
终身权益 (Life Estate) + 指定权 (Power of Appointment)
↙     ↘
若行使权利：
指定受益人
(女儿?)
若未行使 (Default)：
继子 (Son)
正确答案解析 (选项 A)

本题的核心争议点在于：遗嘱中的“剩余财产条款”(Residuary Clause) 是否足以行使“指定权”(Power of Appointment)？

妻子拥有通过遗嘱分配信托资产的权利。如果她不行使该权利，资产将自动归继子所有。妻子的遗嘱中写道：“我将我的全部遗产(entire estate)赠与我的女儿”。

  • 普通法原则 (Common Law)： 通常认为，仅提及“全部遗产”的剩余财产条款不足以行使指定权。必须明确提及该权利或信托资产。
  • 本题的逻辑陷阱： 题目问的是“如果法院裁定女儿胜诉，理由是什么？”

这意味着我们需要找到一个法律理由来支持“女儿胜诉”这一结果。唯一能让女儿胜诉的理由是：该司法管辖区的法院将“全部遗产”这一表述解释为包含了信托资产（即行使了指定权）。

选项 A 正确：因为它提供了支持判决结果的法律解释——即法院认定遗嘱中的概括性语言足以行使指定权。

干扰项排除

选项 B (RAP)：
虽然反永久所有权规则 (RAP) 适用于指定权，但本案中妻子的权利是“目前可行使的”或在死后立即生效，且受益人（女儿）也是确定的。权益在妻子死亡时立即归属，没有违反 RAP。RAP 不是判决理由。

选项 C (Intent)：
仅有剥夺继承权的意图（“不给继子”）通常不足以构成指定权的有效行使。指定权需要积极地“指定”资产去向，而不仅仅是说“不给谁”。法律看重的是处分行为的有效性，而非单纯的负面意图。

选项 D (Merger)：
合并原则 (Doctrine of Merger) 通常指当终身权益和剩余权益（或完全所有权）归于同一人时发生合并。但在这里，妻子拥有的是“终身权益 + 指定权”，这并不等同于拥有完全所有权 (Fee Simple)。因此不会发生合并。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
注意题干的提问方式：“If the court rules for X...”（如果法院判 X 胜诉...）。

这类题目不是让你预测谁会赢，而是让你进行逆向推理：假设结果已经确定，哪个法律原则是该结果的必要前提？即使该原则可能是少数派规则 (Minority Rule)，只要它是导致该结果的唯一逻辑路径，它就是正确答案。

A brother and sister owned a large tract of land in fee simple as joint tenants with rights of survivorship. While the sister was on an extended safari in Kenya, the brother learned that there were very valuable coal deposits within the land, but he made no attempt to inform the sister. Thereupon, the brother conveyed his interest in the land to his wife, who immediately reconveyed that interest back to him. The common law joint tenancy is unmodified by statute.
Shortly thereafter, the brother was killed in an automobile accident. His will, which was duly probated, specifically devised his one-half interest in the land to his wife.
The sister then returned from Kenya and learned what had happened.
The sister brought an appropriate action against the wife, who claimed a one-half interest in the land, seeking a declaratory judgment that she, the sister, was the sole owner of the land.
In this action, who should prevail?

choices.a: The sister, because the brother breached his fiduciary duty as joint tenant.
choices.b: The sister, because the joint tenancy was reestablished by the wife's reconveyance to the brother.
choices.c: The wife, because the brother and sister were tenants in common at the time of the brother's death.
choices.d: The wife, because the brother's will severed the joint tenancy.

Q86068

A brother and sister owned a large tract of land in fee simple as joint tenants with rights of survivorship. While the sister was on an extended safari in Kenya, the brother learned that there were very valuable coal deposits within the land, but he made no attempt to inform the sister. Thereupon, the brother conveyed his interest in the land to his wife, who immediately reconveyed that interest back to him. The common law joint tenancy is unmodified by statute.

Shortly thereafter, the brother was killed in an automobile accident. His will, which was duly probated, specifically devised his one-half interest in the land to his wife.

The sister then returned from Kenya and learned what had happened.

The sister brought an appropriate action against the wife, who claimed a one-half interest in the land, seeking a declaratory judgment that she, the sister, was the sole owner of the land.

In this action, who should prevail?

一对兄妹以享有遗属权的共同共有人身份，拥有对一大片土地的完全所有权（fee simple）。当妹妹在肯尼亚进行长期狩猎旅行时，哥哥得知土地下有非常宝贵的煤炭矿藏，但他并未试图告知妹妹。于是，哥哥将其在土地上的权益转让给他的妻子，妻子随即又将该权益转回给他。普通法上的共同共有（joint tenancy）未经成文法修改。

此后不久，哥哥在一起车祸中丧生。其遗嘱经过合法认证，明确将其在土地上的二分之一权益遗赠给他的妻子。

妹妹随后从肯尼亚回来，并得知了所发生的一切。

妹妹对声称拥有土地二分之一权益的嫂子提起了适当的诉讼，请求宣告判决，确认她，即妹妹，是该土地的唯一所有者。

在此诉讼中，谁应当胜诉？
options:
A. The sister, because the brother breached his fiduciary duty as joint tenant.
妹妹，因为哥哥作为共同共有人违反了他的信托责任。

B. The sister, because the joint tenancy was reestablished by the wife's reconveyance to the brother.
妹妹，因为通过妻子向哥哥的权益转回，共同共有关系得以重建。

C. The wife, because the brother and sister were tenants in common at the time of the brother's death.
妻子，因为在哥哥去世时，兄妹二人是分权共有人。

D. The wife, because the brother's will severed the joint tenancy.
妻子，因为哥哥的遗嘱切断了共同共有关系。
data.explanation:
A joint tenancy is a type of concurrent estate in which each co-tenant has an undivided and equal interest in the property with the right of survivorship. Under the common law (and in most jurisdictions), the creation and continuation of a joint tenancy relies on the coexistence of four unities (PITT):

  • P ossession - co-tenants share an equal right to possess or use the property
  • I nterest - co-tenants each have an equal interest in the property
  • T ime - property interests simultaneously vest in all co-tenants
  • T itle - property interests received in same instrument of conveyance


If any of these unities is lost , then the noncomplying interest is severed from the joint tenancy and becomes a tenancy in common.

Here, a brother and sister owned land as joint tenants. When the brother conveyed his interest to his wife, the joint tenancy lost the unities of time (interests vested at different times) and title (interests received in different instruments). Therefore, the conveyed interest was severed from the joint tenancy and converted into a tenancy in common. The wife's immediate reconveyance to the brother did not reestablish the joint tenancy since the unities of time and title were still lost (Choice B). Instead, the brother became tenants in common with his sister. And since the brother's interest was devised to his wife upon his death, the wife should prevail.

(Choice A) A fiduciary duty is a legal obligation to act in another's best interest. Joint tenants owe no such duty to each other.

(Choice D) A will has no effect on a joint tenancy interest, because the right of survivorship automatically transfers the property to the surviving joint tenant(s) at the moment of death. A will is not probated and does not take effect until after death. As such, a will cannot be used to sever a joint tenancy.

Educational objective: Under the common law, a joint tenancy must satisfy four unities: possession, interest, time, and title (PITT). If any of these unities is broken (eg, when a joint tenant conveys his/her interest), then the noncomplying interest is severed from the joint tenancy and converted to a tenancy in common.



选项正确率统计：A选项 12%，B选项 11%，C选项 71%（正确选项），D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

共同共有（joint tenancy）是一种共同产权形式，其中每个共有人对财产拥有不可分割且平等的权益，并享有遗属权（right of survivorship）。根据普通法（common law）（以及在大多数司法管辖区），共同共有的设立和存续依赖于四个统一体（four unities）（PITT）的共存：

  • 占有（Possession） - 共有人享有占有或使用该财产的平等权利
  • 权益（Interest） - 每个共有人在财产中拥有平等的权益
  • 时间（Time） - 所有共有人的财产权益同时归属
  • 所有权（Title） - 财产权益通过同一份转让文书获得


如果这些统一体中的任何一个被破坏，那么不符合要求的权益将从共同共有中被切断，并转变为分权共有（tenancy in common）。

在本案中，一对兄妹作为共同共有人拥有土地。当哥哥将其权益转让给他的妻子时，共同共有关系失去了时间统一体（权益在不同时间归属）和所有权统一体（权益通过不同文书获得）。因此，被转让的权益从共同共有中被切断，并转变为分权共有。妻子立即将权益转回给哥哥的行为，并不能重建共同共有关系，因为时间和所有权的统一体仍然被破坏（选项 B）。相反，哥哥与他的妹妹成为了分权共有人。并且由于哥哥的权益在他去世时通过遗嘱遗赠给了他的妻子，因此妻子应当胜诉。

（选项 A）信托责任是在法律上为他人最大利益行事的义务。共同共有人之间互不负有此种责任。

（选项 D）遗嘱对共同共有的权益没有影响，因为遗属权在死亡瞬间自动将财产转移给尚存的共同共有人。遗嘱在死后才进行认证并生效。因此，遗嘱不能用于切断共同共有关系。

教学目的：根据普通法，一项共同共有必须满足四个统一体：占有、权益、时间和所有权（PITT）。如果这些统一体中的任何一个被破坏（例如，当一个共同共有人转让其权益时），那么不符合要求的权益将从共同共有中被切断，并转变为分权共有。

References

20 Am. Jur. 2d Cotenancy and Joint Ownership § 5 (2020) (four unities of a joint tenancy).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Joint Tenancy & Severance
核心概念：共同共有 (Joint Tenancy)

共同共有最显著的特征是遗属权 (Right of Survivorship)：当一方去世时，其权益自动归属于幸存的共有人，不受遗嘱控制。

要维持这种关系，必须同时满足四个统一体 (Four Unities - PITT)：

  • Possession
    占有
  • Interest
    权益
  • Time
    时间
  • Title
    所有权/文书

案情法律推演

初始状态
哥哥(B) 和 妹妹(S) 拥有 Joint Tenancy。
PITT 四要素齐全。
⬇️
关键转折 (Severance)
哥哥将权益转让给妻子(W)。
法律后果：破坏了 Time 和 Title 的统一性。Joint Tenancy 被切断 (Severed)。
⬇️
当前状态
妻子(W) 和 妹妹(S) 成为分权共有人 (Tenants in Common)。
不再享有遗属权。
⬇️
转回操作
妻子(W) 将权益转回给哥哥(B)。
法律后果：B 和 S 仍然是 Tenants in Common。因为 B 获得权益的时间(Time)和文书(Title)与 S 最初获得时不同，无法自动恢复 Joint Tenancy。

为什么妻子(Wife)胜诉？

本题的正确答案是 C。

1. 切断 (Severance) 是不可逆的：
当哥哥在生前(inter vivos)将土地权益转让给妻子时，哪怕只是短暂的一瞬间，共同共有关系(Joint Tenancy)就已经破裂了。这被称为 "Strawman conveyance"（稻草人转让）。

2. 状态转变为分权共有 (Tenancy in Common)：
一旦切断，哥哥（后转回）与妹妹的关系变成了分权共有。分权共有没有遗属权。

3. 遗嘱生效：
因为没有了遗属权，哥哥去世后，他在土地中的 1/2 权益变成了他的遗产。因此，他的遗嘱有效，该权益根据遗嘱转移给了妻子。

为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 A (信托责任): 共同共有人之间通常没有信托责任(Fiduciary Duty)。哥哥有权单方面处置自己的份额，无需通知妹妹。
  • 选项 B (重建共有): 共同共有不能通过简单的“转回”自动复活。要重建 Joint Tenancy，必须重新通过同一文书同时将土地转让给 B 和 S (需满足 PITT)。
  • 选项 D (遗嘱切断): 这是一个常见的陷阱。遗嘱不能切断 Joint Tenancy。如果哥哥生前没有转让给妻子，那么在他死亡的瞬间，权益直接归妹妹所有，遗嘱对该土地无效。本案是因为生前的转让切断了共有，而非遗嘱。
结论：哥哥去世时是分权共有人，其权益按遗嘱归妻子所有。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
看到 "Joint Tenancy" 就要立刻寻找是否有 "Severance" (切断) 的行为。最常见的切断方式就是一方单方面转让权益（即使是秘密进行的）。一旦发生转让，PITT 中的 Time 和 Title 必破，遗属权随之消失。

questions.question:
A worker took a temporary job of unknown duration in a distant state. The worker entered into a written agreement to rent a room in that state on a weekly basis, with the weekly period to start on Sunday and a weekly rent of $350, reflecting a per-day rental rate of $50, to be paid at the end of the week on Saturday. The worker occupied the room and paid the rent for several months before learning on a Tuesday that his job would be finished the following day. That same Tuesday evening, the worker gave an oral notice of termination to the landlord.
There is no applicable statute.
Assuming that the landlord is unable to find someone else to rent the room, how much rent is the worker obligated to pay?

choices.a: $150, because the worker's notice would terminate the lease immediately.
choices.b: $350, because the worker's notice would terminate the lease at the end of the current period, on Saturday.
choices.c: $500, because the worker's notice would terminate the lease seven days after notice was provided, on the following Tuesday.
choices.d: $700, because the worker's notice would terminate the lease at the end of the next full period, on the following Saturday.

一名工人在一个遥远的州从事一份为期不定的临时工作。该工人签订了一份书面协议，按周租赁一个房间，租期从周日开始，周租金为350美元，相当于每日租金50美元，于每周六周末支付。该工人租住该房间并支付了几个月的租金，直到某个周二，他得知自己的工作将于次日结束。就在那个周二晚上，该工人向房东发出了口头解约通知。

本案没有适用的成文法。

假设房东无法找到其他人租赁该房间，该工人有义务支付多少租金？
options:
A. $150, because the worker's notice would terminate the lease immediately.
150美元，因为工人的通知将立即终止租赁。

B. $350, because the worker's notice would terminate the lease at the end of the current term, on Saturday.
350美元，因为工人的通知将在本期租期结束时（即周六）终止租赁。

C. $500, because the worker's notice would terminate the lease seven days after notice was provided, on the following Tuesday.
500美元，因为工人的通知将在发出通知七天后（即下周二）终止租赁。

D. $700, because the worker's notice would terminate the lease seven days after the end of the current term, on the following Saturday.
700美元，因为工人的通知将在本期租期结束七天后（即下周六）终止租赁。
data.explanation:
Types of tenancies


(leases on land)
TypeCreationDurationTermination
Term of yearsAgreement (ie, lease)Fixed period (eg, one month, three years)End of term (automatic)
Breach of certain covenants (eg, rent, habitability)
Periodic tenancyAgreement
Presumed when lease has no specified termination date
Operation of law (eg, holdover tenant)		Periodically renews until terminatedEnd of period (proper notice)
Breach of certain covenants
Tenancy at willAgreement
Implied when person allowed to possess premises without paying rent		Indefinite periodAt any time (reasonable notice)
Tenancy at sufferanceImplied when tenant keeps possession after lease expires (ie, holdover tenancy)Continues until terminatedLandlord evicts
Tenant vacates
Landlord accepts rent (forms periodic tenancy)
A periodic tenancy lasts for a set period of time and then automatically renews at the end of each period (eg, on a weekly basis). Either party can terminate this tenancy at the end of a full period by giving the other party notice before that period begins. This means that notice given during the current period is effective to terminate the tenancy on the last day of the following period.

Here, the worker rented the room on a weekly basis (periodic tenancy), with the weekly period to start on Sunday. The worker gave an oral notice of termination to the landlord on a Tuesday evening, which was effective to terminate the worker's tenancy on Saturday of the following week.† As a result, the worker is obligated to pay rent for the current week and the following week ($350 + $350), or a total of $700.

†An oral notice of termination is sufficient under the common law to terminate a periodic tenancy. However, most jurisdictions have enacted statutes that require some form of written notice (not seen here).

(Choice A) $150 represents the amount of rent that the worker would have been obligated to pay if his termination notice had ended the tenancy immediately . That is because the worker had occupied the room for the first three days of the week (Sunday through Tuesday), and the per-day portion of the weekly rent is $50.

(Choice B) $350 represents the amount of rent the worker would have been obligated to pay if his termination notice had been effective at the end of the current term .

(Choice C) $500 represents the amount of rent that the worker would have owed if his termination notice had ended the tenancy after the length of a period . This amount includes the $150 ($50 × 3) for Sunday through Tuesday and $350 for the seven days after notice was given.

Educational objective: Either party can terminate a periodic (eg, week-to-week) tenancy at the end of a full period by giving the other party notice before the period begins. This means that notice given during the current period is effective to terminate the tenancy on the last day of the following period.

选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 41%，C选项 13%，D选项 36%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

租赁类型

周期性租赁 (periodic tenancy) 持续一个固定的时间段，并在每个周期结束时自动续约（例如，按周计算）。任何一方都可以在一个完整租期结束时终止此租赁，但需在该租期开始前通知另一方。这意味着在当前租期内发出的通知，其效力在于终止下一个租期最后一天的租赁关系。

在本案中，该工人按周租赁房间（周期性租赁），每周的租期从周日开始。该工人在周二晚上向房东发出口头解约通知，该通知的效力在于终止下一周周六的租赁关系。† 因此，该工人有义务支付本周和下一周的租金（350美元 + 350美元），共计700美元。

†根据普通法，口头解约通知足以终止周期性租赁。然而，大多数司法管辖区已颁布成文法，要求某种形式的书面通知（本案中未体现）。

（选项 A）150美元是工人的解约通知立即终止租赁关系时所需支付的租金数额。因为该工人已经占用了本周的前三天（周日至周二），而每周租金分摊到每天是50美元。

（选项 B）350美元是工人的解约通知在本期租期结束时生效所需支付的租金数额。

（选项 C）500美元是工人的解约通知在一个租期长度之后终止租赁关系时所需支付的租金数额。该金额包括周日至周二的150美元（50美元 × 3）以及发出通知后七天的350美元。

教学目的：对于周期性租赁（例如，按周租赁），任何一方都可以在一个完整租期结束时终止租赁，但需在该租期开始前通知另一方。这意味着在当前租期内发出的通知，其效力在于终止下一个租期最后一天的租赁关系。

References

Restatement (Second) of Property: Landlord & Tenant § 1.5 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (periodic tenancy).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Landlord & Tenant
Periodic Tenancy (周期性租赁)

本题考察的是普通法下周期性租赁的终止规则。正确答案是 D ($700)。

⚖️ 核心法律规则 (Common Law Rule) 对于周期性租赁（Periodic Tenancy），要终止租赁关系，必须满足两个条件：
  1. 通知时间：必须至少提前一个完整的周期发出通知（对于按周租赁，需提前一周）。
  2. 生效时间：终止必须发生在自然租期的最后一天 (End of a natural lease period)。
1. 确定租赁类型

题目中提到 "rent a room on a weekly basis" 且没有固定的结束日期。这构成了按周的周期性租赁 (Week-to-Week Periodic Tenancy)。

2. 分析时间线
  • 租期设定：周日开始，周六结束。
  • 通知时间：周二晚上（当前租期内）。

根据普通法，如果在当前周期内（周二）发出通知，该通知无法终止本周六的租约，因为剩下的时间不足一个完整的周期（一周）。

3. 确定终止日期

通知必须顺延到下一个完整的周期结束。因此，租赁关系将在下周六正式终止。

周日
本周开始
周二
发出通知
周六
本周结束
(无效)
下周六
正式终止
4. 计算租金

工人必须支付直到租赁正式终止日期的所有租金：

  • 本周租金：$350
  • 下周租金：$350
总计义务 = $700
💡 为什么其他选项是错的？
  • A ($150) 错：普通法不支持“立即终止”或按日计算退租。
  • B ($350) 错：这假设通知在本周六生效。但要在本周六生效，通知必须在上一个租期结束前（即上周六之前）发出。
  • C ($500) 错：这假设租赁可以在“周中”终止（下周二）。普通法要求租赁必须在租期末尾（End of the period）终止，不能在周期中间切断。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧：
注意题目中的 "No applicable statute"（无适用成文法）。这意味着你必须应用严格的普通法 (Common Law) 规则，而不是现代更灵活的法规（现代法规可能允许30天通知在任何一天终止）。在普通法下，周期性租赁的终止日必须与周期的最后一天重合。

questions.question:
A brother and sister owned property as joint tenants. A two-family house was situated on the property. The brother lived in one of the two apartments and rented the other apartment to a friend. The brother got in a fight with the friend and injured him. The friend obtained and properly filed a judgment for $10,000 against the brother.
The statute in the jurisdiction reads: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for ten years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered."
The sister, who lived in a distant city, knew nothing of the friend's judgment. Before the friend took any further action, the brother died. The common law joint tenancy is unmodified by statute. The sister then learned the facts and brought an appropriate action against the friend to quiet title to the property.
Does the friend have an enforceable judgment lien on the property?

choices.a: No, because the brother's death terminated the interest to which the friend's lien attached.
choices.b: No, because the sister had no actual notice of the friend's judgment until after the brother's death.
choices.c: Yes, because the friend was a tenant of both the brother and sister at the time of the judgment.
choices.d: Yes, but only against the brother's undivided one-half interest in the property, because the friend's judgment was filed prior to the brother's death.

Q86056

A brother and sister owned property as joint tenants. A two-family house was situated on the property. The brother lived in one of the two apartments and rented the other apartment to a friend. The brother got in a fight with the friend and injured him. The friend obtained and properly filed a judgment for $10,000 against the brother.

The statute in the jurisdiction reads: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for ten years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered."

The sister, who lived in a distant city, knew nothing of the friend's judgment. Before the friend took any further action, the brother died. The common law joint tenancy is unmodified by statute. The sister then learned the facts and brought an appropriate action against the friend to quiet title to the property.

Does the friend have an enforceable judgment lien on the property?

一对兄妹以共同共有人的身份拥有一处房产。该房产上建有一栋双户住宅。哥哥住在其中一套公寓，并将另一套公寓出租给一位朋友。哥哥与该朋友发生争执并致其受伤。该朋友获得了针对哥哥的一项金额为10,000美元的判决，并进行了妥善登记。

该司法管辖区的法规规定：“任何妥善登记的判决，自登记之日起十年内，应成为对判决所针对的任何人当时拥有或随后获得的不动产的留置权。”

妹妹住在远方城市，对朋友的判决一无所知。在该朋友采取任何进一步行动之前，哥哥去世了。普通法上的共同共有关系未被法规修改。妹妹随后了解到事实，并对该朋友提起了适当的确认产权诉讼。

该朋友对该房产是否拥有可强制执行的判决留置权？
options:
A. No, because the brother's death terminated the interest to which the friend's lien attached.
否，因为哥哥的死亡终止了朋友留置权所附着的权益。

B. No, because the sister had no actual notice of the friend's judgment until after the brother's death.
否，因为直到哥哥去世后，妹妹才实际得知朋友的判决。

C. Yes, because the friend was a tenant of both the brother and sister at the time of the judgment.
是，因为在判决作出时，该朋友是兄妹二人的租户。

D. Yes, but only against the brother's undivided one-half interest in the property, because the friend's judgment was filed prior to the brother's death.
是，但仅针对哥哥在该房产中不可分割的二分之一权益，因为朋友的判决在哥哥去世前已经登记。
data.explanation:
A joint tenancy is a type of concurrent estate in which each tenant has an equal and undivided interest in the property with the right of survivorship. Under the common law (and in most jurisdictions), the creation and continuation of a joint tenancy depends on the coexistence of four unities (PITT):
  • P ossession - tenants share an equal right to possess or use the property
  • I nterest - tenants each have an equal interest in the property
  • T ime - property interests simultaneously vest in all tenants
  • T itle - property interests received in the same instrument of conveyance
A judgment lien on a joint tenant's interest does not disrupt the four unities because it merely secures payment of a money judgment (ie, the tenancy remains intact). But a forced sale of the encumbered property (eg, foreclosure) does sever the tenancy - and creates a tenancy in common - since the sale disrupts the unities of time and title. However, a joint tenant's property interest disappears upon his/her death and is absorbed by the surviving tenants due to the right of survivorship. Therefore, a judgment lien on the deceased tenant's property interest also disappears (as seen here).

(Choice B) The sister's notice of the friend's judgment has no bearing on the enforceability of his judgment lien on the brother's property interest.

(Choice C) Although the friend rented the apartment from the brother, he was a tenant of both siblings. But his judgment lien only encumbered the brother's property interest and disappeared upon the brother's death.

(Choice D) To create an enforceable judgment lien on a debtor's property, the judgment must be filed while the debtor owns that property. Therefore, the friend obtained an enforceable lien on the brother's one-half interest by filing the judgment before the brother's death. But the lien disappeared when the brother died.

Educational objective: Under a joint tenancy, a deceased tenant's property interest disappears and is absorbed by the surviving tenants due to the right of survivorship. As a result, a judgment lien on the deceased tenant's interest also disappears.



选项正确率统计：A选项 47%（正确选项），B选项 2%，C选项 7%，D选项 42%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

共同共有（joint tenancy）是一种共同产权形式，其中每个共有人对财产拥有平等的、不可分割的权益，并享有生存者权（right of survivorship）。根据普通法（以及大多数司法管辖区），共同共有的设立和存续取决于四个统一体（four unities）（PITT）的共存：
  • P ossession（占有）- 共有人享有平等的占有或使用该财产的权利
  • I nterest（权益）- 每位共有人在该财产中拥有平等的权益
  • T ime（时间）- 财产权益同时归属于所有共有人
  • T itle（产权）- 财产权益通过同一份转让文书获得
对共同共有人权益的判决留置权（judgment lien）不会破坏这四个统一体，因为它仅仅是为了一项金钱判决的支付提供担保（即，共有关系保持不变）。但是，对设有产权负担的财产进行强制出售（例如，止赎）确实会分割（sever）该共有关系——并产生一种分别共有关系——因为出售破坏了时间和产权的统一性。然而，由于生存者权的存在，共同共有人的财产权益在其死亡时即告消灭，并由尚存的共有人吸收。因此，附着于已故共有人财产权益的判决留置权也随之消灭（如此案所示）。

（选项B）妹妹是否知晓朋友的判决，对于该朋友对哥哥财产权益的判决留置权的可执行性没有影响。

（选项C）尽管朋友是从哥哥那里租的公寓，但他是兄妹二人的租户。然而，他的判决留置权只对哥哥的财产权益构成了负担，并在哥哥去世后消灭了。

（选项D）要在债务人的财产上设立可强制执行的判决留置权，判决必须在债务人拥有该财产期间进行登记。因此，通过在哥哥去世前登记判决，朋友获得了对哥哥二分之一权益的可执行留置权。但是，该留置权在哥哥去世时即告消灭。

教学目标：在共同共有关系下，由于生存者权的存在，已故共有人的财产权益会消灭并由尚存的共有人吸收。因此，附着于已故共有人权益的判决留置权也随之消灭。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Joint Tenancy & Liens

✅ 正确答案：A

因为哥哥的死亡终止了朋友留置权所附着的权益。生存者权（Right of Survivorship）优于单纯的判决留置权（Judgment Lien）。

本题考察的是共同共有（Joint Tenancy）的核心特征以及判决留置权（Judgment Lien）对其的影响。

核心法则：生存者权 (Right of Survivorship)

在共同共有关系中，当一名共有人死亡时，其权益自动消失，并被尚存的共有人（Surviving Joint Tenants）吸收。尚存者并非从死者那里“继承”了权益，而是死者的权益单纯地终止了。

关键逻辑链条：

初始状态
哥哥 + 妹妹 = 共同共有 (Joint Tenants)
拥有完整的财产权益
↓
判决登记
朋友获得针对哥哥的判决留置权
留置权仅附着于哥哥的权益上
↓
关键事件：哥哥死亡
哥哥的权益瞬间消失 (Extinguished)
妹妹通过生存者权拥有全部
↓
最终结果
皮之不存，毛将焉附？
哥哥权益消失 → 留置权随之消失
妹妹拥有无负担的房产

为什么留置权没有“分割”共有关系？

这是MBE的一个常见陷阱。

1. 单纯的留置权不分割（Lien does not sever）： 仅仅登记判决（Filing a judgment）通常不足以破坏共同共有的“四个统一体”（Four Unities）。它只是在债务人的权益上设立了一个担保。

2. 需要强制执行（Execution/Levy）： 如果朋友在哥哥生前不仅仅是登记了判决，而是启动了强制执行程序（Levy and Sale），那么这种强制出售行为会分割共有关系，将其转变为按份共有（Tenancy in Common）。

3. 赌博性质： 债权人（朋友）实际上是在与死神赛跑。如果债务人（哥哥）先死，留置权消失；如果债务人先被强制执行，留置权得以实现。本案中，哥哥先死，所以朋友输了。

选项 B 错误 通知（Notice）无关紧要： 妹妹是否知情不影响生存者权的法律效力。
选项 D 错误 最具迷惑性： 很多人认为留置权会“锁定”哥哥的一半权益。但如上所述，除非已经执行（Levy），否则哥哥死后其权益归零，留置权无处附着。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
看到 Joint Tenancy + Lien/Mortgage + Death 的组合时：
  • 如果是抵押 (Mortgage)：在“产权理论州 (Title Theory)”可能导致分割；在“留置权理论州 (Lien Theory)”不分割。MBE通常默认 Lien Theory。
  • 如果是判决留置权 (Judgment Lien)：仅仅登记（Filing）绝不导致分割。
  • 结论： 如果没有发生强制出售，债务人死亡 = 留置权/抵押权（在Lien Theory下）消灭。

The owner of an apartment building leased an apartment to a tenant at a fixed monthly rent for one year. Seven months later, the tenant informed the owner of her intent to vacate the premises. The tenant vacated the premises and did not pay rent for the remaining five months of the lease. The owner did not enter the premises during those five months, and he made no effort to rent the unoccupied space to someone else. Subsequently, the owner sued the tenant for the five months of unpaid rent.
According to the majority rule, is the owner entitled to recover the full amount of this unpaid rent from the tenant?

choices.b: No, because the owner made no effort to rent the apartment to someone else.
choices.c: Yes, because the owner did not retake possession of the leased premises.
choices.d: Yes, because the tenant abandoned her leasehold interest.

一位牧师拥有一块一英亩的空地。五年前，他签署了一份地契，将该土地转让给“我的教会，用于在其上建造一座教堂建筑”。三年前，牧师去世，其儿子是其唯一法定继承人。他经过适当遗嘱认证的遗嘱将“我所有的动产和不动产”留给了“我的朋友”。

该教会从未在该土地上建造教堂建筑，上个月，该教会以有效的对价将该土地转让给了一位房地产开发商。

该房地产开发商对该儿子、朋友和教会提起了适当的确认产权诉讼(action to quiet title)，并将相应的州政府官员列为当事人。该官员主张，一项慈善信托已经设立且尚未终止。

在此诉讼中，法院应判决谁胜诉？
options:
A. The friend.
朋友。

B. The real estate developer.
房地产开发商。

Fee simple estates


TypeLanguageFuture interest
Indefeasible
Fee simple absolute		"To A""To A and his heirs"None
Defeasible, Durational
Fee simple determinable		"so long as""during""until"Grantor's possibility of reverter
Third party's executory interest (i.e., fee simple subject to executory limitation)
Defeasible, Conditional
Fee simple subject to condition subsequent		"but if""provided that""unless"Grantor's right of entry
Like fee simple absolutes (FSAs) and other freehold estates,† defeasible fees are ownership interests in land that last for an indeterminate duration. But unlike FSAs, defeasible fees may be terminated by the happening of a stated event. Defeasible fees are limited by specific durational or conditional language (eg, "so long as," "but if"). However, language that limits only the purpose of the transfer (eg, "for the purpose of") creates an FSA.

Here, the pastor conveyed the land "to my church for the purpose of erecting a church building thereon." This conveyance created an FSA - not a defeasible fee - so the fact that the church never constructed a church building on the land did not terminate its ownership interest in the land. Therefore, the church effectively conveyed the land to the real estate developer, and the real estate developer should win the action.

†To be categorized as a freehold (eg, life estates, estates in fee), an estate must be immobile (eg, land, fixtures) AND last for an indeterminate duration (eg, for the life of X). In contrast, a leasehold is an immobile estate that lasts for a limited duration (eg, 15 years).

(Choices A & C) Had the church's ownership interest in the land terminated and reverted back to the pastor, the friend - not the son - would own the land because the pastor's will left his entire estate to the friend.

(Choice D) A trust is an arrangement in which a trustee holds property at the request of another (settlor) for the benefit of a third party (beneficiary). A charitable trust is one created for a charitable purpose, and it is enforceable by the appropriate state official (ie, the attorney general). But here, no trust was created since the church is the beneficiary and the holder of the property (no trustee).

Educational objective: Defeasible fees are limited by specific durational or conditional language. Language that limits only the purpose of the transfer instead creates a fee simple absolute.

“给A及其继承人”		无
可作废，期限性
可决定终止的完全保有地产权 (Fee simple determinable)		“只要”
“在…期间”
“直到”		转让人的复归可能性
第三方的待执行权益（即，受待执行限制的完全保有地产权 (fee simple subject to executory limitation)）
可作废，条件性
受后决条件限制的完全保有地产权 (Fee simple subject to condition subsequent)		“但是如果”
“条件是”
“除非”		转让人的进入权
与绝对完全保有地产权 (FSAs) 和其他自由保有地产†一样，可作废的保有权 (defeasible fees) 是一种持续时间不定的土地所有权权益。但与 FSAs 不同，可作废的保有权可因某一规定事件的发生而终止。可作废的保有权受特定的期限性或条件性措辞（例如，“只要”、“但是如果”）的限制。然而，仅限制转让目的的措辞（例如，“为了…目的”）则创设了一项绝对完全保有地产权 (FSA)。

在本案中，牧师转让土地时写明“给我的教会，用于在其上建造一座教堂建筑”。这一转让创设了一项绝对完全保有地产权 (FSA) — 而非可作废的保有权 — 因此，教会从未在该土地上建造教堂建筑这一事实，并不会终止其对该土地的所有权权益。因此，教会有效地将土地转让给了房地产开发商，房地产开发商应在该诉讼中胜诉。

†要被归类为自由保有地产（例如，终身地产、完全保有地产），一项地产必须是不可移动的（例如，土地、附着物）并且持续时间不确定（例如，在X的有生之年）。相比之下，租赁保有权是一种持续时间有限的不可移动地产（例如，15年）。

（选项A和C） 假如教会对土地的所有权权益已终止并复归于牧师，那么朋友——而非儿子——将拥有该土地，因为牧师的遗嘱将其全部遗产留给了朋友。

（选项D） 信托是一种安排，其中受托人应另一人（委托人）的要求，为第三方（受益人）的利益持有财产。慈善信托是为慈善目的而设立的信托，可由相应的州政府官员（即，州检察长）强制执行。但在本案中，并未设立信托，因为教会既是受益人也是财产的持有人（没有受托人）。

教学目标： 可作废的保有权受特定的期限性或条件性措辞限制。仅限制转让目的的措辞则创设了绝对完全保有地产权。

References

Restatement of Property § 44 cmt. m (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (discussing designated purpose of conveyance).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Estates in Land
核心考点：转让目的 vs. 限制条件 在不动产转让中，仅仅陈述土地使用的目的（Purpose）或动机（Motive），并不会创设可作废的保有权（Defeasible Fee）。相反，这通常被视为创设了绝对完全保有地产权（Fee Simple Absolute）。

案情逻辑分析

本题的关键在于解读地契中的措辞：

"to my church for the purpose of erecting a church building thereon"

（给我的教会，用于在其上建造一座教堂建筑）

1. 法律定性：
这句话使用了 "for the purpose of"（为了...目的）。在普通法中，这种表达被视为祈使性语言（Precatory Language），它表达了授予人的愿望，但没有施加法律上的强制力或终止条件。

2. 结果：
因为没有使用创设“可作废保有权”所需的特定词汇（如 "so long as", "but if"），教会获得的是绝对完全保有地产权 (Fee Simple Absolute)。

3. 结论：
既然是绝对完全保有权，教会拥有土地的全部权益。即使教会没有建教堂，土地也不会自动复归给牧师的继承人。因此，教会将土地卖给开发商是完全有效的。

类型 关键措辞 (Magic Words) 法律后果
绝对完全保有权
Fee Simple Absolute		 "To A"
"For the purpose of..."
"With the hope that..."		 拥有完整所有权，不受条件限制。
可决定终止的保有权
Fee Simple Determinable		 "So long as"
"While"
"During"		 条件触发时，自动复归 (Automatic Reverter)。
受后决条件限制的保有权
Fee Simple Subject to Condition Subsequent		 "But if"
"Provided that"
"On condition that"		 条件触发时，需行使进入权 (Right of Entry)。

为什么选 B (房地产开发商)？

正确。 因为教会获得了 Fee Simple Absolute，其所有权不因未建教堂而终止。教会拥有合法的处分权，将其卖给了开发商。开发商现在拥有该土地的有效产权。

为什么其他选项错误？

A (朋友) & C (儿子)：
这两个选项都基于一个错误的前提：即教会失去了土地所有权。

如果地契创造的是 Defeasible Fee 且条件已触发，土地会复归给牧师的遗产。由于牧师遗嘱将所有财产留给了朋友，朋友会优于法定继承人（儿子）获得土地。但因为本案中土地从未复归，所以两人都无权。

D (州政府官员)：
州官员主张存在慈善信托 (Charitable Trust)。虽然信托可以由州检察长（Attorney General）强制执行，但本案中并没有设立信托的意图。

仅仅将财产赠予慈善机构（教会）并说明用途，通常被视为绝对赠与 (Outright Gift)，而不是设立信托。除非有明确证据表明授予人意图让教会作为受托人（Trustee）持有财产，否则不构成信托。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

在 Real Property 题目中，法院倾向于促进土地的自由流转 (Free Alienation of Land)。

因此，如果地契语言模棱两可（例如只是表达目的、愿望），法院几乎总是将其解释为 Fee Simple Absolute，而不是可能会导致土地所有权丧失的 Defeasible Fee。

口诀：没有 "So long as" 或 "But if"，通常就不是条件！

questions.question:
An elderly woman had two children, a son and daughter. In the months before the woman's death, the son had lived in the woman's home and cared for her. Although the daughter had provided no assistance to the woman, both children inherited the woman's home upon her death and became tenants in common.
The son continued to live in the woman's home and paid all taxes, insurance, and other carrying charges on the property. The daughter never visited the property and did not seek rent or other compensation from the son until they got into a heated dispute 15 years later.
The son has filed an action to quiet title and claims that he owns the property in fee simple. The period of time to acquire title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 10 years.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.a: The daughter, because one co-tenant cannot acquire title by adverse possession against another.
choices.b: The daughter, because there is no evidence that the son has ousted the daughter.
choices.c: The son, because he has acquired title in fee simple by adverse possession.
choices.d: The son, because the parties' acts indicate the daughter's intention to renounce her inheritance.

data.questionStem:
Q86066

An elderly woman had two children, a son and daughter. In the months before the woman's death, the son had lived in the woman's home and cared for her. Although the daughter had provided no assistance to the woman, both children inherited the woman's home upon her death and became tenants in common.

The son continued to live in the woman's home and paid all taxes, insurance, and other carrying charges on the property. The daughter never visited the property and did not seek rent or other compensation from the son until they got into a heated dispute 15 years later.

The son has filed an action to quiet title and claims that he owns the property in fee simple. The period of time to acquire title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 10 years.

Who is likely to prevail?

一位年迈的妇人有两个孩子，一个儿子和一个女儿。在该妇人去世前的几个月里，儿子一直住在她的家里并照顾她。尽管女儿没有向妇人提供任何帮助，但在她去世后，两个孩子都继承了她的房屋，并成为共同共有人 (tenants in common)。

儿子继续住在这所房子里，并支付了该房产的所有税款、保险费和其他持有费用。女儿从未探访过该房产，也未向儿子索要租金或其他补偿，直到15年后他们发生激烈争执。

儿子提起了确认产权诉讼 (action to quiet title)，并声称他拥有该房产的完全所有权 (fee simple)。在该司法管辖区，通过侵权逆占 (adverse possession) 取得所有权的法定时效为10年。

谁可能胜诉？
options:
A. The daughter, because one co-tenant cannot acquire title by adverse possession against another.
女儿，因为一个共同共有人不能通过侵权逆占来对抗另一个共同共有人从而获得所有权。

B. The daughter, because there is no evidence that the son has ousted the daughter.
女儿，因为没有证据表明儿子已经驱逐 (ousted) 了女儿。

C. The son, because he has acquired title in fee simple by adverse possession.
儿子，因为他已经通过侵权逆占取得了完全所有权 (fee simple)。

D. The son, because the parties' acts indicate the daughter's intention to renounce her inheritance.
儿子，因为双方的行为表明女儿意图放弃其继承权。
data.explanation:
Adverse possession allows a person to acquire title to another's property when his/her possession of the land is:

Adverse Possession (OCEAN)


Open and notoriousapparent or visible to a reasonable owner
Continuousuninterrupted for the statutory period
Exclusivenot shared with the owner
Actualphysical presence on the land
Nonpermissivehostile and adverse to the owner
But for a co-tenant to acquire sole ownership of co-owned property through adverse possession, he/she must also oust the other co-tenants. This is done by preventing them from using or accessing the property (eg, changing the locks, constructing a fence, physical removal) (Choice A).

Here, the son (co-tenant) lived alone on the property and paid all taxes, insurance, and other carrying charges for more than the 10-year statutory period. But since he took no action to prevent the daughter (other co-tenant) from using the property, he did not oust her. Therefore, he never acquired sole ownership by adverse possession, and the daughter will likely prevail (Choice C).

(Choice D) An inheritance can only be renounced if the recipient unequivocally rejects the inheritance within a reasonable time after learning of it. Actions that merely indicate an intent to renounce are not sufficient. Therefore, the parties' actions - absent an explicit rejection - did not eliminate the daughter's right to the inherited property.

Educational objective: A co-tenant can acquire sole ownership of co-owned property through adverse possession if he/she ousts the other co-tenants by preventing them from using or accessing the property (and meets all other requirements for adverse possession).



选项正确率统计：A选项 35%，B选项 54%（正确选项），C选项 8%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

侵权逆占 (Adverse possession) 允许一个人在其对土地的占有符合以下条件时，取得他人财产的所有权：

侵权逆占 (Adverse Possession) (OCEAN)


公开且众所周知 (Open and notorious)对一个理性的所有者来说是显而易见的
持续 (Continuous)在法定时效期间内不间断
排他 (Exclusive)不与所有者共享
实际 (Actual)实际占有该土地
非经许可 (Nonpermissive)对所有者具有敌意和对抗性
但是，对于一个共同共有人 (co-tenant) 来说，要通过侵权逆占获得共同所有财产的唯一所有权，他/她还必须驱逐 (oust) 其他共同共有人。这需要通过阻止他们使用或进入该财产（例如，更换门锁、建造围栏、物理驱离）来实现（选项 A）。

在本案中，儿子（共同共有人）独自居住在该房产上，并支付了所有税款、保险费和其他持有费用，时间超过了10年的法定时效。但由于他没有采取任何行动阻止女儿（另一共同共有人）使用该房产，因此他并未驱逐她。因此，他从未通过侵权逆占获得唯一所有权，女儿很可能胜诉（选项 C）。

（选项 D）只有在继承人在得知继承后的合理时间内明确地拒绝继承，继承才能被放弃。仅仅表示放弃意图的行为是不够的。因此，在没有明确拒绝的情况下，双方的行为并未消除女儿对所继承财产的权利。

教学目标：如果一个共同共有人通过阻止其他共同共有人使用或进入财产的方式驱逐了他们（并满足侵权逆占的所有其他要求），那么他/她就可以通过侵权逆占获得共同所有财产的唯一所有权。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Adverse Possession
核心法律规则：驱逐 (Ouster)

在共同共有 (Tenancy in Common) 关系中，一个共有人要通过侵权逆占 (Adverse Possession) 取得另一个共有人的产权，仅有“独占使用”是不够的，必须发生明确的驱逐 (Ouster)。

📝 案情逻辑推演

1. 默认规则：占有即共享
法律假定，任何一个共同共有人 (Co-tenant) 对房产的占有，都是代表所有共有人进行的。因此，儿子的居住通常被视为也代表了女儿的权益。这种占有在法律上不具有敌意 (Not Hostile)。
2. 仅仅支付费用 ≠ 敌意占有
儿子支付税款、保险费等 (Carrying charges)，被视为他在行使作为共有人的管理职责，或者作为他独占使用房产的对价，但这并不构成对女儿产权的否认。
3. 关键缺失：驱逐 (Ouster)
要启动侵权逆占的时效，儿子必须采取行动阻止女儿进入或使用房产（例如换锁并拒绝给钥匙、明确告知“这是我的房子，你滚出去”）。

结论 题目中明确指出儿子没有阻止女儿使用房产，因此没有发生 Ouster，10年的时效从未开始计算。

🔍 选项深度解析

选项 分析
A
法律错误 		错误观点：共有人之间永远不能逆占。
修正：共有人可以逆占，但门槛很高，必须证明发生了 Ouster。
B
正确答案 		正确理由：直接击中考点。没有证据表明儿子驱逐了女儿 (No Ouster)，因此逆占要素中的“敌意 (Hostile)”不成立。
C
事实错误 		虽然时间超过10年，但由于缺乏敌意占有的起始点 (Ouster)，儿子并未获得 Fee Simple。
D
概念混淆 		放弃继承 (Renunciation) 需要明确的书面行为或法庭程序。仅仅是不访问、不收租金，在法律上不构成放弃产权。
💡 MBE 避坑指南 在处理 Co-tenants 之间的 Adverse Possession 问题时：
  • 看到 "Sole possession" (独自居住) → 不够。
  • 看到 "Paying all taxes" (支付所有税费) → 不够。
  • 必须寻找 "Prevented entry" (阻止进入) 或 "Refused access" (拒绝访问) 等明确表示 Ouster 的行为。

questions.question:
A manicurist entered into a one-year agreement to lease a nail salon from a landlord. During the first six months of the lease, the plumbing in the building functioned properly. During the seventh month, a pipe under the bathroom sink began leaking over a three-day weekend, causing flooding throughout the nail salon. The manicurist took reasonable steps to mitigate damages, including turning off the water to the bathroom sink and cleaning up the excess water to prevent water damage to the floors. The manicurist was still able to operate the nail salon despite the leaking pipe but not at full capacity. She notified the landlord about the leaking pipe, but the landlord refused to repair the faulty plumbing. The manicurist refused to pay the following month's rent, and the landlord has filed a breach-of-contract action against her.
For whom is the court likely to decide?

choices.a: For the landlord, because he did not have a duty to repair the plumbing.
choices.b: For the landlord, because the implied covenant of quiet enjoyment does not apply to commercial leases.
choices.c: For the manicurist, because she took reasonable steps to mitigate damages.
choices.d: For the manicurist, because the leaking pipe resulted in a constructive eviction.

questions.question:
A man owned adjoining lots (Lot 1 and Lot 2) in fee simple. He built a house in which he took up residence on Lot 1. Thereafter, he built a house on Lot 2, which he sold, house and lot, to his brother. Consistent with the contract of sale and purchase, a valid deed conveying Lot 2 from the man to the brother contained the following clause:
"In the event my brother, his heirs or assigns, decide to sell the property hereby conveyed and obtain a purchaser ready, willing, and able to purchase Lot 2 and the improvements thereon on terms and conditions acceptable to my brother, said Lot 2 and improvements shall be offered to me, my heirs or assigns, on the same terms and conditions. I, my heirs or assigns, as the case may be, shall have ten days from said offer to accept said offer and thereby to exercise said option."
Three years after delivery and recording of the deed and payment of the purchase price, the brother became ill and moved to a climate more compatible with his health. The brother's daughter orally offered to purchase the premises from him at its then fair market value. The brother declined his daughter's offer but instead deeded Lot 2 to his daughter as a gift.
Immediately thereafter, the daughter sold Lot 2 to her friend at the then fair market value of Lot 2. The sale was completed by the delivery of deed and payment of the purchase price. At no time did the brother or his daughter offer to sell Lot 2 to the man.
The man learned of the conveyance to the daughter and the sale to the friend one week after the conveyance of Lot 2 from the daughter to the friend. The man promptly brought an appropriate action against the friend to enforce rights created in him by the deed of the man to the brother. The man tendered the amount paid by the friend into the court for whatever disposition the court deemed proper.
The common-law Rule Against Perpetuities is unmodified by statute.
Which of the following will determine whether the man will prevail?

choices.a: The parol evidence rule only.
choices.b: The parol evidence rule and the Rule Against Perpetuities.
choices.c: The Rule Against Perpetuities only.
choices.d: The statute of frauds and the type of recording statute of the jurisdiction in question.

A man owned adjoining lots (Lot 1 and Lot 2) in fee simple. He built a house in which he took up residence on Lot 1. Thereafter, he built a house on Lot 2, which he sold, house and lot, to his brother. Consistent with the contract of sale and purchase, a valid deed conveying Lot 2 from the man to the brother contained the following clause:

"In the event my brother, his heirs or assigns, decide to sell the property hereby conveyed and obtain a purchaser ready, willing, and able to purchase Lot 2 and the improvements thereon on terms and conditions acceptable to my brother, said Lot 2 and improvements shall be offered to me, my heirs or assigns, on the same terms and conditions. I, my heirs or assigns, as the case may be, shall have ten days from said offer to accept said offer and thereby to exercise said option."

Three years after delivery and recording of the deed and payment of the purchase price, the brother became ill and moved to a climate more compatible with his health. The brother's daughter orally offered to purchase the premises from him at its then fair market value. The brother declined his daughter's offer but instead deeded Lot 2 to his daughter as a gift.

Immediately thereafter, the daughter sold Lot 2 to her friend at the then fair market value of Lot 2. The sale was completed by the delivery of deed and payment of the purchase price. At no time did the brother or his daughter offer to sell Lot 2 to the man.

The man learned of the conveyance to the daughter and the sale to the friend one week after the conveyance of Lot 2 from the daughter to the friend. The man promptly brought an appropriate action against the friend to enforce rights created in him by the deed of the man to the brother. The man tendered the amount paid by the friend into the court for whatever disposition the court deemed proper.

The common-law Rule Against Perpetuities is unmodified by statute.

Which of the following will determine whether the man will prevail?

一名男子以完全所有权（fee simple）拥有相邻地块（地块1和地块2）。他在地块1上建造了一座房屋并居住于此。此后，他在地块2上建造了一座房屋，并将房屋和地块一同出售给了他的兄弟。根据买卖合同，一份将地块2从该男子转让给其兄弟的有效契约包含以下条款：

“若我的兄弟、其继承人或受让人决定出售本协议转让的财产，并找到一位准备好、愿意且有能力按我兄弟可接受的条款和条件购买地块2及其上附着物的买家，则上述地块2及其附着物应以相同的条款和条件向我、我的继承人或受让人发出要约（offer）。我、我的继承人或受让人（视情况而定）应在收到上述要约之日起十天内接受该要约，从而行使该选择权。”

在契约交付、登记并支付购买价款三年后，该兄弟生病并搬到一个气候更适合其健康的地方。该兄弟的女儿口头要约（offer）以当时的市场公允价值向他购买该房产。该兄弟拒绝了他女儿的要约，而是将地块2作为赠与过户给了他的女儿。

此后，该女儿立即以当时地块2的市场公允价值将其出售给了她的朋友。此次出售通过交付契约和支付购买价款完成。该兄弟或其女儿从未向该男子要约出售地块2。

在该女儿将地块2转让给朋友一周后，该男子得知了此次转让和出售事宜。该男子立即对该朋友提起了适当的诉讼，以强制执行由他与兄弟之间的契约赋予他的权利。该男子将朋友支付的款项提存至法院，以供法院做出其认为适当的处置。

普通法上的 Rule Against Perpetuities 未被成文法修改。

以下哪项将决定该男子是否会胜诉？
options:
A. The parol evidence rule only.
仅限口头证据规则。

B. The parol evidence rule and the Rule Against Perpetuities.
口头证据规则和 Rule Against Perpetuities。

C. The Rule Against Perpetuities only.
仅限 Rule Against Perpetuities。

D. The statute of frauds and the type of recording statute of the jurisdiction in question.
防止欺诈法和该司法管辖区的登记法规类型。
data.explanation:
The Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP) applies only to contingent future interests - ie, future interests that are held by unknown/unborn persons or subject to a condition precedent. A right of first refusal is a contractual right to purchase property before any other person if the owner later decides to sell, so it must comply with RAP.

Under the common-law RAP, a contingent future interest is void ab initio (ie, from the beginning) if there is any possibility that it could vestmore than 21 years after some relevant life in being at the creation of the interest. Therefore, a right of first refusal almost always violates RAP if the conveying instrument does not provide a termination date † that falls within the perpetuities period.

Here, there is no termination date for the man's right of first refusal. As a result, it is possible that the right of first refusal may not vest until after the perpetuities period - ie, more than 21 years after the man and brother have died. Since this RAP violation renders the man's right of first refusal invalid, RAP determines whether he will prevail in this action.

†A termination date can be set by a temporal limitation (eg, calendar date) or by reference to a life in being (eg, within 21 years of grantee's death).

(Choices A & B) The parol evidence rule generally bars evidence of a prior agreement to modify or contradict the terms of a final written agreement. But here, the man is seeking to enforce not a prior agreement but the purchase option specified in the deed.

(Choice D) The statute of frauds renders certain contracts, including contracts for the sale of land, unenforceable unless they are in writing and signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought. Additionally, recording statutes protect earlier-recorded property interests against subsequent purchasers. But neither will protect the man's contingent future interest from being invalidated by RAP.

Educational objective: The Rule Against Perpetuities applies to contingent future interests, including a right of first refusal. This contractual right violates RAP if it is not set to terminate within 21 years after some relevant life in being at the creation of the interest.



选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 6%，C选项 45%（正确选项），D选项 41%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP) 仅适用于附条件的未来权益——即由未知/未出生的人持有或受限于先决条件的未来权益。优先购买权是一种合同权利，即如果所有者日后决定出售财产，该权利人有权在任何其他人之前购买，因此它必须遵守 RAP。

根据普通法上的 RAP，如果一项附条件的未来权益有任何可能在权益创设时某一相关在世人死亡超过21年后才归属，则该权益自始无效（即从一开始就无效）。因此，如果转让文书未提供一个落在永久存续期内的终止日期†，则优先购买权几乎总是违反 RAP。

在本案中，该男子的优先购买权没有终止日期。因此，该优先购买权有可能直到永久存续期之后——即在该男子和兄弟去世超过21年后——才可能归属。由于违反 RAP 导致该男子的优先购买权无效，因此 RAP 决定了他是否能在此次诉讼中胜诉。

†终止日期可以通过时间限制（例如，日历日期）或参照在世人（例如，在受让人死亡后21年内）来设定。

（选项A和B）口头证据规则通常禁止使用先前协议的证据来修改或反驳最终书面协议的条款。但在本案中，该男子寻求强制执行的并非先前的协议，而是契约中规定的购买选择权。

（选项D）防止欺诈法规定某些合同，包括土地买卖合同，除非采用书面形式并由被要求执行的一方签署，否则不可强制执行。此外，登记法规保护已登记的财产权益免受后续购买者的侵害。但这两者都无法保护该男子的附条件未来权益不因 RAP 而无效。

教学目标：Rule Against Perpetuities 适用于附条件的未来权益，包括优先购买权。如果该合同权利未被设定在权益创设时某一相关在世人死亡后21年内终止，则其违反 RAP。

References

61 Am. Jur. 2d Perpetuities and Restraints on Alienation § 5 (2020) (Rule Against Perpetuities).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property (不动产法)

🎯 核心考点：Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP)

本题考察的是反永久占有规则（RAP）对优先购买权（Right of First Refusal）的适用性。

1. 识别权利类型

题目中的条款赋予了卖方（Man）一项权利：如果买方（Brother）决定出售土地，必须先向卖方要约。这在法律上被称为 Right of First Refusal（优先购买权）。

2. 法律规则适用

在普通法下，优先购买权被视为一种附条件的未来权益（Contingent Future Interest）。因此，它必须遵守 Rule Against Perpetuities。

  • RAP 规则：权益必须在“设立时的在世之人的寿命 + 21年”内归属（vest）或失效。
  • 违规后果：如果存在任何可能性（哪怕是理论上的），该权益在上述期限后才归属，则该权益自始无效（Void ab initio）。
3. 结合本案事实

请注意契约中的措辞：

"...In the event my brother, his heirs or assigns... said Lot 2... shall be offered to me, my heirs or assigns..."

这里使用了“继承人或受让人”（heirs or assigns），且没有设定时间限制。

这意味着：

  • 该权利可能在几百年后，当双方的曾曾孙子决定出售土地时才被触发。
  • 这显然超过了“在世人寿命 + 21年”的期限。
⚖️ 结论：
该优先购买权违反了 RAP，因此自始无效。
决定胜诉与否的关键是 RAP。
正确答案：C
为何其他选项错误？

❌ A & B (Parol Evidence Rule): 口头证据规则用于排除与书面合同矛盾的先前口头协议。本案中，男子依据的是契约（Deed）中的书面条款，而非口头协议，因此该规则不适用。

❌ D (Statute of Frauds/Recording):
  • 防止欺诈法要求土地合同必须书面（本案已有书面契约）。
  • 登记法规涉及对抗第三人（本案契约已登记）。
虽然这些都很重要，但它们无法挽救一个因违反 RAP 而本质上无效的条款。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 不动产题目中，如果你看到：

  1. 购买选择权 (Option to Purchase) 或 优先购买权 (Right of First Refusal)；
  2. 且条款中包含 "heirs and assigns"（及于继承人和受让人）；
  3. 且没有明确的截止日期（如“21年内”）；

请立即联想 RAP。这通常是导致该权利无效的原因。

© MBE Study Guide | Real Property Q86044

questions.question:
A husband owned a farm of 300 acres in fee simple. He died and by will duly admitted to probate devised the farm to his surviving widow for life with remainder in fee simple to his three children (twin sons and a daughter). All three children survived the husband.
At the time of the husband's death, there existed a mortgage on the farm that the husband had given 10 years before to secure a loan for the purchase of the farm. At his death, there remained unpaid $40,000 in principal, payable in installments of $4,000 per year for the next 10 years. In addition, there was due interest at the rate of 10% per annum, payable annually with the installment of principal. The widow took possession and out of a gross income of $50,000 per year realized $25,000 net after paying all expenses and charges except the installment of principal and interest due on the mortgage.
The twin sons wanted the three children, including the daughter, to each contribute one-third of the amounts needed to pay the mortgage installments. The daughter objected, contending that the widow should pay all of these amounts out of the profits she had made in operation of the farm. When foreclosure of the mortgage seemed imminent, the daughter sought legal advice.
If the daughter obtained sound advice relating to her rights, what was she told?

choices.a: Her only protection would lie in instituting an action for partition to compel the sale of the life estate of the widow and to obtain the value of the daughter's one-third interest in remainder.
choices.b: She could be compelled personally to pay her share of the amounts due because discharge of the mortgage enhances the principal.
choices.c: She could not be held personally liable for any amount but her share in remainder could be lost if the mortgage installments are not paid.
choices.d: She could obtain appropriate relief to compel the widow personally to pay the sums due because the income is more than adequate to cover these amounts.
