data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Future Interests
✅ 正确答案：B

朋友拥有终身地产权，慈善机构拥有既定剩余地产权。

⚖️ 权益流转图解
原始授予 (Grant)
朋友：终身地产权 (Life Estate)
邻居：既定剩余权 (Vested Remainder)
⬇️
邻居去世 (Neighbor Dies)
有遗嘱 (Will) ➡️ 赠与慈善机构
⬇️
当前状态
朋友：持有终身地产权
慈善机构：持有剩余权
🔍 核心法律分析
1️⃣
既定剩余权的可处分性
Vested Remainder 是完全的财产权益。它具有以下三个特征：
  • 可生前转让 (Alienable)
  • 可遗嘱处分 (Devisable)
  • 可被继承 (Descendible)
在本案中，邻居拥有既定剩余权。当她去世时，该权益通过遗嘱合法转移给了慈善机构。
2️⃣
限制性词语 vs. 购买词语
题目中 "to neighbor and her heirs" 是经典的陷阱。

Words of Limitation： "and her heirs" 仅表示邻居获得的是完全简单所有权 (Fee Simple) 的剩余权，而不是仅仅给她个人的终身权益。

这并不意味着邻居的继承人直接获得了权益。继承人只有在邻居无遗嘱死亡 (Intestate) 时才有希望继承。但本案中邻居有遗嘱，所以女儿一无所获。
🚫 为什么女儿的 Quitclaim Deed 无效？（排除 A & C） 因为邻居留有遗嘱将财产给了慈善机构，女儿作为继承人（Heir）没有继承到任何东西。
既然女儿对这块土地没有任何权益，她签署的 Quitclaim Deed（放弃索赔契据）就是空的，不能将任何权益转让给朋友。因此，朋友的终身地产权无法与剩余权合并 (Merger)。
🚫 反永久所有权规则 (RAP) 适用吗？（排除 D） 不适用。 RAP 通常不适用于授予给已出生且可识别之人的既定剩余权 (Indefeasibly Vested Remainder)。邻居是确定的在世之人，她的权益在设立时就已经既定 (Vested)，不存在“可能在21年后才既定”的风险。
💡 MBE 提分技巧

看到 "and his/her heirs" 时，请立即在脑海中划掉它，并标记为“这是 Fee Simple 的标志，不是给继承人的礼物”。

时刻关注当事人是有遗嘱 (Testate) 还是无遗嘱 (Intestate) 死亡。遗嘱优先于法定继承。

questions.question:
A landowner died, validly devising his land to his wife "for life or until remarriage, then to" their daughter. Shortly after the landowner's death, his daughter executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed, purporting to convey the land to her friend. A year later, the daughter died intestate, with her mother, the original landowner's wife, as her sole heir. The following month, the wife remarried. The wife then executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed, purporting to convey the land to her new husband as a wedding gift.
Who now owns what interest in the land?

choices.a: The daughter's friend owns the fee simple.
choices.b: The wife owns the fee simple.
choices.c: The wife's new husband has a life estate in the land for the wife's life, with the remainder in the daughter's friend.
choices.d: The wife's new husband owns the fee simple.

data.questionStem:
Q86098

A landowner died, validly devising his land to his wife "for life or until remarriage, then to" their daughter. Shortly after the landowner's death, his daughter executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed, purporting to convey the land to her friend. A year later, the daughter died intestate, with her mother, the original landowner's wife, as her sole heir. The following month, the wife remarried. The wife then executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed, purporting to convey the land to her new husband as a wedding gift.

Who now owns what interest in the land?

一位土地所有人去世，通过有效遗嘱将其土地遗赠给其妻子，“终身持有或直至再婚，然后归于”他们的女儿。土地所有人去世后不久，其女儿签署了一份符合法定格式的地契文书，意图将该土地转让给她的朋友。一年后，女儿无遗嘱死亡，其母亲，即原土地所有人的妻子，是其唯一继承人。次月，该妻子再婚。随后，妻子签署了一份符合法定格式的地契文书，意图将该土地作为结婚礼物转让给她的新任丈夫。

现在谁对该土地拥有何种权益？
options:
A. The daughter's friend owns the fee simple.
女儿的朋友拥有该土地的 fee simple。

B. The wife owns the fee simple.
妻子拥有该土地的 fee simple。

C. The wife's new husband has a life estate in the land for the wife's life, with the remainder in the daughter's friend.
妻子的新任丈夫拥有以妻子生命为期的终身地产权(life estate)，剩余权益归女儿的朋友所有。

D. The wife's new husband owns the fee simple.
妻子的新任丈夫拥有该土地的 fee simple。
data.explanation:
A defeasible life estate is a present interest that terminates upon the death of an individual OR the happening of a stated event. The future- interest holder (ie, remainderman) acquires possession of the estate when the death or event occurs. Future interests are alienable - ie, the remainderman can freely convey that interest.

Here, the landowner devised a defeasible life estate in the land to his wife, which would pass to their daughter upon the wife's death or remarriage. Therefore, the daughter had a future interest that she properly conveyed to a friend, making the friend the new remainderman. When the wife remarried (and terminated her life estate), the land automatically transferred to the remainderman - the friend - in fee simple.

(Choices B & D) The wife had a defeasible life estate - not a fee simple - that ended when she remarried. As a result, the wife could only acquire a fee simple (or convey it to her new husband) if she inherited the daughter's future interest. Since the daughter did not hold the future interest when she died (she had already conveyed it to her friend), that interest never passed to the wife. Therefore, neither the wife nor the new husband owns the fee simple.

(Choice C) Since the wife's life estate terminated as soon as she remarried, she did not have a property interest to deed to the new husband. As a result, the new husband does not have an interest in the land.

Educational objective: A future interest that follows a defeasible life estate becomes possessory upon the death of an individual or the happening of a stated event. Future interests are alienable, meaning that the future-interest holder (ie, remainderman) can freely convey his/her interest.



选项正确率统计：A选项 66%（正确选项），B选项 4%，C选项 7%，D选项 21%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

一份可废止的终身地产权 (defeasible life estate) 是一种当前权益，它会在个人死亡或特定事件发生时终止。当死亡或事件发生时，未来权益持有人（即剩余权益人）获得对该地产权的占有。未来权益是可转让的——即，剩余权益人可以自由转让该权益。

在本案中，土地所有人通过遗嘱将其土地上的一份可废止的终身地产权遗赠给其妻子，该地产权将在妻子死亡或再婚时转移给他们的女儿。因此，女儿拥有一份未来权益，她已合法地将该权益转让给一位朋友，使该朋友成为新的剩余权益人。当妻子再婚时（并因此终止了她的终身地产权），土地便自动以 fee simple 的形式转移给剩余权益人——即那位朋友。

（选项 B & D）妻子拥有的是一份可废止的终身地产权——而非 fee simple——该权益在她再婚时即告终止。因此，妻子只有在继承了女儿的未来权益的情况下，才能获得 fee simple（或将其转让给她的新任丈夫）。由于女儿去世时并未持有该未来权益（她已将其转让给了她的朋友），该权益从未转移给妻子。因此，妻子和她的新任丈夫都不拥有该土地的 fee simple。

（选项 C）由于妻子的终身地产权(life estate)在她一再婚时就已终止，她没有任何财产权益可以通过地契转让给新任丈夫。因此，新任丈夫在该土地上不享有任何权益。

教学目标：继可废止的终身地产权(defeasible life estate)之后的未来权益，在个人死亡或特定事件发生时，即转为占有性权益。未来权益是可转让的，意味着未来权益持有人（即剩余权益人）可以自由转让其权益。

References

  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Wills & Other Donative Transfers § 24.5 (Am. Law Inst. 2011) (life estates).
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Wills & Other Donative Transfers § 25.2 (Am. Law Inst. 2011) (reversions and remainders).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Future Interests
核心考点：未来权益的可转让性

本题考察的是既得剩余权益 (Vested Remainder) 的性质及其在持有者生前的转让能力 (Alienability)。

案件逻辑推演 (Timeline Analysis)

1. 遗嘱生效 (Creation)
Wife (W): 获得可废止终身地产权 (Defeasible Life Estate)。
Daughter (D): 获得既得剩余权益 (Vested Remainder)。
2. 女儿转让权益 (Conveyance)
D 将其权益通过地契转让给 Friend (F)。
关键点：未来权益是可转让的 (Alienable)。此时 F 拥有了剩余权益。
3. 女儿去世 (Death of D)
D 无遗嘱死亡，W 是继承人。
陷阱：因为 D 生前已将土地权益卖给了 F，所以 D 死时名下无该土地权益，W 无法继承该权益。
4. 妻子再婚 (Remarriage)
触发了 "until remarriage" 条款。
W 的终身地产权自动终止。土地所有权自动转移给剩余权益持有人，即 F。
5. 妻子转让给新丈夫 (Invalid Deed)
W 试图将土地赠予 New Husband。
但此时 W 的权益已终止，她没有任何权益可以转让。

深度解析

1. 权益的定性
遗嘱中 "for life or until remarriage" 创造了一个可废止的终身地产权 (Defeasible Life Estate)。这意味着 W 的权益会在她死亡 或者 再婚时终止，以先发生者为准。
2. 剩余权益的自由转让 (Alienability)
D 拥有的是既得剩余权益 (Vested Remainder)。在普通法下，既得剩余权益是完全可转让的财产权益。当 D 签署地契给 F 时，F 立即成为了新的剩余权益持有人 (Remainderman)。
3. 继承的空缺 (Nemo Dat)
这是一个经典的 "Nemo dat quod non habet" (没有人可以给予他所没有的东西) 变体。虽然 W 是 D 的继承人，但 D 去世时已经不拥有该土地的任何权益（因为已经卖给了 F）。因此，W 没有从 D 那里继承到任何关于这块土地的权利。
正确答案：A
女儿的朋友 (Friend) 拥有 Fee Simple。
为什么其他选项错误？
  • 选项 B & D (Wife/Husband owns Fee Simple): 错误。W 的权益因再婚而终止。她没有从女儿那里继承到剩余权益，因此她无法获得 Fee Simple，也无法将其转让给新丈夫。
  • 选项 C (Husband has Life Estate): 错误。W 的 Life Estate 在她再婚的那一刻就消失了。她不能将一个已经失效的权益转让给新丈夫。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在做 Real Property 题目时，务必画出权益链条图。特别注意时间顺序：如果剩余权益 (Remainder) 在持有人死亡前已经被转让 (Conveyed)，那么该权益就不会进入持有人的遗产 (Estate) 被继承。

questions.question:
A landlord and a tenant orally agreed to a commercial tenancy for a term of six months beginning on July 1. Rent was to be paid by the first day of each month, and the tenant paid the first month's rent at the time of the agreement.
When the tenant arrived at the leased premises on July 1, he learned that the previous tenant had not vacated the premises at the end of her lease term on May 31 and did not intend to vacate. The tenant then successfully sued the previous tenant for possession. The tenant did not inform the landlord of the eviction action until after the tenant received possession.
The tenant then sued the landlord, claiming damages for that portion of the lease period during which the tenant was not in possession.
If the court finds for the landlord, what will be the most likely explanation?

choices.a: By suing the previous tenant for possession, the tenant elected that remedy in lieu of a suit against the landlord.
choices.b: The landlord had delivered the legal right of possession to the tenant.
choices.c: The tenant failed to timely vacate as required to sue for constructive eviction.
choices.d: The tenant had not notified the landlord before bringing the eviction action.

data.questionStem:
Q86036

A landlord and a tenant orally agreed to a commercial tenancy for a term of six months beginning on July 1. Rent was to be paid by the first day of each month, and the tenant paid the first month's rent at the time of the agreement.

When the tenant arrived at the leased premises on July 1, he learned that the previous tenant had not vacated the premises at the end of her lease term on May 31 and did not intend to vacate. The tenant then successfully sued the previous tenant for possession. The tenant did not inform the landlord of the eviction action until after the tenant received possession.

The tenant then sued the landlord, claiming damages for that portion of the lease period during which the tenant was not in possession.

If the court finds for the landlord, what will be the most likely explanation?

一位房东和一位租户口头约定了一项为期六个月的商业租赁，自7月1日开始。租金应在每月第一天支付，租户在协议签订时支付了第一个月的租金。

当租户于7月1日到达租赁物业时，他得知前租户在5月31日租期结束后并未搬离该物业，且无意搬离。该租户随后成功起诉前租户，要求获得占有权。在该租户获得占有权之后，他才将此驱逐诉讼告知房东。

之后，该租户起诉房东，就其未能占有物业的那部分租期主张损害赔偿。

如果法院作出有利于房东的裁决，最可能的解释是什么？
options:
A. By suing the previous tenant for possession, the tenant elected that remedy in lieu of a suit against the landlord.
通过起诉前租户以获得占有权，租户选择了该救济方式，以替代对房东的诉讼。

B. The landlord had delivered the legal right of possession to the tenant.
房东已向租户交付了占有的合法权利。

C. The tenant failed to timely vacate as required to sue for constructive eviction.
租户未能按照推定驱逐诉讼的要求及时搬离。

D. The tenant had not notified the landlord before bringing the eviction action.
租户在提起驱逐诉讼前未通知房东。
data.explanation:
Landlord's duty to deliver possession


RequirementsRemedies for breach
English rule
(majority)		Deliver actual possession to tenant - ie, remove third party who wrongfully possesses property
  • Withhold rent to acquire possession
  • Seek damages for period not in possession
  • Terminate lease
American rule
(minority)		Deliver legal possession to tenant - ie, ensure that no third party has a right to possess property
A landlord must generally deliver actual possession of leased premises to the tenant at the start of the lease term - ie, by removing any third party who wrongfully possesses the property (eg, a holdover tenant). If the landlord fails to do so, the tenant can recover damages from the landlord for the time when the tenant was not in possession. However, a minority of jurisdictions only require a landlord to deliver legal possession - ie, by ensuring that no third party has a right to possess the property when the lease term begins.

Here, the landlord leased property to the tenant for six months beginning on July 1. When the tenant arrived at the leased premises on July 1, he learned that the previous tenant had not vacated the premises (ie, the landlord failed to deliver actual possession). And since the previous tenant's lease ended on May 31, she was a holdover tenant who had no right to possess the property on July 1. Therefore, the most likely reason for a finding in the landlord's favor is that this court follows the minority rule and the landlord had delivered legal possession to the tenant.

(Choices A & D) A tenant does not waive any claim against the landlord by (1) suing a third party (eg, the previous tenant) for possession of the premises or (2) failing to notify the landlord before evicting the third party. As a result, the court will not find for the landlord on either basis.

(Choice C) To sue a landlord for constructive eviction - a landlord's substantial interference with a tenant's permissible use and enjoyment of the property - the tenant must notify the landlord and then vacate the premises within a reasonable time. But a failure to vacate does not prevent a tenant from suing based on the landlord's failure to deliver possession, so the court likely would not find in the landlord's favor on this basis.

Educational objective: Although a landlord must generally deliver actual possession of the leased premises to the tenant at the beginning of the lease term, a minority of jurisdictions only require the landlord to deliver legal possession.

选项正确率统计：A选项 20%，B选项 55%（正确选项），C选项 1%，D选项 22%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

房东交付占有权的义务


要求违约救济
English rule
(多数派)		向租户交付实际占有权——即，移除非法占有物业的第三方
  • 拒绝支付租金以获取占有权
  • 就未能占有的期间寻求损害赔偿
  • 终止租约
American rule
(少数派)		向租户交付合法占有权——即，确保在租期开始时没有第三方有权占有该物业
房东通常必须在租期开始时向租户交付租赁物业的实际占有权——即，通过移除任何非法占有该物业的第三方（例如，逾期占有租户）。如果房东未能这样做，租户可以就其未能占有物业的期间向房东追偿损害赔偿。然而，少数司法管辖区仅要求房东交付合法占有权——即，通过确保在租期开始时没有第三方有权占有该物业。

在本案中，房东将物业出租给租户，租期六个月，自7月1日开始。当租户于7月1日到达租赁物业时，他得知前租户并未搬离（即，房东未能交付实际占有权）。并且由于前租户的租约已于5月31日结束，她是一名逾期占有租户，无权在7月1日占有该物业。因此，法院作出有利于房东的裁决，最可能的原因是该法院遵循少数派规则，并且房东已向租户交付了合法占有权。

（选项 A & D）租户不会因为（1）起诉第三方（例如，前租户）要求获得物业占有权，或（2）在驱逐第三方之前未通知房东，而放弃对房东的任何索赔。因此，法院不会基于任何一个理由作出有利于房东的裁决。

（选项 C）就推定驱逐——即房东对租户合法使用和享用物业的重大干扰——起诉房东，租户必须通知房东，然后在合理时间内搬离该物业。但是，未能搬离并不妨碍租户基于房东未能交付占有权而提起诉讼，因此法院不太可能基于此理由作出有利于房东的裁决。

教学目的：尽管房东通常必须在租期开始时向租户交付租赁物业的实际占有权，但少数司法管辖区仅要求房东交付合法占有权。

References

Restatement (Second) of Prop.: Landlord & Tenant § 6.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (landlord's duty to deliver possession).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property / Landlord & Tenant
核心考点：房东交付占有的义务

当新租约开始时，如果前任租户（Holdover Tenant）非法滞留，房东是否有义务将其驱逐？美国法律对此有两种截然不同的规则。

1. 英国规则 (English Rule)

地位：多数派规则 (Majority Rule)。

内容：房东必须向租户交付实际占有 (Actual Possession)。

后果：如果有第三方非法占有房屋，房东违约，租户可向房东索赔。

2. 美国规则 (American Rule)

地位：少数派规则 (Minority Rule)。

内容：房东只需交付法律上的占有权 (Legal Possession)。

后果：只要房东给了租户合法的租约，驱逐非法占有者（如赖着不走的前租户）就是新租户的责任，房东不承担违约责任。

题目逻辑分析

案情回顾：租户到达时发现前租户未搬走。租户起诉前租户并获胜。随后租户起诉房东要求赔偿未能入住期间的损失。

关键点：题目问的是“如果法院判决房东胜诉，最可能的解释是什么？”

这意味着该法院适用的法律规则必须是免除房东驱逐义务的规则。

选项 B 正确 房东已向租户交付了占有的合法权利。

这是典型的American Rule的应用。根据该规则，房东的义务仅限于赋予租户合法的占有权利（即签订有效的租约，且没有在此期间将房屋租给他人）。既然前租户是无权占有（Holdover），根据美国规则，驱逐她是新租户的责任，而非房东的责任。因此，房东胜诉。
选项 A 错误 关于救济方式的选择 (Election of Remedy)。
即使在要求交付实际占有的管辖区，租户起诉第三方（前租户）并不意味着他自动放弃了起诉房东违约的权利。这不是房东胜诉的主要法律依据。
选项 C 错误 关于推定驱逐 (Constructive Eviction)。
推定驱逐通常发生在租期内，因房东的行为导致房屋无法居住，租户必须搬离才能主张。本案是租期开始时的“交付占有”问题，且租户根本没住进去，谈不上“未能及时搬离”。
选项 D 错误 关于通知 (Notice)。
虽然通知房东通常是明智的，但在American Rule下，房东本就没有义务去驱逐，所以是否通知不影响判决结果；在English Rule下，房东违约是事实，未通知也不足以让房东完全免责。
💡 MBE 备考小贴士：
注意区分规则名称与实际应用范围的“反直觉”现象：
  • English Rule 是美国的多数派规则。
  • American Rule 反而是美国的少数派规则。
做题时，如果题目没有指定适用哪个规则，通常默认适用多数派（English Rule）。但本题通过设定“法院判房东赢”这一结果，反向考察了你对少数派规则（American Rule）的理解。

questions.question:
An individual who was domiciled in State A throughout her life deeded land in State A to a charity organized under the laws of State B but retained a right of entry if the land was not used for a charitable purpose. Later in her life, the individual transferred the right of entry to a creditor. The individual then devised her entire estate to her son shortly before she died. Recently, the charity ceased to use the land for a charitable purpose. The son and the creditor are domiciled in State B.
The law of State A, adhering to the common law, does not permit an inter vivos transfer of a right of entry. The law of State B permits a right of entry to be transferred during the owner's life.
The son has initiated a lawsuit in a state court in State B seeking a declaratory judgment that he is the owner of the land and naming the charity and the creditor as parties in this action.
Is the court likely to rule in the son's favor?

choices.a: No, because the court in State B must apply the law of State B.
choices.b: No, because the parties to this action are domiciled in State B.
choices.c: Yes, because the individual was domiciled in State A throughout her life.
choices.d: Yes, because the law of State A likely governs this matter.

data.questionStem:
Q86063

An individual who was domiciled in State A throughout her life deeded land in State A to a charity organized under the laws of State B but retained a right of entry if the land was not used for a charitable purpose. Later in her life, the individual transferred the right of entry to a creditor. The individual then devised her entire estate to her son shortly before she died. Recently, the charity ceased to use the land for a charitable purpose. The son and the creditor are domiciled in State B.

The law of State A, adhering to the common law, does not permit an inter vivos transfer of a right of entry. The law of State B permits a right of entry to be transferred during the owner's life.

The son has initiated a lawsuit in a state court in State B seeking a declaratory judgment that he is the owner of the land and naming the charity and the creditor as parties in this action.

Is the court likely to rule in the son's favor?

一名终身居住在A州的个人，将其位于A州的土地通过契约转让给一家根据B州法律成立的慈善机构，但保留了一项进入权，即如果该土地不被用于慈善目的，她有权进入并收回土地。在其晚年，该个人将此进入权转让给了一名债权人。随后，该个人在去世前不久，通过遗嘱将其全部遗产遗赠给了她的儿子。最近，该慈善机构停止将该土地用于慈善目的。其儿子和债权人均居住在B州。

A州的法律遵循普通法，不允许生前转让（inter vivos transfer）进入权。B州的法律则允许在所有者生前转让进入权。

儿子已在B州的一家州法院提起诉讼，请求宣告性判决（declaratory judgment），确认他是该土地的所有人，并将该慈善机构和债权人列为本案当事人。

法院是否可能做出有利于儿子的裁决？
options:
A. No, because the court in State B must apply the law of State B.
不会，因为B州的法院必须适用B州的法律。

B. No, because the parties to this action are domiciled in State B.
不会，因为本案当事人的居住地在B州。

C. Yes, because the individual was domiciled in State A throughout her life.
会，因为该个人终身居住在A州。

D. Yes, because the law of State A likely governs this matter.
会，因为A州的法律很可能管辖此事。
data.explanation:
Conflict-of-laws rule for real property issues


General ruleIn cases involving real property, law applied by forum court should be determined by conflict-of-laws rule that would be applied by state where property is located
Exceptions
  • Document specifies application of specific jurisdiction's laws
  • Issues regarding effect of marriage on interest in land
  • Collateral issues (eg, whether transferor perpetrated fraud)
  • Issues regarding mortgage note (eg, validity of note)
  • Foreclosure-related issues that do not affect interest in land (eg, mortgagee's right to sue mortgagor for underlying debt before foreclosure)
A conflict-of-laws issue arises when significant aspects of a legal action are divided between two or more states and there is a conflict as to which state's law applies (as seen here). If such a conflict arises in a case involving real property, the general conflict-of-laws rule is as follows:

The law applied by the forum court should be determined by the conflict-of-laws rule that would be applied by the courts of the situs state - ie, the state where the property is located.

The conflict-of-laws rule of the situs state typically directs the application of its own local law on that issue (ie, the law of the situs) in resolving the matter.

Here, the land is located in State A, so the law of State A (law of the situs) likely governs this matter. Since the law of State A does not permit an inter vivos transfer of a right of entry, the individual could not transfer her right of entry to the creditor during her lifetime. Instead, it passed to her son under her will. Therefore, the State B court will likely rule in the son's favor (Choice A).

(Choice B) The fact that the parties to this action are domiciled in State B shows that the State B court has personal jurisdiction over them. But this does not determine which state's law governs the matter.

(Choice C) Although the individual was domiciled in State A throughout her life, the situs of the property (not the domicile of the transferor) determines the law to be applied in this matter.

Educational objective: When there is a conflict-of-laws issue in a case involving real property, the general rule is that the applicable law should be determined by the conflict-of-laws rule of the state where the property is located (ie, situs state). This usually results in the application of the situs state's local law on that issue.

选项正确率统计：A选项 14%，B选项 4%，C选项 2%，D选项 78%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

关于不动产问题的法律冲突规则


一般规则在涉及不动产的案件中，受案法院适用的法律应由财产所在地州将适用的法律冲突规则来决定
例外情况
  • 文件指明适用特定法域的法律
  • 关于婚姻对土地权益影响的问题
  • 附带问题（例如，转让人是否实施了欺诈）
  • 关于抵押票据的问题（例如，票据的有效性）
  • 与取消抵押品赎回权相关但不影响土地权益的问题（例如，抵押权人在取消抵押品赎回权前就基础债务起诉抵押人的权利）
当一项法律诉讼的重要方面分属于两个或多个州，并且在适用哪个州的法律上存在冲突时，就会出现法律冲突问题（如本案所示）。如果此类冲突发生在涉及不动产的案件中，一般的法律冲突规则如下：

受案法院所适用的法律应由物之所在地州（situs state）（即财产所在地州）的法院将适用的法律冲突规则来决定。

物之所在地州的法律冲突规则通常指引就该问题适用其本州的实体法（即物之所在地的法律）来解决争议。

在本案中，土地位于A州，因此A州的法律（物之所在地的法律）很可能管辖此事。由于A州的法律不允许生前转让（inter vivos transfer）进入权，该个人无法在其生前将其进入权转让给债权人。相反，该权利通过她的遗嘱传给了她的儿子。因此，B州法院很可能做出有利于儿子的裁决（选项A）。

（选项B）本案当事人居住在B州这一事实表明B州法院对他们拥有对人管辖权。但这并不能决定哪个州的法律管辖此事。

（选项C）尽管该个人终身居住在A州，但决定本案适用法律的是财产所在地（situs），而非转让人的居住地。

教学目标：当涉及不动产的案件出现法律冲突问题时，一般规则是，应适用的法律由财产所在地州（即物之所在地州）的法律冲突规则决定。这通常导致适用物之所在地州关于该问题的实体法。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Conflict of Laws § 223 (Am. Law Inst. 1971) (validity and effect of conveyance of interest in land).

MBE 考点解析

法律冲突与不动产所有权
(Conflict of Laws & Real Property)

核心考点：物之所在地法

一般规则 (General Rule)：
在涉及不动产（Real Property）的法律冲突案件中，法院通常适用不动产所在地（Situs）的法律。

这在法律上被称为 Lex Loci Rei Sitae（物之所在地法）。无论是土地的所有权归属、转让的有效性，还是权益的性质，都由土地所在的州法律管辖。

本案逻辑推演

1
确定争议焦点：
本案的核心争议是“进入权”（Right of Entry）的生前转让（Inter Vivos Transfer）是否有效。
2
确定不动产位置 (Situs)：
土地位于 A州。
3
适用法律冲突规则：
虽然诉讼在 B州（法院所在地/Forum）提起，但 B州法院在处理不动产问题时，会依据法律冲突规则指向 A州法律。
4
应用实体法得出结论：
A州法律禁止生前转让进入权。因此，该个人试图转让给债权人（Creditor）的行为无效。该权利保留在个人手中，并最终通过遗嘱传给了儿子。

选项解析

正确答案：D

法院很可能判决儿子胜诉，因为 A州的法律很可能管辖此事。

选项 A 错误：
虽然法院位于 B州，但法院不会仅仅因为它是受理法院（Forum）就自动适用 B州法律。对于不动产案件，B州法院会适用其冲突法规则，该规则通常指向不动产所在地（A州）。

选项 B & C 错误：
当事人的住所地（Domicile）在涉及不动产所有权的案件中通常不是决定性因素。住所地通常影响动产继承或家庭法问题，但在土地确权问题上，土地的位置（Situs）才是王道。

🎓 MBE 备考技巧：
  • 看到 Real Property（不动产）+ Multiple States（多州涉及），第一反应应该是 Law of the Situs（所在地法）。
  • 不要被当事人的居住地（Domicile）或合同签订地迷惑，除非题目明确提到是关于合同本身的附带问题（如欺诈），否则土地权益本身由土地所在地法律决定。
  • 例外情况： 如果涉及婚姻对土地权益的影响（如夫妻共同财产），有时会参考住所地法，但最稳妥的默认规则依然是所在地法。

questions.question:
A husband and wife acquired land as common law joint tenants with right of survivorship. One year later, without his wife's knowledge, the husband executed a will devising his interest in the land to his best friend. The husband subsequently died.
Is the wife now the sole owner of the land?

choices.a: No, because a joint tenant has the unilateral right to end a joint tenancy without the consent of the other joint tenant.
choices.b: No, because the wife's interest in the husband's undivided 50% ownership in the land adeemed.
choices.c: Yes, because of the doctrine of after-acquired title, or estoppel by deed.
choices.d: Yes, because the devise to the friend did not sever the joint tenancy.

data.questionStem:
Q86090

A husband and wife acquired land as common law joint tenants with right of survivorship. One year later, without his wife's knowledge, the husband executed a will devising his interest in the land to his best friend. The husband subsequently died.

Is the wife now the sole owner of the land?

一对夫妻以普通法上的共同共有（joint tenants with right of survivorship）的形式获得了一块土地。一年后，在妻子不知情的情况下，丈夫订立了一份遗嘱，将其在该土地上的权益遗赠给他最好的朋友。丈夫随后去世。

妻子现在是该土地的唯一所有权人吗？
options:
A. No, because a joint tenant has the unilateral right to end a joint tenancy without the consent of the other joint tenant.
否，因为共同共有人有单方面的权利在未经其他共同共有人同意的情况下终止共同共有关系。

B. No, because the wife's interest in the husband's undivided 50% ownership in the land adeemed.
否，因为妻子于丈夫未分割的50%土地所有权中所享有的权益已撤销（adeemed）。

C. Yes, because of the doctrine of after-acquired title, or estoppel by deed.
是，因为“事后取得产权”（after-acquired title）原则，或称“文书禁反言”（estoppel by deed）原则。

D. Yes, because the devise to the friend did not sever the joint tenancy.
是，因为对朋友的遗赠并未切断（sever）该共同共有关系。
data.explanation:
A joint tenancy is a type of concurrent estate in which each co-tenant has an undivided and equal interest in the property with the right of survivorship. The right of survivorship means that a joint tenant's interest disappears upon his/her death and the remaining joint tenants' interests automatically expand to absorb it. As a result, although a joint tenant can sever the joint tenancy by conveying his/her interest to another during life (thereby creating a tenancy in common), a joint tenant cannot devise his/her interest at death.

Here, the husband and wife were joint tenants with the right of survivorship. Therefore, the husband could not sever the joint tenancy by devising his interest to his best friend. And since the husband and wife's joint tenancy remained intact, the wife absorbed his interest and became the sole owner of the land upon his death.

(Choice A) A tenant can unilaterally end a joint tenancy without the other tenant's consent. But this only occurs when a joint tenancy interest is conveyed during a tenant's lifetime, since a joint tenancy interest cannot be devised upon death.

(Choice B) Ademption is the failure of a gift under a will, often because the testator no longer owns that gift when he/she dies. Here, the best friend's interest in the land (not the wife's) adeemed because the husband's joint tenancy interest disappeared upon his death. Therefore, the husband had no interest to devise to his friend.

(Choice C) The doctrine of after-acquired title (ie, estoppel by deed) applies when a testator acquires title to devised property after executing a will. In that case, the property passes under the will so long as the testator still owns the property when he/she dies. This doctrine does not apply here since the husband (testator) owned the land before he attempted to devise it to the best friend.

Educational objective: A joint tenancy includes the right of survivorship, so a joint tenant's interest disappears upon his/her death and the remaining joint tenants' interests automatically expand to absorb it. As a result, a joint tenancy interest cannot be devised.



选项正确率统计：A选项 25%，B选项 4%，C选项 1%，D选项 68%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

共同共有（Joint tenancy）是一种共有财产形式（concurrent estate），其中每个共有人（co-tenant）对财产拥有不可分割且平等的权益，并附带生存者权利（right of survivorship）。生存者权利意味着，某一共同共有人的权益在其去世后即告消失，而其余共同共有人的权益则自动扩张以吸收该权益。因此，尽管共同共有人可以在生前通过将其权益转让给他人来切断（sever）共同共有关系（从而产生分别共有关系，tenancy in common），但共同共有人不能在去世时通过遗嘱遗赠其权益。

在本案中，夫妻二人是拥有生存者权利的共同共有人。因此，丈夫不能通过将其权益遗赠给最好的朋友来切断共同共有关系。并且，由于夫妻间的共同共有关系保持完整，丈夫去世后，妻子吸收了他的权益，成为该土地的唯一所有权人。

(选项A) 共同共有人可以单方面终止共同共有关系，无需另一共有人的同意。但这仅在共同共有权益于共有人生前被转让时才会发生，因为共同共有权益不能在死亡时被遗赠。

(选项B) 遗赠撤销（Ademption）指遗嘱下的赠与失效，通常是因为立遗嘱人（testator）在去世时已不再拥有该赠与物。在本案中，是其最好朋友在该土地上的权益（而非妻子的权益）被撤销，因为丈夫的共同共有权益在其去世时即告消失。因此，丈夫没有任何权益可以遗赠给他的朋友。

(选项C) “事后取得产权”（after-acquired title）原则（即“文书禁反言”，estoppel by deed）适用于立遗嘱人在订立遗嘱之后才获得遗赠财产所有权的情况。在这种情况下，只要立遗嘱人在其去世时仍然拥有该财产，该财产就会根据遗嘱转移。该原则在此处不适用，因为丈夫（立遗嘱人）在试图将土地遗赠给其最好朋友之前就已经拥有该土地。

教学目标：共同共有（A joint tenancy）包含生存者权利，因此一个共同共有人的权益在其死亡时消失，其余共同共有人的权益自动扩张以吸收该权益。因此，共同共有权益不能被遗赠。

References

20 Am. Jur. 2d Cotenancy and Joint Ownership § 22 (2018) (severance of joint tenancy).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Joint Tenancy & Wills
✅ 正确答案：D

是的，妻子是唯一所有权人。因为对朋友的遗赠并没有切断（Sever）共同共有关系。

核心考点：生存者权 (Right of Survivorship)

本题考查的是 Joint Tenancy（联权共有/共同共有）最核心的特征：Right of Survivorship（生存者权）。

这意味着当一个共有人去世时，其权益自动消失，并被幸存的共有人（Survivor）自动吸收。幸存者并不是从死者那里“继承”了份额，而是死者的份额“蒸发”了，幸存者的所有权扩张到了整个财产。

1. 遗嘱 vs. 生存者权

这是MBE中非常经典的“死亡竞赛”。

  • 遗嘱 (Will): 只有在立遗嘱人死亡后才生效（Testamentary）。
  • 生存者权 (Survivorship): 在共有人死亡的瞬间立即生效。

结论：生存者权总是“跑得比遗嘱快”。当丈夫去世的那一刻，他的权益已经消失并归于妻子所有。遗嘱生效时，丈夫名下已无该土地的任何权益，因此遗赠无效。

2. 如何切断 (Severance)？

选项A提到了“单方面终止”。确实，Joint Tenant 可以在生前 (Inter Vivos) 通过转让（Conveyance）自己的份额来切断共有关系，将其转变为 Tenancy in Common（分别共有）。

但是，丈夫试图通过遗嘱来切断是无效的，因为遗嘱在生前不产生效力。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 A: 混淆了生前转让与死后遗赠。生前可以单方切断，但死后不行。
  • 选项 B: 提到了 Ademption（遗赠撤销）。虽然结果上朋友确实拿不到地（因为赠与物不存在了），但该选项暗示妻子失去了权益，这是错误的。妻子不仅没失去，反而得到了全部。
  • 选项 C: Estoppel by deed（文书禁反言）适用于“先卖后买”的情况（即先转让未持有的财产，后获得产权）。本案中丈夫一直拥有产权，不适用此原则。
💡 MBE 破题口诀 在 Real Property 题目中，一旦看到 "Joint Tenancy" 和 "Will"（遗嘱）同时出现：

👉 记住：遗嘱不能切断 Joint Tenancy。
生存者权 (Survivorship) 永远胜过遗嘱继承。除非题目中提到丈夫在生前签署了契据（Deed）转让给他人。

questions.question:
A man owned a tract of land in fee simple. By will duly admitted to probate after his death, the man devised the land to "any wife who survives me for life with remainder to such of my children as are living at her death."
The man was survived by his wife and by two daughters and a son. Thereafter, the son died and by will duly admitted to probate devised his entire estate to a friend. The son's sole heirs at law were the two daughters.
Later, the wife died. In an appropriate lawsuit to which the two daughters and the friend are parties, title to the land is at issue.
In such lawsuit, judgment should be that title to the land is in which party?

choices.a: The two daughters and the friend, because the earliest vesting of remainders is favored and reference to the wife's death should be construed as relating to time of taking possession.
choices.b: The two daughters and the friend, because the provision requiring survival of children violates the Rule Against Perpetuities since the surviving wife might have been a person unborn at the time of writing of the will.
choices.c: The two daughters, because the remainders were contingent upon surviving the life tenant.
choices.d: The two daughters, because the son's remainder must descend by intestacy and is not devisable.

data.questionStem:
Q86091

A man owned a tract of land in fee simple. By will duly admitted to probate after his death, the man devised the land to "any wife who survives me for life with remainder to such of my children as are living at her death."

The man was survived by his wife and by two daughters and a son. Thereafter, the son died and by will duly admitted to probate devised his entire estate to a friend. The son's sole heirs at law were the two daughters.

Later, the wife died. In an appropriate lawsuit to which the two daughters and the friend are parties, title to the land is at issue.

In such lawsuit, judgment should be that title to the land is in which party?

一名男子以完全保有地产权(fee simple)的形式拥有一块土地。该男子去世后，其遗嘱经正式遗嘱认证程序确认，将该土地遗赠给“在我去世后尚存的妻子，为其终身保有，剩余权益则归于其去世时仍在世的我的子女。”

该男子去世时，其妻子、两个女儿和一个儿子尚在人世。此后，儿子去世，其遗嘱经正式遗嘱认证程序确认，将其全部遗产遗赠给了一位朋友。该儿子的法定继承人仅为其两个姐妹。

之后，妻子去世。在一场以两个女儿和那位朋友为当事人的相关诉讼中，该土地的所有权成为争议焦点。

在该诉讼中，应判决该土地的所有权归属于哪一方？
options:
A. The two daughters and the friend, because the earliest vesting of remainders is favored and reference to the wife's death should be construed as relating to time of taking possession.
两个女儿和那位朋友，因为法律倾向于剩余权益的尽早归属(vesting)，且提及妻子去世应被解释为与占有时间相关。

B. The two daughters and the friend, because the provision requiring survival of children violates the Rule Against Perpetuities since the surviving wife might have been a person unborn at the time of writing of the will.
两个女儿和那位朋友，因为要求子女生存的条款违反了反永久权规则(Rule Against Perpetuities)，因为存活的妻子在遗嘱订立时可能是一个尚未出生的人。

C. The two daughters, because the remainders were contingent upon surviving the life tenant.
两个女儿，因为剩余权益是以在终身地产权人(life tenant)之后存活为条件的或有权益(contingent)。

D. The two daughters, because the son's remainder must descend by intestacy and is not devisable.
两个女儿，因为儿子的剩余权益必须通过无遗嘱继承进行传承，且不可通过遗嘱处分。
data.explanation:
Vested remainders v. Contingent remainders


DefinitionExamples
VestedRemainder not subject to condition precedent & held by identifiable living person"... remainder to A"
ContingentRemainder subject to condition precedent or held by unknown / unborn person"... remainder to A, but only if A outlives B""... remainder to my heirs"
A life estate is a present possessory interest in real property that expires upon the death of an individual. The future interest that follows a life estate is either a reversion (if it is held by the grantor) or a remainder (if it is created in a grantee - as seen here). A remainder is contingent if it is held by an unknown or unborn person OR subject to a condition precedent.

Here, the man devised a life estate in the land to his wife and a remainder to his children - but only if they survived the wife. Because the children's remainders were contingent upon surviving the wife, no child's interest can vest before the wife's death. This is true regardless of whether there is a policy favoring early vesting (Choice A). And since the son died before the wife, the son never acquired an interest in the land to devise to his friend. Therefore, the two daughters - both of whom were alive when the wife died - have title to the land.

(Choice B) A future interest that violates the Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP) is void. Therefore, had the children's remainders violated RAP, the daughters would not take title to the land.

(Choice D) Remainders (whether they are vested or contingent) are transferable inter vivos, devisable by will, and inheritable by intestate succession.

Educational objective: Future interests following a life estate are called remainders if they are created in a grantee. And remainders are contingent if they are
  • held by an unknown or unborn person or
  • subject to a condition precedent.


选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 7%，C选项 78%（正确选项），D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

既定剩余权益 vs. 或有剩余权益


定义示例
既定(Vested)剩余权益不受先决条件限制，且由可确定的在世之人持有“……剩余权益归于A”
或有(Contingent)剩余权益受先决条件限制，或由未知/未出生之人持有“……剩余权益归于A，但前提是A比B长寿”
“……剩余权益归于我的继承人”
终身地产权(life estate)是一种现有的不动产占有权益，它在某一个人死亡时终止。紧随终身地产权之后的未来权益，若由授予人持有则为复归权(reversion)，若为受让人创设（如本案所示）则为剩余权益(remainder)。如果剩余权益由未知或未出生的人持有，或受先决条件限制，则该剩余权益为或有(contingent)权益。

在本案中，该男子将土地的终身地产权遗赠给其妻子，并将剩余权益遗赠给其子女——但前提是他们要在妻子之后仍然存活。由于子女的剩余权益是以在妻子之后存活为条件的或有权益，因此在妻子去世前，任何子女的权益都不能归属(vest)。这一点是成立的，无论是否存在倾向于尽早归属的法律政策（选项A）。并且，由于儿子在妻子之前去世，他从未获得该土地的任何权益以遗赠给他的朋友。因此，两个女儿——在妻子去世时都还健在——拥有该土地的所有权。

（选项B） 违反反永久权规则(Rule Against Perpetuities, RAP)的未来权益是无效的。因此，如果子女的剩余权益违反了RAP，女儿们将不会获得土地所有权。

（选项D） 剩余权益（无论是既定的还是或有的）均可在生前转让(transferable inter vivos)，可通过遗嘱处分(devisable by will)，并可通过无遗嘱继承(intestate succession)来继承。

教学目的：紧随终身地产权之后的未来权益，若为受让人创设，则称为剩余权益。如果剩余权益符合以下条件，则为或有权益(contingent)：
  • 由未知或未出生的人持有，或
  • 受先决条件限制。


References

Restatement of Property § 157 cmt. u (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (contingent remainders).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Future Interests

核心考点：或有剩余权益 (Contingent Remainder)

当剩余权益的归属受制于一个先决条件 (Condition Precedent) 时，它就是“或有”的。最常见的先决条件就是“必须存活到某一特定时间”。

遗嘱设立 (Grant)
终身权益给妻子，剩余权益给子女
↓
关键条件 (Condition)
"Living at her death"
(妻子去世时仍健在)
↓
事实 (Facts)
1. 儿子先于妻子去世 ❌
2. 女儿们在妻子去世时健在 ✅
为什么选 C？

本题的关键在于遗嘱中的措辞："to such of my children as are living at her death"。

这句话明确设立了一个生存条件 (Survivorship Condition)。这意味着子女获得土地所有权的前提是：必须比终身地产权人（妻子）活得长。

  • 对于儿子：他在妻子去世前已经死亡。因此，他未能满足先决条件。他的或有剩余权益在他死亡时即刻消灭 (Extinguished)。既然权益已消灭，他自然无法通过遗嘱将其传给朋友。
  • 对于女儿：她们在妻子去世时仍然在世，满足了条件。此时，她们的权益从“或有”转变为“既定”，并获得土地所有权。
为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (错误)：关于“尽早归属原则”
虽然法律确实倾向于将剩余权益解释为既定的 (Vested)，但这仅适用于语言模棱两可的情况。本题中“living at her death”表述非常清晰，不存在歧义，必须严格执行生存条件。
选项 B (错误)：关于反永久权规则 (RAP)
这里的子女是“在世的生命” (Lives in being)。他们的权益会在妻子（也是在世生命）去世的那一刻确定归属或失败，完全在 RAP 允许的时间范围内，因此不违反 RAP。
选项 D (错误)：关于可继承性
通常情况下，或有剩余权益是可以转让和继承的。但是，如果该权益本身就是以“生存”为条件的，那么当持有人死亡时，该权益自然终止，无法被继承或遗赠。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧 看到 "survive", "living at", "if he is alive" 等字眼时，立即警惕！这通常意味着这是一个或有剩余权益 (Contingent Remainder)。

如果受益人在条件触发前死亡，该权益直接消失，不会进入其遗产 (Estate)。

questions.question:
A testator owned a tract of land in fee simple. The testator wrote and executed, with the required formalities, a will that devised the land to "my daughter for life with remainder to my descendants per stirpes." At the time of writing the will, the testator had a husband and no descendants living other than her two children, the daughter named in the will and a son.
The testator died and the will was duly admitted to probate. The testator's husband predeceased her, but she was survived by her daughter, her son, four grandchildren, and one great-grandchild. The testator's children were her sole heirs at law.
The testator's children brought an appropriate action for declaratory judgment as to title of the land. Guardians ad litem were appointed and all other steps were taken so that the judgment would bind all persons interested.
In that action, the court ruled that the daughter has a life estate in the whole of the land and that the remainder is contingent.
The court must have chosen a construction that did which of the following?

choices.a: Implied a condition that remaindermen survive the daughter.
choices.b: Implied a gift of a life estate to the son.
choices.c: Related all vesting to the death of the testator.
choices.d: Related all vesting to the time of writing of the will.

data.questionStem:
Q86093

A testator owned a tract of land in fee simple. The testator wrote and executed, with the required formalities, a will that devised the land to "my daughter for life with remainder to my descendants per stirpes." At the time of writing the will, the testator had a husband and no descendants living other than her two children, the daughter named in the will and a son.

The testator died and the will was duly admitted to probate. The testator's husband predeceased her, but she was survived by her daughter, her son, four grandchildren, and one great-grandchild. The testator's children were her sole heirs at law.

The testator's children brought an appropriate action for declaratory judgment as to title of the land. Guardians ad litem were appointed and all other steps were taken so that the judgment would bind all persons interested.

In that action, the court ruled that the daughter has a life estate in the whole of the land and that the remainder is contingent.

The court must have chosen a construction that did which of the following?

一位立遗嘱人以无条件继承地产权（fee simple）的方式拥有一片土地。该立遗嘱人以法定形式书写并签署了一份遗嘱，将该土地遗赠给“我的女儿终身持有，剩余地产权由我的后嗣按房继承（per stirpes）”。

在书写遗嘱时，立遗嘱人有一位丈夫，除了她的两个孩子（遗嘱中指定的女儿和一个儿子）外，没有其他在世的后嗣。

立遗嘱人去世后，其遗嘱被正式接纳进行遗嘱认证（probate）。立遗嘱人的丈夫先于她去世，但她留下了女儿、儿子、四个孙子女和一个曾孙子女。立遗嘱人的子女是她的唯一法定继承人（heirs at law）。

立遗嘱人的子女就该土地的所有权提起了适当的宣告性判决（declaratory judgment）之诉。法院任命了诉讼监护人（Guardians ad litem），并采取了所有其他必要措施，以确保判决对所有利害关系人均具有约束力。

在该诉讼中，法院裁定女儿对全部土地拥有终身地产权（life estate），且剩余地产权（remainder）是或有的（contingent）。

法院必定是采纳了以下哪一种解释？
options:
A. Implied a condition that remaindermen survive the daughter.
默示了一个条件，即剩余地产权人（remaindermen）必须在女儿之后仍然在世。

B. Implied a gift of a life estate to the son.
默示了将终身地产权（life estate）赠与儿子。

C. Related all vesting to the death of the testator.
将所有权利的归属（vesting）与立遗嘱人的死亡相关联。

D. Related all vesting to the time of writing of the will.
将所有权利的归属（vesting）与遗嘱的书写时间相关联。
data.explanation:
Vested remainders v. Contingent remainders


DefinitionExamples
Vested Remainder not subject to condition precedent & held by identifiable living person"... remainder to A"
Contingent Remainder subject to condition precedent or held by unknown / unborn person"... remainder to A, but only if A outlives B" "... remainder to my heirs"
A remainder is a future interest in real property that is capable of becoming possessory upon the expiration of a life estate or term of years. Remainders are either:
  • vested - not subject to any condition precedent AND held by an identifiable living person or
  • contingent - subject to some condition precedent (other than the natural termination of the prior estate) OR held by an unknown or unborn person.
Here, the testator wrote a will that devised a life estate to her daughter and a remainder to her descendants. After the testator's death, the court ruled that that the remainder was contingent - not vested. This means that the court cannot have chosen a construction (ie, interpretation) of the testator's will that related all vesting to:
  • the time of the writing of the will - in which case, the testator's descendants who were alive and identifiable when she wrote the will (her two children) would have had vested remainders (Choice D) or
  • the death of the testator - in which case, the testator's descendants who were alive and identifiable when she died (her children, grandchildren, and great-grandchild) would have had vested remainders (Choice C).
Instead, the court must have chosen a construction of the testator's will that implied a condition that remaindermen survive the daughter. In that case, the remainder would be contingent because the testator's descendants who will survive the daughter and eventually take possession of the land are still unknown.

(Choice B) There is no indication that the court implied a life estate to the son. And even if it did, this would not create a contingent remainder.

Educational objective: A vested remainder is not subject to any condition precedent and is held by an identifiable living person, whereas a contingent remainder is either subject to a condition precedent or held by an unknown or unborn person.

选项正确率统计：A选项 64%（正确选项），B选项 1%，C选项 20%，D选项 13%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

既得剩余地产权（Vested remainders） vs. 或有剩余地产权（Contingent remainders）


定义示例
既得剩余地产权（Vested Remainder）不受先决条件（condition precedent）的限制，且由可确定的在世之人持有“……剩余地产权归A”
或有剩余地产权（Contingent Remainder）受先决条件（condition precedent）的限制，或由身份不明/尚未出生之人持有“……剩余地产权归A，但仅当A比B长寿时”
“……剩余地产权归我的继承人”
剩余地产权（remainder）是一种不动产的未来权益，它能够在终身地产权（life estate）或限期地产权（term of years）期满后变为占有性权益。剩余地产权分为：
  • 既得的（vested）- 不受任何先决条件（condition precedent）的限制，且由可确定的在世之人持有，或
  • 或有的（contingent）- 受到某个先决条件（condition precedent）的限制（该先决条件并非前述地产权的自然终止），或由身份不明或尚未出生的人持有。
在本案中，立遗嘱人书写了一份遗嘱，将终身地产权（life estate）遗赠给她的女儿，并将剩余地产权（remainder）遗赠给她的后嗣。在立遗嘱人去世后，法院裁定该剩余地产权是或有的（contingent）——而非既得的（vested）。这意味着法院不可能采纳一种将所有权利归属（vesting）与之相关联的遗嘱解释，即：
  • 遗嘱的书写时间——在这种情况下，立遗嘱人在书写遗嘱时在世且身份可确定的后嗣（她的两个孩子）将拥有既得的（vested）剩余地产权（选项D）或
  • 立遗嘱人的死亡时间——在这种情况下，立遗嘱人去世时在世且身份可确定的后嗣（她的子女、孙子女和曾孙子女）将拥有既得的（vested）剩余地产权（选项C）。
相反，法院必定是采纳了一种遗嘱解释，该解释默示了一个条件，即剩余地产权人（remaindermen）必须在女儿之后仍然在世。在这种情况下，剩余地产权将是或有的（contingent），因为哪些后嗣将在女儿之后仍然在世并最终占有该土地，目前尚不确定。

（选项B）没有迹象表明法院默示了将终身地产权（life estate）赠与儿子。即使法院这样做了，这也不会产生一个或有剩余地产权（contingent remainder）。

教学目的：既得剩余地产权（vested remainder）不受任何先决条件的限制，并由一个可确定的在世之人持有；而或有剩余地产权（contingent remainder）则受先决条件的限制，或由一个身份不明或尚未出生的人持有。

References

Restatement of Property § 157 (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (discussing the types of remainders).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：剩余地产权的分类

本题考察的是不动产法中关于未来权益（Future Interests）的核心概念，特别是如何区分既得剩余地产权（Vested Remainder）与或有剩余地产权（Contingent Remainder）。

核心法律规则

剩余地产权（Remainder）分为两类：

  • 既得的 (Vested)：
    Created in an ascertained person AND not subject to any condition precedent.
    受让人身份确定，且没有先决条件。
  • 或有的 (Contingent)：
    Created in an unascertained person OR subject to a condition precedent.
    受让人身份未定，或者附带先决条件。

题目逻辑推演

1
法院的裁决是前提：
题目明确指出，法院裁定该剩余地产权是或有的（Contingent）。这是我们解题的出发点。我们需要找到导致它成为“或有”的原因。
2
分析“后嗣”（Descendants）：
遗嘱将剩余地产权给了“后嗣”。如果仅仅是给“孩子”，通常在立遗嘱人死亡时就确定了，属于既得权益。但法院判决它是“或有”的。
3
寻找“或有”的理由：
要让这个权益变成“或有”，必须存在一个先决条件（Condition Precedent）。
在涉及“后嗣”或“继承人”的赠与中，最常见的先决条件就是生存要求（Survivorship）——即要求受益人必须活得比终身地产权持有人（女儿）更久。
立遗嘱人死亡
↓
女儿持有终身地产权 (Life Estate)
↓
关键点：谁能拿剩余地产权？
如果是“或有”的 → 必须等到女儿死后，看谁还活着。

为什么选 A？

选项 A (Implied a condition that remaindermen survive the daughter) 是唯一能解释法院判决的选项。

如果法院默示了一个条件，要求后嗣必须在女儿死后仍然在世（survive the life tenant），那么在女儿去世之前，我们无法确定最终的受益人是谁。这种不确定性正是或有剩余地产权（Contingent Remainder）的特征。

为什么其他选项错误？

  • 选项 C 和 D（错误原因相同）：
    如果权利的归属（Vesting）与“立遗嘱人死亡时”（选项C）或“遗嘱书写时”（选项D）相关联，那么立遗嘱人的儿子和女儿在当时就是身份确定的受益人。
    这将导致产生一个既得剩余地产权（Vested Remainder）。这与题目中法院裁定其为“或有（Contingent）”的事实相矛盾。
  • 选项 B：
    默示给儿子终身地产权不仅没有事实依据，而且即使给了，也不影响剩余地产权是既得还是或有的性质。
💡 考试技巧
在 MBE 考试中，如果题目告诉你法院判定某种权益是“Contingent”（或有）的，你必须在选项中寻找导致这种不确定性的因素：要么是人没定（Unascertained person），要么是有条件（Condition precedent）。

本题中，"Survive the daughter" 就是那个让权益变为 Contingent 的关键条件。

questions.question:
A tenant entered into a one-year agreement to lease a two-bedroom home from a landlord for $1,000 per month, with rent due at the beginning of each month. The lease further provided that either party could properly terminate the lease by giving at least 30-days' notice. For eight months, the tenant paid rent on a timely basis. At the beginning of the following month, the tenant failed to pay rent. The landlord immediately contacted the tenant and demanded payment, but the tenant refused to pay. Pursuant to the terms of the lease, the tenant gave 30 days' notice of his intent to vacate the premises. The landlord subsequently sued the tenant for damages. In the meantime, the landlord re-rented the home for the remaining three months of the lease to another tenant for $800 per month.
Under the majority rule, what is the most that the landlord could potentially collect from the tenant?

choices.a: Nothing, because the landlord did not give the tenant the opportunity to cure before re-renting.
choices.b: $1,000, because the lease was properly terminated and the tenant is not obligated to pay future rents.
choices.c: $1,600, because the tenant is liable for any deficiency resulting from his early termination of the lease.
choices.d: $2,000, because the tenant is liable for the current month and rent that accrues during his 30-day notice period.

questions.question:
A real estate developer owned a 100-acre tract of land. Six years ago, the real estate developer leased a one-acre lot located in the northeasterly corner of the tract for a term of 30 years to a fast-food company. The fast-food company intended to, and did, construct a fast-food restaurant on the one-acre lot.
The lease provided that:
The fast-food company was to maintain the lot and improvements thereon, to maintain full insurance coverage on the lot, and to pay all taxes assessed against the lot.
The real estate developer was to maintain the access roads and the parking lot areas platted on those portions of the tract that adjoined the lot and to permit the company's customers to use them in common with the customers of the other commercial users of the remainder of the tract.
The fast-food company was to pay its share of the expenses for the off-site improvements according to a stated formula.
Five years ago, the real estate developer sold the one-acre lot to an investor; the conveyance was made subject to the lease to the fast-food company. However, the investor did not assume the obligations of the lease and the real estate developer retained the remainder of the 100-acre tract of land. Since that conveyance five years ago, the fast-food company has paid rent to the investor. However, the fast-food company refused to pay its formula share of the off-site improvement costs as provided in the lease.
The real estate developer brought an appropriate action against the fast-food company to recover such costs.
Is the real estate developer likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the conveyance of the one-acre lot to the investor terminated the privity of estate between the real estate developer and the fast-food company.
choices.b: No, because the investor, as the fast-food company's landlord, has the obligation to pay the maintenance costs by necessary implication.
choices.c: Yes, because the conveyance of the one-acre lot to the investor did not terminate the real estate developer's right to enforce the covenant to contribute.
choices.d: Yes, because the use of the improvements by the customers of the fast-food company imposes an implied obligation on the fast-food company.

Q86109

A real estate developer owned a 100-acre tract of land. Six years ago, the real estate developer leased a one-acre lot located in the northeasterly corner of the tract for a term of 30 years to a fast-food company. The fast-food company intended to, and did, construct a fast-food restaurant on the one-acre lot.

The lease provided that:

1. The fast-food company was to maintain the lot and improvements thereon, to maintain full insurance coverage on the lot, and to pay all taxes

assessed against the lot.

2. The real estate developer was to maintain the access roads and the parking lot areas platted on those portions of the tract that adjoined the

lot and to permit the company's customers to use them in common with the customers of the other commercial users of the remainder of the tract.

3. The fast-food company was to pay its share of the expenses for the off-site improvements according to a stated formula.

Five years ago, the real estate developer sold the one-acre lot to an investor; the conveyance was made subject to the lease to the fast-food company. However, the investor did not assume the obligations of the lease and the real estate developer retained the remainder of the 100-acre tract of land. Since that conveyance five years ago, the fast-food company has paid rent to the investor. However, the fast-food company refused to pay its formula share of the off-site improvement costs as provided in the lease.

The real estate developer brought an appropriate action against the fast-food company to recover such costs.

Is the real estate developer likely to prevail?

一位房地产开发商拥有一块100英亩的土地。六年前，该房地产开发商将这块土地东北角的一块一英亩地块出租给一家快餐公司，租期为30年。该快餐公司计划并确实在该一英亩地块上建造了一家快餐店。

租赁合同规定：

1. 快餐公司须维护该地块及其上的改良物，为该地块维持全面的保险，并支付针对该地块征收的所有税款。

2. 房地产开发商须维护与该地块相邻的土地部分上规划的通行道路和停车场区域，并允许快餐公司顾客与该土地剩余部分的其他商业用户的顾客共同使用这些设施。

3. 快餐公司须根据既定公式支付其在场外改良物费用中的份额。

五年前，房地产开发商将这一英亩地块出售给一位投资者；此次转让受与快餐公司租赁合同的约束。然而，该投资者并未承担租赁合同中的义务，且房地产开发商保留了100英亩土地的剩余部分。自五年前那次转让以来，快餐公司一直向该投资者支付租金。然而，快餐公司拒绝按照租赁合同的规定，支付其按公式计算的场外改良物费用份额。

房地产开发商对快餐公司提起了适当的诉讼，以追讨该等费用。

房地产开发商可能胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the conveyance of the one-acre lot to the investor terminated the privity of estate between the real estate developer and the fast-food company.
不会，因为将一英亩地块转让给投资者终止了房地产开发商与快餐公司之间的财产利益关系（privity of estate）。

B. No, because the investor, as the fast-food company's landlord, has the obligation to pay the maintenance costs by necessary implication.
不会，因为作为快餐公司的出租人，投资者有因必要默示而支付维护费用的义务。

C. Yes, because the conveyance of the one-acre lot to the investor did not terminate the real estate developer's right to enforce the covenant to contribute.
会，因为将一英亩地块转让给投资者并未终止房地产开发商执行该缴款契约的权利。

D. Yes, because the use of the improvements by the customers of the fast-food company imposes an implied obligation on the fast- food company.
会，因为快餐公司的顾客对改良物的使用为快餐公司施加了一项默示义务。
data.explanation:
A landlord may generally transfer his/her property interest to a third party (ie, assignee-landlord) without the tenant's consent. However, the assignee-landlord only has the right to enforce a covenant (ie, promise) in the lease if it runs with the land. Otherwise, the original landlord retains the right to enforce it. A covenant runs with the land when:
  • the original parties intended to bind successors in interest (eg, assignee-landlord)
  • the covenant touches and concerns (ie, affects the use or value of) the land and
  • the transfer brings the assignee-landlord into privity of estate (ie, a mutual or successive relationship in the same property interest) with the tenant.
Here, a lease covenant required that the fast-food company contribute to costs associated with off-site improvements on the real estate developer's adjoining property. This covenant did not touch and concern the one-acre lot because it only affected the adjoining property. Therefore, the covenant does not run with the land, and the conveyance to the investor did not terminate the developer's right to enforce that covenant.

(Choice A) Privity of estate between the real estate developer (landlord) and the fast-food company (tenant) terminated when the one-acre lot was sold to the investor. But the developer retains the right to enforce the covenant to contribute because the covenant does not run with the land.

(Choice B) The implied warranty of habitability obligates landlords to pay maintenance costs to keep property fit for residential purposes. But this obligation does not apply to commercial leases (as seen here). Even if it did, this would not affect the real estate developer's recovery of off- site improvement costs.

(Choice D) An implied obligation to contribute to repair and maintenance costs arises under an easement. But the use of the off-site improvements by the fast-food company's customers (easement) did not obligate the company to contribute to improvement costs.

Educational objective: A lease covenant can only be enforced by an assignee-landlord if it runs with the land. This occurs when (1) the original parties intended to bind their successors, (2) the covenant touches and concerns the land, and (3) there is privity of estate.



选项正确率统计：A选项 21%，B选项 2%，C选项 73%（正确选项），D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

出租人通常可以在未经承租人同意的情况下，将其财产权益转让给第三方（即受让出租人）。然而，只有当租赁合同中的契约（即承诺）与土地一并转移（runs with the land）时，受让出租人才有权执行该契约。否则，原出租人保留执行该契约的权利。一项契约在以下情况下与土地一并转移：
  • 原始各方意图约束权益继受人（例如，受让出租人）
  • 该契约涉及并关系到（即影响其使用或价值）该土地并且
  • 该转让使受让出租人与承租人之间建立了财产利益关系（privity of estate）（即在同一财产权益中的相互或连续关系）。
在本案中，一项租赁契约要求快餐公司分担与房地产开发商相邻地产上的场外改良物相关的费用。这项契约不涉及也不关系到（touch and concern）那一英亩的地块，因为它仅影响相邻的地产。因此，该契约不与土地一并转移，转让给投资者之举并未终止开发商执行该契约的权利。

(选项A) 当一英亩地块出售给投资者时，房地产开发商（出租人）与快餐公司（承租人）之间的财产利益关系（privity of estate）即告终止。但开发商保留执行缴款契约的权利，因为该契约不与土地一并转移。

(选项B) 适租性的默示保证（implied warranty of habitability）要求出租人支付维护费用，以保持物业适于居住目的。但此义务不适用于商业租赁（如本案所示）。即使适用，这也不会影响房地产开发商追讨场外改良物的费用。

(选项D) 在地役权（easement）下，会产生分担维修和保养费用的默示义务。但是，快餐公司顾客对场外改良物的使用（地役权）并未使该公司有义务分担改良费用。

教学目的： 只有当租赁契约与土地一并转移时，受让出租人才能执行该契约。这种情况发生在：(1) 原始各方意图约束其继受人，(2) 契约涉及并关系到土地，以及 (3) 存在财产利益关系（privity of estate）。

References

Restatement (Second) of Prop.: Landlord & Tenant § 16.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (landlord's right to enforce lease provision against former tenant after transfer of ownership).

MBE Real Property Analysis

不动产所有权与租赁契约

📌 核心考点：契约随土地转移

本题考察的核心是：当房东转让房产时，租赁合同中的条款（Covenants）是否随土地转移给新房东（Running with the Land），还是保留在原房东手中作为个人契约（Personal Covenant）。

⚖️ 法律规则解析
规则： 受让房东（Assignee-Landlord）只有在契约"随土地转移" (Runs with the land) 时，才有权执行该契约。

一个契约要随土地转移，必须满足三个条件：

  • 意图 (Intent)： 原始双方意图约束继承者。
  • 涉及并关系到土地 (Touch and Concern)： 契约必须影响土地的使用或价值。
  • 财产利益关系 (Privity of Estate)： 双方存在地产权益上的关系。
🔍 本案关键事实分析

开发商将1英亩地卖给了投资者，但保留了剩余的99英亩土地。

争议的条款是：快餐公司支付"场外改良物" (Off-site improvements) 的费用。

关键判断：

  • 这个付款义务是为了维护开发商保留的那部分土地（场外），而不是为了维护投资者买下的那1英亩地。
  • 因此，该条款不涉及也不关系到 (Does not touch and concern) 被转让的那1英亩租赁土地。
✅ 正确答案：C

理由： 转让并未终止开发商执行该契约的权利。

由于支付"场外改良费"的契约不满足 Touch and Concern 的要求（因为它主要利益归属于开发商保留的相邻土地，而非租赁土地本身），该契约没有随土地转移给投资者。

这意味着：

  1. 投资者（新房东）无权执行此条款。
  2. 该条款仍然是开发商与快餐公司之间的个人契约 (Personal Covenant)。
  3. 尽管开发商不再拥有该地块（Privity of Estate 终止），但他仍保留基于合同的权利（Privity of Contract）来起诉追讨费用。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
  • 选项 A (错误)： 虽然转让确实终止了开发商与租户的 Privity of Estate，但这并不妨碍开发商执行那些未随土地转移的个人契约。
  • 选项 B (错误)： 商业租赁通常不适用居住租赁中的默示适租性保证 (Implied Warranty of Habitability)。且本案涉及的是明确的合同条款，非默示义务。
  • 选项 D (错误)： 这是一个基于合同条款的问题，而不是基于地役权 (Easement) 的默示维修义务。顾客使用设施是合同权利，费用的支付应依据合同条款判断。
💡 考试技巧：
遇到租赁转让题目，先画图分清谁拥有哪块地。如果契约涉及的是"场外" (Off-site) 利益，通常不随土地转移，原所有者保留执行权。

questions.question:
An owner of land devised the land to a specific university "for the purpose of conducting field research for the improvement of agricultural products and for no other purpose." The owner devised all of her other real property interests to her granddaughter. The owner's only heir was her son. Later, the university decided to build a science classroom on the land even though using the land for the enumerated purpose was still practicable. The owner's granddaughter, asserting ownership of the land, sought to evict the university from the land.
There is no applicable statute, and the common law Rule Against Perpetuities is unmodified in the jurisdiction.
If the court rules in favor of the university, what is the most likely reason?

choices.a: The cy pres doctrine applies to the university's current use of the land.
choices.b: The granddaughter's executory interest in the land is void under the Rule Against Perpetuities.
choices.c: The owner's son, not the granddaughter, is the proper plaintiff to seek eviction.
choices.d: The university owns the land in fee simple absolute because the devise did not include conditional or durational language.

data.questionStem:
Q86059

An owner of land devised the land to a specific university "for the purpose of conducting field research for the improvement of agricultural products and for no other purpose." The owner devised all of her other real property interests to her granddaughter. The owner's only heir was her son. Later, the university decided to build a science classroom on the land even though using the land for the enumerated purpose was still practicable. The owner's granddaughter, asserting ownership of the land, sought to evict the university from the land.

There is no applicable statute, and the common law Rule Against Perpetuities is unmodified in the jurisdiction.

If the court rules in favor of the university, what is the most likely reason?

一位土地所有者将土地遗赠给一所特定大学，‘用于进行旨在改良农产品的田野研究，且不得用于任何其他目的。’该所有者将其所有其他不动产权益遗赠给了她的孙女。该所有者唯一的继承人是她的儿子。后来，尽管将土地用于上述列明目的仍然可行，该大学仍决定在该土地上建造一间科学教室。该所有者的孙女主张对该土地的所有权，并试图将该大学从土地上驱逐出去。

该司法管辖区内没有适用的成文法，且普通法中的Rule Against Perpetuities（反永久所有权规则）未经修改。

如果法院作出有利于该大学的裁决，最可能的原因是什么？
options: A. The cy pres doctrine applies to the university's current use of the land. cy pres原则适用于该大学目前对土地的使用。

B. The granddaughter's executory interest in the land is void under the Rule Against Perpetuities.
根据Rule Against Perpetuities，孙女在该土地上的待执行权益是无效的。

C. The owner's son, not the granddaughter, is the proper plaintiff to seek eviction.
该所有者的儿子，而非孙女，才是寻求驱逐的适格原告。

D. The university owns the land in fee simple absolute because the devise did not include conditional or durational language.
该大学拥有该土地的完全永久所有权（fee simple absolute），因为遗赠中不包含条件性或期限性语言。
data.explanation:
Fee simple estates


TypeLanguageFuture interest
Fee simple absolute (Indefeasible)"To A" "To A and his heirs"None
Fee simple determinable (Defeasible, Durational)"so long as" "during" "until"Grantor's possibility of reverter Third party's executory interest (ie, fee simple subject to executory limitation)
Fee simple subject to condition subsequent (Defeasible, Conditional)"but if" "provided that" "unless"Grantor's right of entry
Like a fee simple absolute (FSA), a defeasible fee is ownership of potentially infinite duration. But unlike an FSA, a defeasible fee can be terminated by the occurrence of a stated event. Defeasible fees are limited by specific durational or conditional language (eg, "so long as," "but if"). However, language that limits only the purpose of the transfer (eg, "for the purpose of") creates an FSA.

Here, the owner's devise did not include conditional or durational language. Instead, the owner devised the land to the university "for the purpose of conducting field research for the improvement of agricultural products and for no other purpose." This conveyance created an FSA - not a defeasible fee - so the university is free to do with the land as it sees fit (eg, build a science classroom thereon). For that reason, the court will most likely rule in favor of the university.

(Choice A) The cy pres doctrine allows courts to reform the conveyance of a future interest - not the university's present interest - to come as close as possible to the transferor's intent while preventing it from violating the Rule Against Perpetuities.† Additionally, this doctrine only applies to a charitable gift or trust when the charitable objective is or later becomes impossible or impracticable to fulfill (not seen here).

(Choices B & C) The owner's conveyance created an FSA, which has no associated executory interest or other future interest. As a result,

neither the son nor the granddaughter has an interest in the land. But had the owner conveyed a defeasible fee and retained the associated future interest, the granddaughter (not the son) would hold that future interest. That is because the owner left all of her other real property interests to the granddaughter.

†The Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP) does not apply to future interests held by the grantor. Therefore, had the granddaughter succeeded to a future interest held by the owner (eg, possibility of reverter), it would not be subject to RAP.

Educational objective: Defeasible fees are limited by specific durational or conditional language (eg, "so long as," "but if"). Language that limits only the purpose of the transfer creates a fee simple absolute.

选项正确率统计：A选项 12%，B选项 4%，C选项 21%，D选项 60%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

Fee simple 地产


类型语言未来权益
完全永久所有权 (不可作废)“授予A” “授予A及其继承人”无
可废止永久所有权 (可废止，有期限)“只要” “在…期间” “直到”授予人的复归可能性 第三方的待执行权益（即，受待执行限制的永久所有权）
受限于后继条件的永久所有权 (可废止，有条件)“但是如果” “条件是” “除非”授予人的进入权
与完全永久所有权（FSA）一样，可废止所有权是一种可能无限期持续的所有权。但与FSA不同，可废止所有权可因某一规定事件的发生而终止。可废止所有权受到特定的期限性或条件性语言的限制（例如，“只要”、“但是如果”）。然而，仅限制转让目的的语言（例如，“为了…目的”）则创设了一个完全永久所有权（FSA）。

在本案中，所有者的遗赠不包含条件性或期限性语言。相反，所有者将土地遗赠给大学，“目的是进行旨在改良农产品的田野研究，且不得用于任何其他目的。”此项转让创设了完全永久所有权（FSA）——而非可废止所有权——因此该大学可按其认为合适的方式处置该土地（例如，在上面建造科学教室）。因此，法院最有可能作出有利于该大学的裁决。

(选项 A) cy pres原则允许法院修改一项未来权益的转让——而非该大学的当前权益——以尽可能接近转让人意图，同时防止其违反Rule Against Perpetuities。†此外，该原则仅适用于慈善赠与或信托的目标已经或后来变得不可能或不切实际以至于无法实现的情况（本案并非如此）。

(选项 B & C) 所有者的转让创设了完全永久所有权（FSA），其不附带任何待执行权益或其他未来权益。因此，儿子和孙女对该土地均不享有权益。但是，如果所有者转让的是一项可废止所有权并保留了相关的未来权益，那么孙女（而非儿子）将持有该未来权益。这是因为所有者将其所有其他不动产权益都留给了孙女。

†Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP) 不适用于由授予人持有的未来权益。因此，如果孙女继承了由所有者持有的未来权益（例如，复归可能性），该权益将不受RAP的约束。

教学目的： 可废止所有权受到特定的期限性或条件性语言（例如，“只要”、“但是如果”）的限制。仅限制转让目的的语言创设的是完全永久所有权。

References

Restatement of Property § 44 cmt. m (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (discussing designated purpose of conveyance).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Fee Simple & Defeasible Fees
💡 核心考点：语言的法律效力

本题考察的是如何区分完全永久所有权 (Fee Simple Absolute) 和可废止所有权 (Defeasible Fee)。

关键在于识别遗嘱中的语言是仅仅表达了目的/动机，还是设立了法律上的限制条件。

1. 法律规则解析

在普通法中，法院倾向于认定土地转让为完全永久所有权 (Fee Simple Absolute)，除非有明确的语言表明要设立条件或期限。

权益类型 关键“魔法词汇” 法律后果
完全永久所有权
Fee Simple Absolute		 "To A"
"To A and his heirs"		 拥有绝对处分权，无未来权益限制。
可废止所有权
Defeasible Fee		 期限性："So long as", "Until", "During"
条件性："But if", "Provided that"		 违反条件时，土地可能自动回归原主或被收回。
仅表述目的
Statement of Purpose		 "For the purpose of..."
"With the hope that..."		 视为完全永久所有权 (FSA)。该语言不具强制约束力。

2. 案情具体分析

题目中的遗赠语言是：

"for the purpose of conducting field research... and for no other purpose."
  • 虽然这句话看起来限制性很强（甚至说了“不得用于其他目的”），但在法律上，它缺乏设立可废止所有权所需的特定期限性或条件性词汇（如 so long as 或 but if）。
  • 这种语言被视为祈使性 (Precatory) 或仅仅是对转让动机的描述。
  • 结论： 大学获得了完全永久所有权 (Fee Simple Absolute)。

3. 为什么选 D？

选项 D 正确。 因为遗赠没有包含法律认可的条件性 (conditional) 或期限性 (durational) 语言。既然大学拥有的是 Fee Simple Absolute，他们就是土地的完全所有者，有权决定如何使用土地（包括建教室），原主人的继承人没有任何剩余权益。

4. 为什么其他选项错误？

  • 选项 A (Cy Pres): Cy Pres 原则通常用于慈善信托无法实现其目的时，法院对其进行修改。但在本案中，大学拥有土地的所有权（而非信托），且并没有出现目的无法实现的情况。
  • 选项 B (RAP): Rule Against Perpetuities 仅适用于特定的未来权益。由于这里创设的是 Fee Simple Absolute，不存在任何未来权益（如 Executory Interest），因此 RAP 不适用。
  • 选项 C (Proper Plaintiff): 既然大学拥有完全所有权，无论是儿子还是孙女都没有任何权益（没有 Possibility of Reverter 或 Right of Entry），因此谁来起诉都无法胜诉。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 考试中，如果你看到 "for the purpose of" 这种短语，哪怕后面跟了 "and no other purpose"，只要没有明确的没收条款 (forfeiture clause，例如 "otherwise to X") 或标准的条件词汇，默认选 Fee Simple Absolute。

questions.question:
An entrepreneur owned a ranch. He entered into a written three-year lease of the ranch with a rancher. Among other provisions, the lease prohibited the rancher from "assigning this lease, in whole or in part, and from subletting the ranch, in whole or in part." In addition to a house, a barn, and a one-car garage, the ranch's 30 acres included several fields where first the entrepreneur, and now the rancher, grazed sheep.
During the following months, by a written agreement, the rancher allowed his neighbor, a car enthusiast, exclusive use of the garage for storage, under lock and key, of his antique automobile for two years, charging him $240. The rancher told his other neighbor, a golfer, that she could use the fields to practice golf as long as she did not disturb his sheep.
Which, if any, of the rancher's actions constituted a violation of the lease?

choices.a: Only allowing the car enthusiast exclusive use of the garage for storage.
choices.b: Only allowing the golfer to use the fields to practice her golf.
choices.c: Both actions.
choices.d: Neither action.

Q86087

An entrepreneur owned a ranch. He entered into a written three-year lease of the ranch with a rancher. Among other provisions, the lease prohibited the rancher from "assigning this lease, in whole or in part, and from subletting the ranch, in whole or in part." In addition to a house, a barn, and a one-car garage, the ranch's 30 acres included several fields where first the entrepreneur, and now the rancher, grazed sheep.

During the following months, by a written agreement, the rancher allowed his neighbor, a car enthusiast, exclusive use of the garage for storage, under lock and key, of his antique automobile for two years, charging him $240. The rancher told his other neighbor, a golfer, that she could use the fields to practice golf as long as she did not disturb his sheep.

Which, if any, of the rancher's actions constituted a violation of the lease?

一名企业家拥有一处牧场。他与一名牧场主就该牧场签订了一份为期三年的书面租赁合同。除其他条款外，该租赁合同禁止牧场主“全部或部分转让本租约（assigning this lease），以及全部或部分分租（subletting）该牧场”。该牧场占地30英亩，除了一栋房屋、一个谷仓和一个单车位车库外，还包括几片此前由企业家本人、现由牧场主用来放羊的田地。

在接下来的几个月里，牧场主通过一份书面协议，允许他的邻居（一位汽车爱好者）在两年内独家使用车库，并上锁存放其古董车，为此向邻居收取240美元。牧场主告诉他的另一位邻居（一位高尔夫球手），只要不打扰他的羊，她就可以使用那些田地练习高尔夫。

牧场主的哪些行为（如有）构成了对租赁合同的违反？
options:
A. Only allowing the car enthusiast exclusive use of the garage for storage.
仅允许汽车爱好者独家使用车库进行存放的行为。

B. Only allowing the golfer to use the fields to practice her golf.
仅允许高尔夫球手使用田地练习高尔夫的行为。

C. Both actions.
两种行为均构成。

D. Neither action.
两种行为均不构成。
data.explanation:
Unless the lease expressly provides otherwise, a tenant is free to transfer his/her interest under the lease to a third party through either:
  • assignment - a transfer of all, or part of, the tenant's interest under the lease to a third party for the remainder of the tenant's lease term or
  • subletting - a transfer of all, or part of, the tenant's interest under the lease to a third party for less than the remainder of the tenant's lease term.


Here, the entrepreneur leased his ranch to the rancher for three years. The lease expressly prohibited the rancher from assigning or subletting the ranch, in whole or in part. The rancher then entered into a written agreement that gave the car enthusiast exclusive possession of the ranch's garage (part of the rancher's lease interest) for two years (less than the remainder of the rancher's lease term) in exchange for $240. Therefore, this written agreement was a sublease and violated the entrepreneur and rancher's lease (Choices B & D).

A tenant also is generally free to grant a license - a non-possessory (and usually non-exclusive) right to enter and use the property for a particular purpose - to a third party unless the lease states otherwise. Here, the lease only prohibited assigning and subletting. Therefore, the rancher's license to the golfer - granting her a non-exclusive right to enter and use the property to practice golf - did not violate the lease (Choices B & C).

Educational objective: A tenant generally has the right to (1) transfer his/her interest under a lease for the remainder (assignment) or part (sublease) of the lease term or (2) grant a non-possessory right to use the property for a particular purpose to another (license). However, these rights can be restricted by an express lease provision.



选项正确率统计：A选项 65%（正确选项），B选项 1%，C选项 6%，D选项 26%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

除非租赁合同另有明确规定，否则承租人可以自由地通过以下任一方式将其在租赁合同下的权益转让给第三方：
  • 租约转让（assignment） - 将承租人在租赁合同下的全部或部分权益，在租期的剩余期限内，转让给第三方；或
  • 分租（subletting） - 将承-租人在租赁合同下的全部或部分权益，在短于租期剩余期限的时间内，转让给第三方。


在本案中，企业家将其牧场租给牧场主，为期三年。租赁合同明确禁止牧场主全部或部分转让租约或分租牧场。牧场主随后签订了一份书面协议，以240美元的对价，将牧场车库（牧场主租赁权益的一部分）的独家占有权授予汽车爱好者，为期两年（短于牧场主租期的剩余期限）。因此，这份书面协议构成了一次分租（sublease），违反了企业家与牧场主之间的租赁合同（选项B和D错误）。

通常，承租人也可以自由地向第三方授予使用许可（license）——即为特定目的进入和使用该财产的非占有性（通常为非独家）权利——除非租赁合同另有规定。在本案中，租赁合同仅禁止租约转让（assigning）和分租（subletting）。因此，牧场主向高尔夫球手授予的使用许可——即允许她为练习高尔夫而进入和使用该财产的非独家权利——并未违反租赁合同（选项B和C错误）。

教学目的：承租人通常有权（1）将其在租赁合同下的权益，在租期的剩余期限内（租约转让/assignment）或部分期限内（分租/sublease）进行转让，或（2）向他人授予为特定目的使用该财产的非占有性权利（使用许可/license）。然而，这些权利可以通过租赁合同中的明确条款加以限制。

References

Restatement (Second) of Prop.: Landlord & Tenant §§ 15.1 - 15.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (assignments and subleases).

Restatement of Prop. § 512 (Am. Law Inst. 1944) (licenses).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

不动产法：租赁权益的转让与限制

正确答案：A 仅允许汽车爱好者独家使用车库的行为违反了租赁合同。

本题的核心考点在于区分分租 (Sublease) 与 使用许可 (License)，以及法院如何解释租赁合同中的限制性条款。

场景 1：车库 (The Garage) 违反合同

事实特征：

  • 独家使用 (Exclusive Use)：邻居拥有排他性的权利。
  • 上锁 (Under Lock and Key)：明确的控制权标志。
  • 固定期限与租金：两年，$240。

法律定性：分租 (Sublease)

当租户将部分物业的独家占有权 (Exclusive Possession) 转让给第三方，且时间短于剩余租期时，这构成了分租。由于合同明确禁止 "subletting"，此行为违约。

场景 2：高尔夫田地 (The Fields) 未违反

事实特征：

  • 非独家 (Non-exclusive)：只要不打扰羊群即可使用。
  • 特定目的：仅用于练习高尔夫。
  • 无占有权移交：牧场主仍保留对田地的控制。

法律定性：使用许可 (License)

License 仅仅是一种进入土地的特权 (Privilege to enter land)，不构成不动产权益的转让，也不涉及占有权的移交。

⚖️ 法律解释原则 (Rule of Construction)
法院通常严格解释 (Strictly Construe) 针对转让的限制条款。

如果租赁合同仅禁止“转让 (Assignment)”和“分租 (Subletting)”，法院不会将其扩大解释为禁止“使用许可 (License)”。除非合同明确写明 "No Licenses"，否则租户有权发放 License。

考点总结：如何区分？

特征 分租 (Sublease) 使用许可 (License)
核心权利 独家占有权
Exclusive Possession		 使用特权
Privilege to Use
排他性 是 (可排除房东/租户) 否 (通常非独家)
典型标志 "独家使用"、"上锁"、"固定空间" "允许进入"、"不打扰他人"
本题结果 ❌ 违反禁令 ✅ 合法

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)：
在 MBE 题目中，看到 "Exclusive Use" (独家使用) 或 "Under Lock and Key" (上锁) 这样的字眼，几乎总是暗示占有权 (Possession) 的转移，从而构成 Lease 或 Sublease。反之，如果只是允许某人做某事（如打球、挂广告牌），通常只是 License。

questions.question:
A widow created a testamentary trust to which she devised real property that was rented under a long-term lease. The trust was to pay the income from the trust to the widow's son for life and then accumulate the income from the trust until the son's first-born child reached 30 years of age, at which time the trust property was to be distributed to that child. Neither the will nor the trust contained any specific provision for distribution of the trust property if the son's first-born child were to die before reaching the age of 30. At the time of the widow's death, the widow's son had no children. Subsequently, the son had a child.
The son has recently died. His only child is now five years old. The trustee has sought a judicial ruling as to what to do with the trust property.
The applicable jurisdiction continues to follow the common law Rule Against Perpetuities but modifies it in accord with the cy pres doctrine.
If the court determines that the trust violates the Rule Against Perpetuities, what should the court order the trustee to do?

choices.a: Maintain the trust under its existing terms, because the cy pres doctrine allows the trust to continue under its existing terms despite violating the Rule Against Perpetuities.
choices.b: Maintain the trust until the child either lives for another 21 years or dies, because the cy pres doctrine allows the trust to be reformed as close as possible to the grantor's intent.
choices.c: Terminate the trust, because the child's interest in the trust violates the Rule Against Perpetuities and cannot be saved under the cy pres doctrine.
choices.d: Terminate the trust, because the child's interest in the trust violates the Rule Against Perpetuities and the cy pres doctrine applies only to charitable gifts.

data.questionStem: Q86047 A widow created a testamentary trust to which she devised real property that was rented under a long-term lease. The trust was to pay the income from the trust to the widow's son for life and then accumulate the income from the trust until the son's first-born child reached 30 years of age, at which time the trust property was to be distributed to that child. Neither the will nor the trust contained any specific provision for distribution of the trust property if the son's first-born child were to die before reaching the age of 30. At the time of the widow's death, the widow's son had no children. Subsequently, the son had a child. Recently, the son has died. His only child is now five years old. The trustee has sought a judicial ruling as to what to do with the trust property. The applicable jurisdiction continues to follow the common law Rule Against Perpetuities but modifies it in accord with the cy pres doctrine. How should the court rule? 一位寡妇设立了一项遗嘱信托，她将一处根据长期租赁合同出租的不动产遗赠给该信托。该信托将在寡妇儿子在世期间向其支付信托收入，然后累积信托收入，直到其儿子的长子女年满30岁，届时将信托财产分配给该子女。遗嘱和信托中均未包含任何具体条款，以规定在其儿子的长子女年满30岁前去世的情况下，该如何分配信托财产。在寡妇去世时，她的儿子没有子女。后来，该儿子有了一个孩子。 最近，儿子去世了。他唯一的孩子现在五岁。受托人已请求法院就如何处理信托财产作出裁决。 适用的司法管辖区继续遵循普通法上的 Rule Against Perpetuities，但根据 cy pres 原则对其进行修改。 法院应如何裁决？
options: A. Order the trustee to maintain the trust until the child either lives for another 21 years or dies, because the court may reform the conveyance under the cy pres doctrine. 命令受托人维持该信托，直到该子女再活21年或去世为止，因为法院可以根据 cy pres 原则修改该财产转让。

B. Order the trustee to maintain the trust until the child either reaches the age of 30 or dies, because the cy pres doctrine allows the trust to continue under its existing terms. 命令受托人维持该信托，直到该子女年满30岁或去世为止，因为 cy pres 原则允许信托按其现有条款继续存在。

C. Order the trustee to terminate the trust, because the child's interest in the trust violates the Rule Against Perpetuities and cannot be saved.
命令受托人终止该信托，因为该子女在信托中的权益违反了 Rule Against Perpetuities，且无法被补救。
D. Order the trustee to terminate the trust, because the cy pres doctrine only applies to charitable gifts. 命令受托人终止该信托，因为 cy pres 原则仅适用于慈善赠与。
data.explanation:
Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP)


Renders contingent future interests void if they could vest more than 21 years after some life in being when interest was created:
Traditional common law rule
  • Contingent remainders
  • Executory interests
  • Vested remainders subject to open
  • Powers of appointment
  • Rights of first refusal
  • Options
Reforms
  • "Wait & see" stance (most jurisdictions) - otherwise invalid interest is valid if it vests within 90 years of its creation
  • Cy pres doctrine (few jurisdictions) - otherwise invalid interest will be reformed to come "as close as possible" to grantor's intent without violating RAP
The Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP) applies to contingent future interests in grantees , where the grantee is unascertained or there is a condition precedent to the interest becoming vested. RAP renders these interests void if they could vest more than 21 years after the end of some life in being when the interest was created. Here, the child's future interest in the trust is subject to RAP because it is contingent upon the child's reaching 30 years of age. And it violates RAP because the 5-year-old child cannot turn 30 within 21 years of the son's death.

However, this jurisdiction applies the cy pres doctrine to interests that violate RAP. This doctrine allows a court to make changes to a conveyance to come "as close as possible" to the grantor's actual intent without violating RAP (Choice C). Here, the widow did not provide for an alternative taker in the event that the child's interest failed, so her intent was to save the child's interest in the trust if possible. Therefore, the court should change the age contingency and order the trustee to maintain the trust until the child lives for another 21 years (or dies).

(Choice B) The cy pres doctrine allows courts to reform a conveyance to prevent it from violating RAP; it does not allow a trust that violated RAP to continue under its existing terms.

(Choice D) While the cy pres doctrine is most often applied by courts to save a gift to charity, it can also be applied when RAP would void a contingent future interest in a noncharitable grantee (as seen here).

Educational objective: In a few jurisdictions, the cy pres doctrine allows a court to reform a conveyance to come as close as possible to the grantor's intent while staying within the bounds of the Rule Against Perpetuities - eg, by reducing the time limit for a future interest to vest to 21 years after the end of the last life in being when the interest was created.

选项正确率统计：A选项 24%（正确选项），B选项 27%，C选项 27%，D选项 19%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP)


如果或有未来权益 可能 在权益创设时存在的某个生命结束21年后才归属，则该规则使其无效：
传统普通法规则
  • 或有剩余产权 (Contingent remainders)
  • 待执行权益 (Executory interests)
  • 可扩大的既得剩余产权 (Vested remainders subject to open)
  • 指定权 (Powers of appointment)
  • 优先购买权 (Rights of first refusal)
  • 选择权 (Options)
改革
  • “等待观望”立场 (大多数司法管辖区) - 若一项本应无效的权益在其创设后的90年内归属，则其为有效
  • Cy pres 原则 (少数司法管辖区) - 若一项本应无效的权益，将被修改以“尽可能接近”设权人的意图，同时不违反 RAP
Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP) 适用于受赠人的或有未来权益，即当受赠人尚未确定，或权益的归属存在先决条件时。如果这些权益可能在权益创设时存在的某个生命结束后超过21年才归属，RAP 将使这些权益无效。在本案中，该子女在信托中的未来权益受 RAP 约束，因为它以该子女年满30岁为或有条件。并且它违反了 RAP，因为这个5岁的孩子不可能在作为衡量生命的儿子去世后的21年内年满30岁。

然而，该司法管辖区对违反 RAP 的权益适用 cy pres 原则。该原则允许法院修改财产转让，以在不违反 RAP 的前提下“尽可能接近”设权人的真实意图 (选项 C)。在本案中，寡妇没有规定在该子女的权益失效情况下的替代受益人，因此她的意图是尽可能保全该子女在信托中的权益。因此，法院应更改年龄的或有条件，并命令受托人维持信托，直到该子女再活21年（或去世）。

(选项 B) cy pres 原则允许法院修改财产转让以防止其违反 RAP；它不允许一个违反了 RAP 的信托按其现有条款继续存在。

(选项 D) 虽然 cy pres 原则最常被法院用于挽救对慈善机构的赠与，但当 RAP 将导致非慈善受赠人的或有未来权益无效时，它也可以适用（如本案所示）。

教学目标： 在少数司法管辖区，cy pres 原则允许法院修改财产转让，以尽可能接近设权人的意图，同时又保持在 Rule Against Perpetuities 的限制范围内——例如，将未来权益的归属时限缩短为权益创设时存在的最后一个生命终结后的21年。

References

Restatement (Second) of Property: Donative Transfers § 1.5 (Am. Law Inst. 1983) (applying cy pres principles to reform interests that would otherwise fail under the Rule Against Perpetuities).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考题解析

Real Property: Rule Against Perpetuities

核心考点：RAP 与 Cy Pres 原则
Rule Against Perpetuities (RAP) 简介：
任何权益必须在“设权时存在的生命 (Life in Being) + 21年”内归属 (Vest)，否则自始无效。
1 分析 RAP 违规情况

本案中，衡量生命 (Life in Being) 是寡妇的儿子。他在寡妇去世时（信托设立时）在世。

问题出在哪里？

  • 权益归属条件：长子年满 30 岁。
  • 最坏情况假设：儿子去世时，孩子刚出生（或如题中所示，只有5岁）。
  • 计算：5岁 + 25年 = 30岁。
  • 25年 > 21年。
儿子去世 (Life Ends) ➔ 需等待 25 年 ➔ 权益归属
❌ 违反 RAP (超过了 21 年限制)

根据传统普通法，该赠与将直接无效 (Void ab initio)，信托终止。

2 应用 Cy Pres 原则

题目明确指出该司法管辖区适用 Cy Pres (意为 "as near as possible") 原则来修改 RAP 规则。

Cy Pres 的作用：

法院不会直接废除该权益，而是会修改条款，使其在不违反 RAP 的前提下，尽可能接近设立人的意图。

  • 设立人意图： 给孙子财产，但希望等到他成熟（30岁）。
  • 法律限制： 儿子死后最多只能等 21 年。
  • 修改方案： 将年龄要求降低到法律允许的最大限度。
✅ 正确答案：A

命令受托人维持信托，直到该子女再活21年或去世。

解析：
既然儿子已经去世，RAP 的倒计时已经开始。为了挽救这个信托（根据 Cy Pres），法院会将“年满30岁”这个条件修改为“儿子死后21年”。

此时孩子5岁，再过21年是26岁。虽然达不到寡妇原本希望的30岁，但这已经是法律允许的最长期限，且保全了赠与。

3 为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 B (维持至30岁)： 错误。Cy Pres 是为了修正违规条款，而不是允许违规条款继续存在。维持到30岁依然违反 RAP。
  • 选项 C (终止信托)： 错误。这是传统普通法（无改革）的结果。题目明确说了有 Cy Pres 改革，法院必须尝试挽救。
  • 选项 D (仅限慈善)： 错误。虽然 Cy Pres 起源于慈善信托，但在现代 RAP 改革语境下，它被广泛用于修正私人信托中的 RAP 违规。
🎓 考场技巧 (MBE Tips):
1. 看到 "Age 30" (或任何大于21的年龄) 作为归属条件，立即警惕 RAP 问题。
2. 检查题目是否提及 "Wait and See" (等待观望) 或 "Cy Pres" (修正)。
3. 如果是 Cy Pres，答案通常是“修改年龄至21年”或“修改期限至法定上限”。不要选“直接无效”或“按原样执行”。

questions.question:
Seven years ago, a man, his sister, and his cousin became equal owners, as tenants in common, of a house. Until a year ago, the man lived in the house alone. The sister and the cousin are longtime residents of another state.
One year ago, the man moved to an apartment and rented the house to a tenant for three years under a lease that the man and the tenant both signed. The tenant has since paid the rent each month to the man.
Recently, the sister and the cousin learned about the rental. They brought an appropriate action against the tenant to have the lease declared void and to have the tenant evicted. The tenant raised all available defenses.
What will the court likely decide?

choices.a: The lease is valid, and the tenant is not evicted but must share possession with the sister and the cousin.
choices.b: The lease is valid, and the tenant retains exclusive occupancy rights for the balance of the term.
choices.c: The lease is valid, but the tenant is evicted because one-third of the lease term has expired and the man had only a one-third interest to transfer.
choices.d: The lease is void, and the tenant is evicted.
