What will the court likely decide?

七年前，一名男子、他的妹妹和他的堂/表兄/弟/姐妹以tenants in common（按份共有人）的身份成为一栋房屋的平等共有人。直到一年前，该男子一直独自居住在该房屋内。妹妹和堂/表兄/弟/姐妹是另一州的长期居民。

一年前，该男子搬进了一套公寓，并根据他与一名租户共同签署的为期三年的租赁合同，将该房屋出租给该租户。此后，租户每月向该男子支付租金。

最近，妹妹和堂/表兄/弟/姐妹得知了租赁事宜。她们对租户提起了适当的诉讼，要求宣布租赁合同无效并驱逐租户。租户提出了所有可用的抗辩理由。

法院可能会做出何种裁决？
options:
A. The lease is valid, and the tenant is not evicted but must share possession with the sister and the cousin.
租赁合同有效，租户不会被驱逐，但必须与妹妹和堂/表兄/弟/姐妹共同占有该房屋。

B. The lease is valid, and the tenant retains exclusive occupancy rights for the balance of the term.
租赁合同有效，租户在剩余租期内保留独家占用权。

C. The lease is valid, but the tenant is evicted because one-third of the lease term has expired and the man had only a one-third interest to transfer.
租赁合同有效，但租户被驱逐，因为三分之一的租期已过，而该男子仅有三分之一的权益可供转让。

D. The lease is void, and the tenant is evicted.
租赁合同无效，租户被驱逐。
data.explanation:
Consent between cotenants in common


(common examples)
Consent requiredNo consent required
Convey entire co-owned propertySell, lease, or devise personal ownership interest
Obtain exclusive possession over part of propertyPossess entire co-owned property
Bind other cotenants' interests in contract with third partyExtract minerals from co-owned property (unless committing waste)
Tenancy in common is concurrent ownership of property where each co-tenant has a separate share of the property but the right to possess and enjoy the entire property (ie, separate but undivided interests). A tenant in common may lease or otherwise transfer his/her property interest to a third party without the other co-tenants' consent. But the other co-tenants are entitled to:
  • possess and use the entire property with the third party and
  • share expenses and income (eg, rent) generated by the property in proportion to their property interests.

Here, the man, sister, and cousin share the house as tenants in common. The man leased the house to a tenant, who then paid rent to the man. And though the sister and cousin only recently learned of this lease, it is valid (not void) because the man did not need their consent to lease his property interest. As a result, the court will likely decide that the tenant is not evicted but must share possession with the sister and cousin (Choices B & D).

(Choice C) Although the man (an equal owner) had only a one-third interest in the house, he was entitled to lease his right to possess and enjoy the entire house to the tenant. And since two-thirds of the lease term still remain, the tenant should not be evicted.

Educational objective

A tenant in common has the right to lease (or otherwise transfer) his/her separate, undivided property interest to a third party without the other co- tenants' consent. But the other co-tenants have the right to share possession of the property with the third party and receive a share of the rental income in proportion to their property interests.

选项正确率统计：A选项 69%（正确选项），B选项 25%，C选项 1%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

Tenants in common（按份共有人）之间的同意


（常见示例）
需要同意无需同意
转让整个共有财产出售、租赁或遗赠个人所有权权益
获得对部分财产的独家占有权占有整个共有财产
在与第三方的合同中约束其他共有人的权益从共有财产中开采矿产（除非构成损耗）
Tenancy in common (按份共有) 是一种财产的共同所有权形式，其中每个共有人拥有财产的独立份额，但有权占有和享用整个财产（即，独立但不可分割的权益）。按份共有人可以无需其他共有人同意，将其财产权益租赁或以其他方式转让给第三方。但其他共有人有权：
  • 与该第三方共同占有和使用整个财产，并且
  • 按其财产权益比例分摊财产产生的费用和分享收入（例如，租金）。

在本案中，该男子、妹妹和堂/表兄/弟/姐妹以tenants in common（按份共有人）的身份共享该房屋。该男子将房屋出租给一名租户，租户随后向该男子支付租金。尽管妹妹和堂/表兄/弟/姐妹最近才得知此租赁事宜，但该租赁是有效的（非无效），因为该男子租赁其财产权益无需她们的同意。因此，法院很可能裁定租户不会被驱逐，但必须与妹妹和堂/表兄/弟/姐妹共同占有该房屋（选项 B 和 D 错误）。

（选项 C）尽管该男子（作为平等共有人）仅拥有该房屋三分之一的权益，但他有权将其占有和享用整个房屋的权利出租给租户。而且，由于租期还有三分之二，租户不应被驱逐。

教学目标

按份共有人有权在未经其他共有人同意的情况下，将其独立但不可分割的财产权益租赁（或以其他方式转让）给第三方。但是，其他共有人有权与该第三方共同占有该财产，并按其财产权益的比例获得一份租金收入。

References

20 Am. Jur. 2d Cotenancy and Joint Ownership § 31 (2018) (defining tenancy in common).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Co-Tenancy & Leases

本题考察的核心法律概念是 Tenancy in Common（按份共有） 下共有人的权利范围，特别是关于租赁（Lease）和占有（Possession）的规则。

核心法则 (The Rule) 在 Tenancy in Common 中，每一位共有人（Co-tenant）都拥有对整个房产的占有权（Right to Possess the Whole），且有权在未经其他共有人同意的情况下，转让或租赁自己的权益。

1. 为什么租赁是有效的？

虽然该男子只拥有 1/3 的所有权份额，但他拥有 100% 的房产使用权（与其他共有人共享）。

法律允许按份共有人将自己的权益租赁给第三方。当男子签署租约时，租户（Tenant）实际上是“穿上了男子的鞋子” (Steps into the shoes of the lessor)。

男子
(Co-Tenant)
1/3 权益
➔
租户
(Tenant)
获得占有权

因此，租赁合同是有效 (Valid) 的，其他共有人（妹妹和表亲）不能仅仅因为未同意就宣布合同无效。

2. 为什么不能驱逐租户？

既然租户继承了男子的占有权，他就拥有了在该房屋居住的合法权利。只要租约有效，其他共有人就不能通过法律程序将其驱逐（Evict）。

3. 为什么必须“共同占有”？

这是本题最关键的转折点。虽然男子可以将自己的权利转让给租户，但他不能转让比他自己拥有的更多的权利。

  • 男子拥有的是“与其他共有人共享的占有权”。
  • 男子没有“排除其他共有人”的权利 (Right to Exclude)。

因此，租户也不能排除妹妹和表亲。如果妹妹和表亲想要搬进来住，租户必须允许。这就是所谓的共同占有 (Shared Possession)。

行为 法律后果
男子出租房屋 有效。无需其他共有人同意。
妹妹试图驱逐租户 失败。租户有合法占有权。
租户试图独占房屋 失败。租户必须与妹妹/表亲共享。

选项分析

选项 A (正确)：租赁有效，租户不被驱逐，但必须与妹妹和表亲共享占有权。这完美符合上述法律逻辑。

选项 B (错误)：错在“Exclusive Occupancy”（独家占用）。男子自己都没有独家占用权（相对于其他共有人），所以他无法将独家权授予租户。

选项 C (错误)：错在认为只能转让部分权益会导致驱逐。Tenancy in Common 的特点就是“不可分割的占有权”（Undivided Interest）。

选项 D (错误)：错在认为租赁无效。共有人有权单方面处分自己的权益。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip) 在 MBE 财产法题目中，如果看到一个共有人（Co-tenant）在未征得同意的情况下出租或抵押房产：
  1. 交易通常是有效的（不因缺乏同意而无效）。
  2. 第三方获得的权利不能超过原共有人的权利（即不能排除其他共有人）。
  3. 其他共有人有权分享租金收入（Accounting），但不能取消租约。
© MBE Property Law Review

questions.question:
An aunt owned a commercial property consisting of a one-story building rented to various retail stores and a large parking lot. Two years ago, the aunt died and left the property to her nephew for life, with remainder to her godson, his heirs and assigns. The devise of the property was made subject to any mortgage on the property in effect at the time of the aunt's death.
A year before her death, the aunt mortgaged the property to secure a loan of $150,000. The entire principal of the mortgage remained outstanding when she died. As a result, the net annual income from the property was reduced not only by real estate taxes and regular maintenance costs, but also by the substantial mortgage interest payments due each month.
A commercial real estate developer recently proposed to purchase the property and pay off the mortgage in order to demolish the existing building and construct a 30-story office building. The nephew was willing to accept the developer's offer. However, the godson refused the offer even though he, as the remainderman, paid the principal portion of each monthly mortgage payment. The godson wanted to convert the property into a public park when he became entitled to possession.
When the developer realized that the godson would not change his mind, it modified its proposal to a purchase of the nephew's life estate. When the godson learned that the nephew had agreed to the developer's modified proposal, the godson brought an appropriate action against them to enjoin their carrying it out.
What is the godson's best argument?

choices.a: Continued existence of the one-story building is more in harmony with the ultimate use as a park than the proposed change in use.
choices.b: The developer cannot purchase the nephew's life estate, because life estates are not assignable.
choices.c: The godson's payment of the mortgage principal has subrogated him to the nephew's rights as a life tenant and bars the nephew's assignment of the life estate without the godson's consent.
choices.d: The proposed demolition of the building constitutes waste.

data.questionStem:
Q86110

An aunt owned a commercial property consisting of a one-story building rented to various retail stores and a large parking lot. Two years ago, the aunt died and left the property to her nephew for life, with remainder to her godson, his heirs and assigns. The devise of the property was made subject to any mortgage on the property in effect at the time of the aunt's death.

A year before her death, the aunt mortgaged the property to secure a loan of $150,000. The entire principal of the mortgage remained outstanding when she died. As a result, the net annual income from the property was reduced not only by real estate taxes and regular maintenance costs, but also by the substantial mortgage interest payments due each month.

A commercial real estate developer recently proposed to purchase the property and pay off the mortgage in order to demolish the existing building and construct a 30-story office building. The nephew was willing to accept the developer's offer. However, the godson refused the offer even though he, as the remainderman, paid the principal portion of each monthly mortgage payment. The godson wanted to convert the property into a public park when he became entitled to possession.

When the developer realized that the godson would not change his mind, it modified its proposal to a purchase of the nephew's life estate. When the godson learned that the nephew had agreed to the developer's modified proposal, the godson brought an appropriate action against them to enjoin their carrying it out.

What is the godson's best argument?

一位姑母拥有一处商业地产，该地产包含一栋出租给多家零售商店的单层建筑和一个大型停车场。两年前，姑母去世，将该地产遗赠给她的侄子终身持有(for life)，剩余权益(remainder)则归于她的教子及其继承人和受让人。该地产的遗赠受制于姑母去世时该地产上存在的任何抵押权。

在姑母去世前一年，她将该地产抵押，以担保一笔15万美元的贷款。她去世时，该抵押贷款的全部本金仍未偿还。因此，该地产的年净收入不仅因房地产税和常规维护成本而减少，还因每月需支付的大量抵押贷款利息而减少。

最近，一位商业房地产开发商提议购买该地产并清偿抵押贷款，以便拆除现有建筑，建造一栋30层的办公楼。侄子愿意接受开发商的要约(offer)。然而，教子拒绝了该要约，尽管他作为剩余权益人(remainderman)，支付了每月抵押贷款偿还中的本金部分。教子希望在他有权占有该地产时，将其改造成一个公园。

当开发商意识到教子不会改变主意时，便将其提议修改为购买侄子的终身地产权(life estate)。当教子得知侄子已同意开发商修改后的提议时，教子对他们提起了适当的诉讼，以禁止他们执行该计划。

教子最好的论点是什么？
options:
A. Continued existence of the one-story building is more in harmony with the ultimate use as a park than the proposed change in use.
保留单层建筑比提议的用途变更更符合其作为公园的最终用途。

B. The developer cannot purchase the nephew's life estate, because life estates are not assignable.
开发商不能购买侄子的终身地产权(life estate)，因为终身地产权不可转让。

C. The godson's payment of the mortgage principal has subrogated him to the nephew's rights as a life tenant and bars the nephew's assignment of the life estate without the godson's consent.
教子支付抵押贷款本金的行为使他代位取得了侄子作为终身地产权人(life tenant)的权利，并禁止侄子在未经教子同意的情况下转让其终身地产权。

D. The proposed demolition of the building constitutes waste.
提议的拆除建筑行为构成了“耗损”(waste)。
data.explanation:
Life tenant's duties


Duty to pay current chargesLife tenant must pay all current charges due during life tenancy (eg, property taxes, mortgage interest) up to financial benefit received from property
Duty to prevent wasteLife tenant must prevent affirmative waste (ie, voluntary waste), permissive waste & ameliorative waste
Duty to make ordinary repairsLife tenant must make reasonable repairs to preserve property
A life estate is a present possessory interest that terminates on the death of an individual. This interest is freely transferable (Choice B). But since it is followed by a future interest that will become possessory once the life estate terminates, the life tenant has a duty to prevent waste. There are three types of waste:
  • Affirmative waste - changes that decrease the property's value
  • Permissive waste - deterioration caused by neglect or the failure to reasonably protect the property
  • Ameliorative waste - changes that increase the property's value but are not necessary to make reasonable use of the property amid substantial and permanent changes in the local area

The future interest holder (the godson) may inspect the land for waste and may seek damages or an injunction to prevent waste. This ensures that the life tenant (the nephew) delivers the property to the future interest holder in essentially the same condition it was in when the life tenant took possession.

Here, the demolition of the building would change the condition of the property. Although the construction of a 30-story office building would likely increase the property value, there is no indication that this change is necessary. Therefore, the godson's best argument is that the proposed demolition constitutes waste.

(Choice A) A life tenant can use the property in any manner that does not constitute waste - even if that use affects the future interest holder's plans. Therefore, the godson's plan to use the property as a park is irrelevant.

(Choice C) The future interest holder is responsible for the mortgage principal, but this does not bar the life tenant from assigning the life estate or allow the future interest holder to subrogate the life tenant's rights. Instead, subrogation allows a third party who fully pays off a senior mortgage with no knowledge of junior interests to take that senior mortgage's priority.

Educational objective: A life tenant has a duty to prevent waste so that the property can be delivered in essentially the same condition it was in when the life tenant took possession.

选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 6%，C选项 25%，D选项 61%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

终身地产权人的义务


支付当期费用的义务终身地产权人必须支付其终身地产权存续期间到期的所有当期费用（例如，房产税、抵押贷款利息），但以其从该地产中获得的经济利益为限
防止耗损(waste)的义务终身地产权人必须防止主动耗损（即自愿性耗损）、容许性耗损和改善性耗损
进行日常维修的义务终身地产权人必须进行合理的维修以维护地产
终身地产权(life estate)是一种现有的占有权益，它在某一个人死亡时终止。该权益可以自由转让（选项B）。但由于其后跟随一个未来权益，该未来权益将在终身地产权终止时变为占有性权益，因此终身地产权人有防止耗损(waste)的义务。耗损(waste)有三种类型：
  • 主动耗损 (Affirmative waste) - 导致地产价值减少的变更
  • 容许性耗损 (Permissive waste) - 因疏忽或未能合理保护地产而造成的损耗
  • 改善性耗损 (Ameliorative waste) - 增加地产价值但并非在当地发生重大永久性变化的情况下为合理使用地产所必需的变更

未来权益持有人（教子）可以检查土地是否存在耗损，并可以寻求损害赔偿或禁令以防止耗损。这确保了终身地产权人（侄子）在将地产交付给未来权益持有人时，地产的状况与终身地产权人取得占有权时的状况基本相同。

在本案中，拆除建筑将改变地产的状况。尽管建造一栋30层的办公楼可能会增加地产价值，但没有迹象表明这种变更是必要的。因此，教子最好的论点是，提议的拆除行为构成了耗损(waste)。

（选项A）终身地产权人可以以任何不构成耗损的方式使用地产——即使该使用方式影响了未来权益持有人的计划。因此，教子计划将该地产用作公园是无关紧要的。

（选项C）未来权益持有人负责抵押贷款的本金，但这并不禁止终身地产权人转让其终身地产权，也不允许未来权益持有人代位取得终身地产权人的权利。相反，代位求偿权(subrogation)允许在对次级权益不知情的情况下全额清偿了高级抵押贷款的第三方，取得该高级抵押贷款的优先权。

教学目标：终身地产权人有防止耗损(waste)的义务，以便在交付地产时，其状况与终身地产权人取得占有权时的状况基本相同。

References

Restatement (First) of Property § 140 (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (life tenant's duty to prevent waste).

MBE 考点解析：不动产所有权

本题考察的核心法律概念是终身地产权人 (Life Tenant) 与剩余权益人 (Remainderman) 之间的权利义务关系，特别是关于耗损 (Waste) 的原则。

核心考点：耗损原则 (Doctrine of Waste)

终身地产权人有权使用土地并从中获益，但有义务维护房产的现状，以便在权益终止时将其完好地移交给剩余权益人。违反此义务即构成“耗损”。

为什么选项 D 是最佳论点？

1. 事实认定

开发商（作为侄子终身地产权的受让人）计划拆除现有的单层建筑，建造30层的办公楼。这属于对不动产物理性质的重大改变。

2. 法律定性：主动耗损 (Affirmative/Voluntary Waste)

拆除现有建筑物属于典型的“主动耗损”。即使新建筑（30层办公楼）可能增加土地的市场价值，这种行为通常也被视为改善性耗损 (Ameliorative Waste)。

3. 剩余权益人的权利

在普通法下，剩余权益人（教子）有权要求土地以其原本的状态移交给自己。除非当地社区环境发生了根本性变化，使得原有用途不再合理（本题中未提及此情况，且现有建筑仍有租金收入），否则终身地产权人无权单方面彻底改变土地性质。

因此，教子主张拆除行为构成 Waste 是获得禁令 (Injunction) 的最强法律依据。

为什么其他选项是错误的？

选项 A (公园用途)：

这是主观论点。法律保护的是剩余权益人接收“原状”财产的权利，而不是保护他未来的具体使用计划（建公园）。只要不构成耗损，终身地产权人如何使用土地与教子的未来愿望无关。

选项 B (不可转让性)：

法律错误。 终身地产权 (Life Estate) 是完全可以转让的 (Alienable)。侄子可以将他的权益卖给开发商，开发商将拥有该权益直到侄子去世（即 pur autre vie 的终身地产权）。

选项 C (代位求偿/Subrogation)：

这是一个干扰项。虽然教子作为剩余权益人确实负责支付抵押贷款的本金 (Principal)（终身地产权人负责利息），但这并不赋予他阻止侄子转让权益的权利。支付本金是他在保护自己的未来权益，并不能剥夺侄子的处分权。

💡 MBE 答题技巧

当题目涉及终身地产权人试图改变土地现状（如拆除房屋、开采矿产、砍伐森林）时，首先寻找"Waste" (耗损) 这个关键词。

记住原则：Life Tenant 必须维持现状 (Maintain the Status Quo)。 除非是为了维修或该土地仅能通过开采资源来使用，否则彻底的改变通常是被禁止的。

questions.question:
A landlord and a tenant entered into a valid written agreement to lease a single-family residence for a period of one year at $1,200 per month. Among the provisions in the agreement was a waiver of the implied warranty of habitability. Two months into the lease, the electricity stopped working through no fault of the tenant. The tenant notified the landlord, but after one week, the landlord had done nothing to remedy the problem. When the next month's rent came due, the tenant refused to pay it because the landlord had still not fixed the electricity. The landlord has filed an action for breach of contract against the tenant for failure to pay rent.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.a: The landlord, because the tenant waived the implied warranty of habitability in the lease.
choices.b: The landlord, because there is no duty to repair under a residential lease.
choices.c: The tenant, because the landlord's failure to repair the electricity violated the implied covenant of quiet enjoyment.
choices.d: The tenant, because the tenant notified the landlord of the problem and gave him a reasonable opportunity to correct it.

Who is likely to prevail?

一位房东和一位租户签订了一份有效的书面协议，以每月1200美元的价格租赁一处独户住宅，租期为一年。协议中的条款包括一项对默示可居住性保证的放弃声明。租赁开始两个月后，电力中断，且并非租户的过错。租户通知了房东，但一周后，房东未采取任何措施解决该问题。当下一个月的租金到期时，由于房东仍未修复电力问题，租户拒绝支付租金。房东以租户未支付租金为由，对租户提起了违约诉讼。

哪一方可能胜诉？
options:
A. The landlord, because the tenant waived the implied warranty of habitability in the lease.
房东，因为租户在租赁合同中放弃了默示可居住性保证。

B. The landlord, because there is no duty to repair under a residential lease.
房东，因为住宅租赁合同中没有维修义务。

C. The tenant, because the landlord's failure to repair the electricity violated the implied covenant of quiet enjoyment.
租户，因为房东未能修复电力问题，违反了默示宁静享用契约。

D. The tenant, because the tenant notified the landlord of the problem and gave him a reasonable opportunity to correct it.
租户，因为租户已将问题通知房东，并给予其合理的纠正机会。
data.explanation:
Landlord's duty to repair leased premises


Type of leaseCommon lawMajority rule
ResidentialNo duty to repair unless statute or contract requiresDuty to repair substantial defects under implied warranty of habitability
CommercialNo duty to make ordinary repairs unless statute or contract requires
In most jurisdictions, landlords of leased residential properties have a duty to repair substantial defects that are not caused by the tenant. Failure to make such repairs violates the implied warranty of habitability, which ensures that residential properties satisfy basic safety and living conditions. If the warranty is violated, the tenant may:

  • refuse to pay rent until the necessary repairs are made
  • remedy the defect and offset those costs against the rent or
  • defend against eviction (eg, by asserting constructive eviction).


However, the tenant must notify the landlord of the problem AND give the landlord a reasonable opportunity to correct it before exercising these remedies.

Here, the electricity in the leased residence stopped working two months into the lease through no fault of the tenant. The tenant notified the landlord of this defect and gave him one week, a reasonable opportunity, to correct the problem. The landlord did nothing. Therefore, the tenant was entitled to withhold rent and is likely to prevail in this breach-of-contract action.

(Choice A) The implied warranty of habitability cannot be waived by a tenant, either by express language in the lease or by taking possession of the property with knowledge of the conditions.

(Choice B) At common law, a landlord had no implied duty to make repairs under a residential lease. However, landlords do have an implied duty to repair in most jurisdictions today.

(Choice C) The implied covenant of quiet enjoyment is a promise by the landlord not to interfere with the tenant's possession of the leased premises. Here, the landlord did not violate this covenant since the failure to repair the electricity did not interfere with the tenant's right to possess the leased residence.

Educational objective: In most jurisdictions, a residential landlord must repair substantial defects not caused by the tenant. Breach of this duty violates the implied warranty of habitability and allows the tenant to withhold rent, remedy the defect and offset the costs, or defend against eviction - if the landlord had a reasonable opportunity to correct the defect after notice.

选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 0%，C选项 10%，D选项 79%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

房东维修租赁房屋的义务


租赁类型普通法多数规则
住宅除非法规或合同要求，否则无维修义务根据默示可居住性保证，有义务维修重大缺陷
商业除非法规或合同要求，否则无日常维修义务
在大多数司法管辖区，住宅租赁物业的房东有义务维修并非由租户造成的重大缺陷。未能进行此类维修则违反了默示可居住性保证(implied warranty of habitability)，该保证确保住宅物业满足基本的安全和居住条件。如果该保证被违反，租户可以：

  • 拒绝支付租金，直到必要的维修完成
  • 自行修复缺陷，并用维修费用抵销租金，或
  • 抗辩驱逐（例如，通过主张推定驱逐(constructive eviction)）。


然而，在行使这些救济措施之前，租户必须将问题通知房东，并给予房东合理的纠正机会。

在本案中，租赁开始两个月后，租赁住宅的电力中断，且非租户的过错。租户将此缺陷通知了房东，并给予其一周的合理机会来纠正问题。房东未采取任何行动。因此，租户有权拒付租金，并可能在此次违约诉讼中胜诉。

（选项A）租户不能放弃默示可居住性保证，无论是通过租赁合同中的明确语言，还是在知晓房屋状况的情况下占有该物业。

（选项B）在普通法下，房东在住宅租赁中没有默示的维修义务。然而，如今在大多数司法管辖区，房东确实有默示的维修义务。

（选项C）默示宁静享用契约(implied covenant of quiet enjoyment)是房东作出的不干涉租户占有租赁房屋的承诺。在本案中，房东未违反此契约，因为未能修复电力问题并未干涉租户占有租赁住宅的权利。

教学目标：在大多数司法管辖区，住宅房东必须维修并非由租户造成的重大缺陷。违反此义务即违反了默示可居住性保证，并允许租户在通知房东并给予其合理纠正机会后，拒付租金、自行修复缺陷并抵销费用，或对驱逐进行抗辩。

References

Restatement (Second) of Property: Landlord & Tenant § 5.5 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (landlord's duty to repair).

MBE 考点解析

不动产法：房东与租户的义务

✅ 正确答案分析 (选项 D)

本题的核心在于默示可居住性保证 (Implied Warranty of Habitability) 的执行程序。

虽然现代法律规定房东必须维修住宅，但房东并非对所有损坏承担“严格责任”。租户要行使拒付租金的权利，必须满足两个程序性条件：

  1. 通知 (Notice)： 租户必须告知房东房屋存在的缺陷。
  2. 合理机会 (Reasonable Opportunity)： 租户必须给予房东合理的时间来修复缺陷。

在本案中，租户通知了房东，且等待了一周（对于电力中断这种紧急情况，一周已超出合理时间），房东仍未行动。因此，租户有权拒付租金。

⚖️ 关键法律规则：默示可居住性保证

定义： 在大多数司法管辖区，住宅租赁合同中默示包含一项保证，即房屋必须适合人类居住（例如有水、电、暖气）。

不可放弃性 (Non-waivable)： 这是本题的一大陷阱。 与商业租赁不同，住宅租户不能通过合同条款放弃此项权利。即使租约中写了“放弃保证”，该条款也是无效的（违反公共政策）。

❌ 为什么选项 A 错误？

选项 A 声称租户“放弃”了该保证。如上所述，默示可居住性保证是不可放弃的。任何试图让租户放弃基本居住权利的条款在法律上通常是无效的。

❌ 为什么选项 C 错误？

这是一个常见的混淆项。选项 C 提到了默示宁静享用契约 (Implied Covenant of Quiet Enjoyment)。

  • 宁静享用： 主要针对房东干扰租户的占有权（如噪音、非法进入）。其对应的救济通常是推定驱逐 (Constructive Eviction)，这通常要求租户搬离房屋。
  • 可居住性： 针对房屋的物理状况。其救济允许租户留在房屋内并拒付租金（或自行维修后抵扣）。

由于租户没有搬走而是选择拒付租金，这是基于“可居住性保证”的救济，而非“宁静享用契约”。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到“住宅租赁维修”问题时，请遵循以下思维路径：

  1. 确认类型： 是住宅 (Residential) 还是商业 (Commercial)？（住宅保护更多）。
  2. 检查条款： 是否有放弃权利的条款？（住宅中通常无效）。
  3. 检查程序： 租户是否通知了房东并给了时间维修？（这是行使权利的前提）。
  4. 区分概念： 房屋坏了不修 = 违反可居住性保证；房东吵闹或封锁房屋 = 违反宁静享用契约。

questions.question:
A dairy farmer and his cousin owned a large farm in fee simple as tenants in common, each owning an undivided one-half interest. For five years, the farmer occupied the farm and conducted farming operations. The farmer never accounted to his cousin for any income but did pay all real estate taxes when they were due and kept the buildings on the farm insured against loss from fire, storm, and flood. The cousin lived in a distant city and was interested only in realizing a profit from the sale of the land when market conditions produced the price he wanted.
The farmer died intestate survived by his daughter, who was his sole heir. Thereafter, the daughter occupied the farm but was inexperienced in farming operations. The result was a financial disaster. The daughter failed to pay real estate taxes for two years. The appropriate governmental authority held a tax sale to recover the taxes due. At the sale, the cousin was the only bidder and obtained a conveyance from the appropriate governmental authority upon payment of an amount sufficient to discharge the amounts due for taxes, plus interest and penalties, and the costs of holding the tax sale. The amount paid was one-third of the reasonable market value of the farm.
Thereafter, the cousin instituted an appropriate action against the daughter to quiet title in and recover possession of the farm. The daughter asserted all defenses available to her.
Except for the statutes related to real estate taxes and tax sales, there is no applicable statute.
In this lawsuit, is the cousin entitled to a decree quieting title so that he is the sole owner in fee simple of the farm?

choices.a: No, if the daughter pays the cousin one-half of the amount he paid for the tax deed.
choices.b: No, if the daughter pays the cousin one-half of the reasonable market value of the farm.
choices.c: Yes, because the cousin survived the farmer.
choices.d: Yes, because the daughter defaulted in the obligations undertaken by the farmer.

一位奶农和他的堂兄作为分权共有人（tenants in common），以完全所有权（fee simple）共同拥有一座大农场，每人拥有不可分割的二分之一权益。五年来，该奶农占有并经营该农场。奶农从未向其堂兄报告过任何收入，但按时支付了所有到期的房产税，并为农场上的建筑物投保了火灾、风暴和洪水险。堂兄住在一个遥远的城市，他唯一的兴趣是在市场行情达到他期望的价格时，通过出售土地来实现盈利。

奶农未立遗嘱而去世，其唯一继承人是他的女儿。此后，女儿占有该农场，但由于缺乏农场经营经验，导致了财务上的灾难。女儿连续两年未支付房产税。相关政府机构为收回欠税举行了一次税务拍卖。在拍卖会上，堂兄是唯一的竞标人，并在支付了足以清偿所欠税款、利息、罚金以及举行税务拍卖费用的金额后，从相关政府机构处获得了产权转让文书。他支付的金额是该农场合理市价的三分之一。

此后，堂兄对女儿提起了适当的诉讼，请求确认其对农场的所有权（quiet title）并收回占有。女儿提出了所有可用的抗辩。

除了与房产税和税务拍卖相关的法规外，没有其他适用的成文法。

在本案诉讼中，堂兄是否有权获得确认所有权的判决，从而成为该农场唯一的完全所有权人（owner in fee simple）？
options:
A. No, if the daughter pays the cousin one-half of the amount he paid for the tax deed.
不可以，如果女儿向堂兄支付其为税务契据所付款项的一半。

B. No, if the daughter pays the cousin one-half of the reasonable market value of the farm.
不可以，如果女儿向堂兄支付农场合理市价的一半。

C. Yes, because the cousin survived the farmer.
可以，因为堂兄在奶农去世后仍然在世。

D. Yes, because the daughter defaulted in the obligations undertaken by the farmer.
可以，因为女儿未履行奶农所承担的义务。
data.explanation:
A tenant who buys back co-owned property at a tax sale or foreclosure sale takes the property subject to the other co-tenants' interests. The nonpaying co-tenants then have a reasonable time to contribute their share of the purchase price (as determined by their proportionate ownership interests). A co-tenant who fails to do so forfeits his/her interest in the property to the purchasing co-tenant.

Here, the dairy farmer and his cousin each owned a one-half interest in the farm as tenants in common. When the farmer died, his daughter acquired his one-half interest in the farm. She failed to pay real estate taxes for two years, and a tax sale was held. At that sale, the cousin bought back the farm. But he will only be the sole owner of the farm if the daughter fails to contribute her one-half share of the purchase price.

(Choice B) The daughter need only pay the cousin half of the amount he paid at the tax sale to retain her one-half interest in the farm. The farm's reasonable market value is irrelevant.

(Choice C) The fact that the cousin survived the farmer would have entitled him to sole ownership of the farm had they been joint tenants. That is because a joint tenant's interest disappears upon death and the remaining tenants' interests automatically expand to absorb it (ie, right of survivorship). But tenants in common have no such right.

(Choice D) The daughter's default on tax obligations did not terminate her interest in the farm. Instead, her interest in the farm (or forfeiture thereof) depends on whether she pays the cousin her due contribution - half of the purchase price.

Educational objective: A tenant who buys back co-owned property at a tax or foreclosure sale takes the property subject to the other co-tenants' interests. But the other co-tenants must contribute their proportionate share of the purchase price within a reasonable time to avoid forfeiting their interests to the purchasing co-tenant.



选项正确率统计：A选项 59%（正确选项），B选项 17%，C选项 3%，D选项 19%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在税务拍卖或止赎拍卖中回购共同持有财产的共有人，其所获财产仍受其他共有人权益的约束。未付款的共有人则有合理的时间来分摊其应付的购买价款份额（根据其所有权比例确定）。未能在此期限内分摊的共有人将向购买方共有人丧失其财产权益。

在本案中，奶农和他的堂兄作为分权共有人（tenants in common），各拥有农场二分之一的权益。奶农去世后，他的女儿继承了他二分之一的权益。她连续两年未支付房产税，因此举行了税务拍卖。在拍卖会上，堂兄回购了该农场。但是，只有在女儿未能支付她应分摊的二分之一购买价款时，堂兄才能成为该农场的唯一所有权人。

(选项B) 女儿只需向堂兄支付其在税务拍卖中所付款项的一半，即可保留她在农场中的二分之一权益。农场的合理市价与此无关。

(选项C) 如果他们是联权共有人（joint tenants），堂兄在奶农去世后尚存这一事实，将使他有权获得农场的唯一所有权。这是因为联权共有人的权益会随着其死亡而消失，其余在世共有人的权益会自动扩大以吸收该权益（即生存者财产权 right of survivorship）。但分权共有人（tenants in common）没有此项权利。

(选项D) 女儿未履行纳税义务的行为并未终止其在农场中的权益。相反，她是否保留（或丧失）其在农场中的权益，取决于她是否向堂兄支付她应分摊的份额——即购买价款的一半。

教学目标：在税务或止赎拍卖中回购共同持有财产的共有人，其所获财产仍受其他共有人权益的约束。但是，其他共有人必须在合理时间内分摊其相应比例的购买价款，以避免其权益被购买方共有人所剥夺。

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Co-tenancy & Tax Sales

⚖️ 核心法则：共有人的信义义务

当一名共有人（Co-tenant）在税务拍卖（Tax Sale）或止赎拍卖（Foreclosure Sale）中购买共有财产时，法律视为他是为了所有共有人的利益而赎回（Redeem）该财产，而不仅仅是为自己购买。

购买方持有的产权受制于其他共有人的权益，前提是其他共有人在合理时间内支付其应分摊的费用。

📊 案情逻辑推演

1. 关系确认：
奶农去世后，其女儿继承权益。此时，女儿与堂兄成为分权共有人 (Tenants in Common)。

2. 关键事件：
女儿未缴税导致税务拍卖。堂兄作为共有人之一，买下了整个农场。

3. 法律后果：
虽然堂兄付了钱并拿到了地契，但他不能借此“清洗”掉女儿的权益。因为共有人之间存在一种类似受托人的信任关系（Confidential Relationship）。堂兄买回农场的行为，在法律上被视为代表双方支付了欠税。

4. 补救措施：
女儿有权通过支付她那部分应承担的费用（即堂兄支付金额的一半），来恢复她的所有权权益。这就是所谓的分摊权 (Right of Contribution)。

✅ 选项深度解析
选项 A (正确)

"不可以，如果女儿向堂兄支付其为税务契据所付款项的一半。"

这是正确答案。只要女儿履行了分摊义务（Contribution），堂兄就不能通过Quiet Title Action剥夺她的所有权。她需要支付的是实际成本（堂兄支付金额）的一半，而不是市场价。

选项 B (错误)

关于“合理市价”

分摊（Contribution）是基于补偿原则。堂兄只支付了拍卖价（通常远低于市价），女儿只需补偿堂兄实际支出的成本的一半即可，无需按市场价支付。

选项 C (错误)

关于“生存者财产权”

这是联权共有 (Joint Tenancy)的特征。题目明确指出他们是分权共有人 (Tenants in Common)，没有生存者财产权（Right of Survivorship）。奶农死后，其权益由继承人（女儿）继承，而非自动归堂兄所有。

选项 D (错误)

关于“违约义务”

虽然女儿未缴税是过错方，但这并不导致她自动丧失所有权（Forfeiture）。法律给予共有人通过偿还费用来挽救其权益的机会。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧：

看到 Co-tenants（共有人） + Tax Sale/Foreclosure（拍卖）的组合时，请立即联想：
  • 共有人不能通过拍卖“吃掉”对方的份额。
  • 购买行为被视为“代表大家赎回”。
  • 另一方有权通过支付份额比例的成本来保留权益。

A landowner granted a construction company the exclusive right to remove sand and gravel from the landowner's property for 20 years in exchange for a monthly payment of a fixed amount. The agreement was properly recorded. Three years later, the construction company purchased the landowner's property and built a plant for processing the sand and gravel on the property. Twelve years after purchasing the property, the construction company sold the portion of the land on which the sand and gravel was located to a buyer, while retaining the portion of the land on which the processing plant was located. The contract made no specific mention of the prior recorded agreement, but the construction company had come to rely on the supply of sand and gravel from the property. Although there are other sources for the sand and gravel, sand and gravel are necessary for the projects undertaken by the construction company. The buyer has refused to permit the construction company to continue to remove sand and gravel from the portion of the property purchased by the buyer.
Which of the following is the construction company's best argument for this profit?

choices.a: Sand and gravel are necessary for the construction company to operate.
choices.b: The buyer is estopped from denying the existence of the profit due to the construction company's reliance on the property as its source for sand and gravel.
choices.c: The profit exists by implication.
choices.d: The written agreement that created the profit was recorded.
